emile.meaning_en: The name Emil, Emile, or Émile is a male given name of Indo-European origin. This name has multiple meanings: laborious, rival, or eager, which are derived from the Latin Aemilius of the gens Aemilia.

emilia.meaning_en: Emilia is a feminine Italian given name of Latin origin. The name is popular all over Europe and the Americas. The corresponding masculine name is Emilio. Emily is the English form of the Italian name.
emilia.meaning_fr: Émilie est un nom propre qui peut désigner :

emiliano.meaning_en: Emiliano is a male given name. Notable people with the name include:

emilie.meaning_fr: Émilie est un prénom féminin d'origine romaine venant du latin Aemilia, féminin du prénom Aemilius signifiant « de la gens Aemilia ». La sainte Émilie se fête le 19 septembre.

emilija.meaning_fr: Émilie est un prénom féminin d'origine romaine venant du latin Aemilia, féminin du prénom Aemilius signifiant « de la gens Aemilia ». La sainte Émilie se fête le 19 septembre.

emilio.meaning_en: Emilio is a given name common in the Italian and Spanish languages. The Portuguese-language version of the name is spelled Emílio. Like its counterpart in other languages, Emil, the name is derived from the Latin Aemilius of the gens Aemilia.

emily.meaning_en: Emily is a feminine given name derived from the Roman family name "Aemilius", and is the feminine form of the name Emil.

emin.meaning_en: Emin is a Bosnian and Turkish masculine given name. In the Balkans, Emin is popular among Bosniaks in the former Yugoslav nations. It is also popular among Albanians. The name is a modification to the name Amin, and it holds the same meaning: truthful.

emine.meaning_en: Emine is an Arabic-origin given name used for women in Turkey. It has three major meanings: one in whom you can trust and believe, one who is benign and innocuous, and one who is fearless and courageous. It is also argued that the word means beautiful.

emir.meaning_en: Emir is a male given name. It is derived from the Arabic title Emir or Amir. In Turkish, Emir means command, order, prince, local king. In the Balkans, Emir is popular among Bosniaks in the former Yugoslav nations. The name is a modification to the name Amir.

emmalee.meaning_en: Emily is a feminine given name derived from the Roman family name "Aemilius", and is the feminine form of the name Emil.

emmalyn.meaning_en: Emmeline is a feminine given name. The medieval name, a short form of Germanic names beginning with the element amal meaning "work", was introduced to England by the Normans.

famous.name: Prince Albert of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha

emmanuel.meaning_en: Emmanuel is a name and surname, which is a romanization of Immanuel. Notable prople with the name include:
emmanuel.meaning_fr: Emmanuel ou Emanuel ou encore Immanuel est un prénom dérivé de l'hébreu ‘immânû ’él, qui signifie « Dieu est parmi nous ».

emmanuelle.meaning_en: Emmanuelle is a feminine given name of French origin.
emmanuelle.meaning_fr: Emmanuelle est un prénom féminin, féminin du prénom Emmanuel.

emmeline.meaning_en: Emmeline is a feminine given name. The medieval name, a short form of Germanic names beginning with the element amal meaning "work", was introduced to England by the Normans.

emmy.meaning_en: Emmy is a feminine given name. Orthographic variants include Emme, Emmi and Emmie. The name is in many instances a hypocoristic of either Emma or Emily, or Emmanuel. It came to be used as a separate German name, given officially in Germany from the later 19th century.

emrah.meaning_en: Emrah is a Turkish masculine given name. It is a form of Emre.

emre.meaning_en: Emre is a popular Turkish male given name that means "lover" and/or "friend". It is also a surname in Turkey. The most popular idea is that Emre originates from the Turkish imrenmek, meaning “to love, desire" or "to feel a longing".

eneko.meaning_en: Eneko is a Basque masculine given name, derived from the hypocoristic, old Basque name Enneco, "my little/dear", from ene + ko. Variants of the name rendered in Spanish include Inigo and most widespread form Íñigo or Iñigo.
eneko.meaning_fr: Eneko est un prénom masculin basque. L'équivalent du prénom est « Íñigo » en espagnol. Prénom rendu célèbre par Eneko Arista, le premier roi de Navarre. Le féminin est Eneka.

enguerrand.meaning_en: Enguerrand is a medieval French name, derived from a Germanic name Engilram, from Angil, the tribal name of the Angles, and hramn "raven".
enguerrand.meaning_fr: Enguerrand est un prénom masculin français d'origine franque.

enid.meaning_en: Enid is a feminine given name. Its origin is Middle Welsh eneit, meaning 'spirit; life; purity'.
enid.meaning_fr: Enid est un prénom féminin dont les origines sont du terme eneit qui signifie en moyen gallois esprit ; vie ; pureté.

eniola.meaning_en: Eniola is a Nigerian unisex name of Yoruba origin, serving as both a unisex given name and surname. Eniola means "a wealthy person or an influential person". It is more commonly associated with female individuals.

enis.meaning_en: Enis is a male given name. In the Balkans, Enis is popular among Bosniaks in the former Yugoslav nations. It is also popular among Albanians.

enoch.meaning_en: Enoch is a masculine given name. It is popularized by the biblical figure and patriarch, Enoch in the Bible. The name is derived from Greek Ἑνώχ itself from Hebrew חֲנוֹךְ which came from while the verb.

enola.meaning_en: Enola is an English feminine given name often taken from the English word alone spelled backwards. It is also an English spelling of a Cherokee name meaning black fox.

enora.meaning_en: Enora or Énora is a Breton female given name. Notable people with the name include: Enora Latuillière, French biathlete Énora Malagré, French columnist and radio and television presenter Énora Villard, French professional squash player
enora.meaning_fr: Enora ou Enori est un prénom féminin, fêté le 14 octobre.

enrico.meaning_en: Enrico is an Italian masculine given name which means homeowner, or king, derived from Heinrich of Germanic origin. It is also a given name in Ladino. Equivalents in other languages are Henry, Henri, Enrique, Henrique and Hendrik.

enrique.meaning_en: Enrique is the Spanish variant of the given name Heinrich of Germanic origin. Equivalents in other languages are Henry, Enric, Enrico, Henrik, Heinrich, Hendrik, Henk, Henri, and Henrique. Common nicknames of Enrique are Kiki, Kiko, Kike, Rick, Ricky, and Quique.

enza.meaning_en: Enza is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Enza Anderson, Canadian journalist and politician Enza Barilla, Australian football player Enza Petrilli or Vincenza Petrilli, Italian paralympic archer

enzo.meaning_en: Enzo is an Italian given name derivative of the German name Heinz. It can be used also as the short form for Lorenzo, Vincenzo, Innocenzo, or Fiorenzo. It is most common in the Romance-speaking world, particularly in Italy and Latin America.

eoghan.meaning_en: Éogan is an early Irish male given name, which also has the hypocoristic and diminutive forms Eoganán, Eóghainin, Eóghain and Eóghainn. The Modern Irish form of the name is Eoghan. In Scottish Gaelic, the name is Eòghann or Eòghan.

eoin.meaning_en: Eóin is a masculine Irish-language given name. The Scottish Gaelic equivalent is Eòin and both are closely related to the Welsh Ioan. It is also cognate with the Irish Seán and English John.

ephraim.meaning_en: Ephraim is a masculine given name of Hebrew and Aramaic origin, first used by the Israelite patriarch of that name. In the modern English language, it is typically rəm/. In Hebrew, the name means "fruitful, fertile and productive".

eri.meaning_en: Eri is a common feminine Japanese given name.

eric.meaning_en: The male given names Eric, Erich, Erikk, Erik, Erick, Eirik, or Eiríkur are derived from the Old Norse name Eiríkr [ˈɛiˌriːkz̠].

erica.meaning_en: The given name Erika is a female name with multiple meanings of Classical Latin, Old Norse, and Japanese origin. Erika and the variants Erica, Ericka, or Ereka are feminine forms of Eric, derived from the Old Norse name Eiríkr.

ericka.meaning_en: Ericka, or Éricka in France, is a girl's given name, a variant of Erica and Erika. People with the name include: Ericka Huggins Ericka Bareigts Ericka Hart Ericka Hunter Ericka Beckman Ericka Dunlap

erik.meaning_en: The male given names Eric, Erich, Erikk, Erik, Erick, Eirik, or Eiríkur are derived from the Old Norse name Eiríkr [ˈɛiˌriːkz̠].

erika.meaning_en: The given name Erika is a female name with multiple meanings of Classical Latin, Old Norse, and Japanese origin. Erika and the variants Erica, Ericka, or Ereka are feminine forms of Eric, derived from the Old Norse name Eiríkr.

erin.meaning_en: Erin is a personal name taken from the Hiberno-English word for Ireland, originating from the Irish word "Éirinn".

erina.meaning_en: Erina is a feminine Japanese given name.

erline.meaning_en: Erline is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Erline Harris, American rhythm and blue singer Erline P. McGriff, American professor of nursing Erline Nolte, German bobsledder

ermal.meaning_en: Ermal is an Albanian masculine given name, which means "wind of the mountain".

erminia.meaning_en: Erminia is a feminine given name. It is related to the name Armina, the feminine form of Herman or Armand, which means soldier. Erminia was a character in Tasso's medieval epic poem Jerusalem Delivered. It is sometimes given as Hermine or Herminie.

erna.meaning_en: Erna is a Germanic feminine given name. It is a simplified version of Ernesta, in turn from Ernest.

ernest.meaning_en: Ernest is a given name derived from the Germanic word ernst, meaning "serious", often shortened to Ernie. Notable people and fictional characters with the name include:

ernesto.meaning_en: Ernesto, a form of the name Ernest, is a masculine given name in several Romance languages. Notable people and characters with the name include:

ernst.meaning_en: Ernst is both a surname and a given name, the German, Dutch, and Scandinavian form of Ernest. Notable people with the name include:

eros.meaning_en: Eros is a masculine given name. Bearers include:

ervin.meaning_en: Ervin is a male given name of Indo-European origin, meaning "green water," "fresh water," "friend of the sea," or "army friend." It is believed to have either originated from Old English or Old Gaelic, referring to its water-related meanings, or from the German language, where it signifies "friend of the army." In German, it is typically written as Erwin, but in many other European nations where the name is popular—namely Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Estonia, Hungary, and Romania—it is written as Ervin.
ervin.meaning_fr: Erwin est un prénom masculin d'origine germanique. Sa variante Ervin est utilisée notamment en hongrois.

erwan.meaning_en: Erwan is a masculine Breton given name, sometimes spelled Erwann. Its francization is the French given name Yves.

erwin.meaning_fr: Erwin est un prénom masculin d'origine germanique. Sa variante Ervin est utilisée notamment en hongrois.

eryk.meaning_en: Eryk is a given name. It is the Polish form of the name Erik.

esa.meaning_en: ESA most commonly refers to the European Space Agency. ESA or Esa may also refer to:

esme.meaning_en: Esmé or Esmée is a given name derived from the past participle of the Old French verb esmer, "to esteem", thus signifying "esteemed", or similarly "beloved". Originally a masculine name, Esmé had become a feminine name by the mid-twentieth century.

esmee.meaning_en: Esmé or Esmée is a given name derived from the past participle of the Old French verb esmer, "to esteem", thus signifying "esteemed", or similarly "beloved". Originally a masculine name, Esmé had become a feminine name by the mid-twentieth century.

esmeralda.meaning_en: Esmeralda is a feminine given name of Portuguese and Spanish origin meaning emerald.

espen.meaning_en: Espen is a Norwegian masculine given name. In Norway it reached the peak of its popularity between 1970 and 1990, during which period approximately 1.1% of children were given that name.

esperanza.meaning_en: Esperanza is a Spanish feminine given name, meaning "hope" or "expectation".

esra.meaning_en: Esra is a common Turkish given name for females. It is also a common Arabic name as Isra or Asra. People named Esra include:

essie.meaning_en: Essie is a given name and nickname/hypocorism usually used as a feminine name. As a standalone name, Essie can be found in several languages, including Romance, Germanic, and Persian ones.

esteban.meaning_en: Esteban is a Spanish male given name, derived from Greek Στέφανος and related to the English names Steven and Stephen. Although in its original pronunciation the accent is on the penultimate syllable, English-speakers tend to pronounce it as a proparoxytone EST-ib-an.

estelle.meaning_en: Estelle is a female name of Occitan origin, and means star. Saint Estelle was a martyr who purportedly lived in Aquitania in the third century AD, although the earliest references to her date from the Middle Ages.

esther.meaning_en: Esther is a female given name known from the Jewish queen Esther, eponymous heroine of the Book of Esther. According to the Hebrew Bible, queen Esther was born with the name הֲדַסָּה‎ Hadassah. Her name was changed to Esther to hide her identity upon becoming queen of Persia.

ethan.meaning_en: Ethan or Eytan is a male given name of Hebrew origin that means "firm, enduring, strong and long-lived". The name Ethan appears eight times in the Hebrew Bible.
ethan.meaning_fr: Ethan est un nom d'origine hébraïque cité dans la Bible.

ethel.meaning_en: Ethel is an Old English word meaning "noble", today often used as a feminine given name.

etienne.meaning_en: Étienne, a French analog of Stephen or Steven, is a masculine given name. An archaic variant of the name, prevalent up to the mid-17th century, is Estienne. Étienne, Etienne, Ettiene, Estienne, or Ettienne may refer to:

etta.meaning_en: Etta is an English given name that is a diminutive form of Antonietta, Henrietta and other names that end in “-etta”. Etta is also a Danish, Finnish, Norwegian, Old Danish, Old Swedish and Swedish given name. Notable people with this name include the following:
etta.meaning_fr: Etta est un prénom féminin italien ou anglais, respectivement forme réduite des prénoms Antonietta et Henrietta. Etta est aussi présent en danois, finnois, norvégien et suédois et peut désigner :

euan.meaning_en: Euan is a Scottish, male given name, most common throughout the United Kingdom, Canada and Australia, due to the influence of Scots in both nations.

eudora.meaning_en: Eudora is a feminine given name derived from the Greek word elements eu, meaning "good" and dōron, meaning "gift". It is written in Ancient Greek as Εὐδώρη. Eudora is a name used for three nymphs in Greek mythology. Variants in use include Eudoria and Udora.

eufemia.meaning_en: Eufemia is a feminine given name, a variant spelling of Euphemia in various languages.

eugene.meaning_en: Eugene is a common masculine given name that comes from the Greek εὐγενής, "noble", literally "well-born", from εὖ, "well" and γένος, "race, stock, kin". Gene is a common shortened form. The feminine variant is Eugenia or Eugenie. Other male foreign-language variants include:
eugene.meaning_fr: Eugène est un prénom masculin provenant du grec εὐγενής, signifiant « noble » ou « bien-né », venant lui-même de εὖ « bien » et γένος « race ». Le prénom partage la même origine que le mot eugénique. Il est fêté à plusieurs dates selon le saint auquel il se réfère.

eugenia.meaning_en: Eugenia is a feminine first name related to the masculine name Eugene that comes from the Greek eugenes 'well-born', from eu- 'well' + genes 'born'.

eulalie.meaning_fr: Eulalie est un prénom féminin français. Il est fêté le 10 décembre.

eulogio.meaning_en: Eulogio is a given name. Notable people with given name include: Eulogio Altamirano, Chilean soldier Eulogio Aranguren, Argentine footballer Eulogio Balao, Filipino soldier Eulogio Cantillo, major general in the Cuban Army Eulogio F.

euphemia.meaning_en: Euphemia, also spelled Eufemia, is a feminine given name of Greek origin meaning "well spoken", from a combination of the Greek word elements eu , meaning "good", and phēmí, "to speak". Several early Christian saints were called Euphemia.

euphrasie.meaning_fr: Euphrasie est un nom propre qui peut désigner :

eusebio.meaning_en: Eusebio or Eusébio is both a Spanish and Portuguese masculine given name and surname. Notable people with the name include:

eustace.meaning_en: Eustace is the rendition in English of two phonetically similar Greek given names: Εὔσταχυς meaning "fruitful", "fecund"; literally "abundant in grain"; its Latin equivalents are FæcundusEustis is a variant spelling.

eva.meaning_en: Eva is a female given name derived from the Greek Εὕα, and ultimately from the Hebrew חַוָּה, the name of the first woman in the Book of Genesis. The name spread widely in Europe through the Latin Bible and remains common in many languages.

evalena.meaning_en: Evalena, Eva-Lena, or Eva Lena are feminine given names.

evan.meaning_en: Evan is a Welsh masculine given name, derived from Iefan, a Welsh form of the name John. Evan can also occasionally be found as a shortened version of Greek names like Evangelos, Evander, or Evandro.

evangelina.meaning_en: Evangelina and Evangeline are feminine given names, diminutives of Latin "evangelium". People with these names include:

evangeline.meaning_en: Evangelina and Evangeline are feminine given names, diminutives of Latin "evangelium". People with these names include:

evangelos.meaning_en: Evangelos, Vangelis is a common Greek male name. The diminutive derived from the name Evangelos, is usually Vangelis. The female equivalent is Evangelía. It is an ancient Greek name; in Greek mythology there are at least two personalities bearing the name.

evann.meaning_en: Evann is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Evann Girault, French-Nigerien sabre fencer Evann Guessand, French footballer Evann Siebens, Canadian multi-disciplinary artist

eve.meaning_en: Eve is a feminine English given name, derived from the Latin name Eva, in turn originating with the Hebrew חַוָּה‎. In Greece the name Eve is Evi, a diminutive of the baptismal name Paraskevi.

evelia.meaning_en: Evelia is a feminine given name. Notable people with the name include: Evelia Farina, Argentine sprinter María Evelia Marmolejo, Colombian radical feminist performance artist Evelia Edith Oyhenart, Argentine anthropologist Evelia Sandoval Urbán, Mexican politician

evelin.meaning_fr: Evelin est un prénom porté par : Evelin Jahl, une athlète allemande, lanceuse de disque. Evelin Ilves, Première dame d'Estonie. Katri-Evelin Kalaus, psychologue clinicienne estonienne. Voir aussi Evellin pour le patronyme.

evelina.meaning_en: Evelina is a feminine given name. It is either a Latinised variant of Evelyn or an extension of Eva. Notable people with the name include:

eveline.meaning_en: Evelyn is a matronymic English surname derived from the medieval girl's name Aveline. Since the 17th century, it has also been used as a given name. The earliest recorded bearer was Evelyn Pierrepont, who was a grandson of the Roundhead politician Sir John Evelyn.

evelyn.meaning_en: Evelyn is a matronymic English surname derived from the medieval girl's name Aveline. Since the 17th century, it has also been used as a given name. The earliest recorded bearer was Evelyn Pierrepont, who was a grandson of the Roundhead politician Sir John Evelyn.

even.meaning_en: Even is a Norwegian given name coming from Old Norse Eivindr. Another common name derived from Old Norse Eivindr is the Norwegianized Eivind. Eivind, and variants such as Øyvind.

everardo.meaning_en: Everardo is a Spanish male given name. It is cognates with the English name Everard, and is ultimately derived from the Old Germanic name Eberhard.

everett.meaning_en: Everett is a masculine given name. It is derived from the Old English name Eoforheard and the Germanic Eberhard. Eoforheard has two elements: 'eofor', and 'heard'. Thus Everett means brave as a boar or strong as a boar. Spelling variants include Evert and Everette.

everly.meaning_en: Everly is a given name of English origin that is a transferred use of an English place name and surname. It has increased in popularity as a given name for girls in recent years in the United States.

evert.meaning_en: Evert is a Dutch and Nordic short form of the Germanic masculine name "Everhard". The Germanic meaning is brave as a boar. The Finish spelling is Eevert. The diminutive form is Eef. The English variant is Everett. The related surname is Everts.

evi.meaning_en: Evi is a feminine given name.

evita.meaning_en: Eva is a female given name derived from the Greek Εὕα, and ultimately from the Hebrew חַוָּה, the name of the first woman in the Book of Genesis. The name spread widely in Europe through the Latin Bible and remains common in many languages.

ewa.meaning_en: Ewa is a feminine given name in Eastern Europe and a feminine given name specifically in Poland, the Polish counterpart of English Eve or Latin Eva. People with the name include:
ewa.meaning_fr: Ewa est l'équivalent polonais et suédois du prénom Ève.

ewan.meaning_en: Ewan is a Scottish name with multiple sources. It is usually an anglicisation of the Scottish Gaelic name Eòghann "noble born" and therefore derived ultimately from Latin Eugenius. A Pictish name, Uuen meaning " warrior", or "born of the mountain", may instead be the source.

ewen.meaning_en: Ewen is a male given name, most common throughout Scotland as well as Canada, due to the immigration of Scottish people. It is an anglicisation of the Scottish Gaelic name, Eòghann.
ewen.meaning_fr: Ewen est un prénom breton de la région Bretagne. D'origine étymologique incertaine, il est souvent apparenté au prénom Erwan.

eytan.meaning_en: Ethan or Eytan is a male given name of Hebrew origin that means "firm, enduring, strong and long-lived". The name Ethan appears eight times in the Hebrew Bible.

ezel.meaning_en: Ezel is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Ezel Akay, Turkish film actor, director and producer Ezel Bayraktar, fictional character protagonist of the Turkish TV series Ezel Ezel Kural Shaw, Turkish American writer, wife of historian Stanford J. Shaw

ezequiel.meaning_en: Ezequiel is a given name, the Spanish version of Ezekiel. Notable people with the name include:

fabian.meaning_en: Fabian is the English form of the late Roman name Fabianus. This was a name originally given to those adopted into or descended through the female line from a Roman family named Fabius, that derived from the Latin faba for the broad bean, an important food crop in antiquity.

fabiana.meaning_en: Fabiana is a feminine given name of Latin origin meaning "bean grower". It is a feminine version of the name Fabian.

fabien.meaning_fr: Fabien est un prénom masculin d'origine latine - se référant à la gens Fabia. La Saint-Fabien a lieu le 20 janvier.

fabienne.meaning_en: Fabienne is a feminine French and English given name.

fabio.meaning_en: Fabio [ˈfaːbjo] is a given name descended from Latin Fabius and very popular in Italy and Latin America. The name is written without an accent in Italian and Spanish, but is usually accented in Portuguese as Fábio.

fabiola.meaning_fr: Venant du latin "faber" qui veut dire artisan, Fabiola est un prénom féminin fêté le 27 décembre. Il a pour forme dérivée Fabia. Il a été entre autres porté par : Doña Fabiola de Mora y Aragón, noble espagnole, devenue par son mariage reine, puis reine douairière, de Belgique.

fabrice.meaning_en: Fabrice is a French masculine given name from the Roman name Fabricius, which is itself derived from the Latin faber meaning blacksmith or craftsman.

fadila.meaning_fr: Fadila, ou Fadela ou Fadilah est un prénom féminin d’origine arabe.

fadwa.meaning_en: Fadwa is an Arabic feminine name.

fahim.meaning_en: Faheem, also spelled Fahiem, Fahim or Fehim is a masculine given name of Cypriot Arabic origin, also used as a surname, meaning 'perceptive', 'understanding', 'keen', or 'intelligent', derived from the root word f-h-m, found in Quran 21:79. The name may refer to:

famous.name: King Faisal bin Abdulaziz Al Saud

faith.meaning_en: Faith is an English feminine given name derived from the word faith. It became popularized when the Puritans began using it as a virtue name during the 17th century.

faiz.meaning_en: Faizin is a male Arabic name meaning overflowing, plenty.

faizan.meaning_en: Faizan, also spelt Faizan, Faydhan, Faizon, Faidhan, Faizaan, and Fayzan, a variant of Faiz, is a male given name and a surname. It has been variously translated as meaning "successful", "beneficence", "ruler", "benefit" and "generosity".

fallon.meaning_en: Fallon is a given name of the following people: Fallon Bowman, South African born Canadian musician Fallon Fox, American mixed martial arts fighter Fallon Kelly, United States Attorney Fallon King, American singer and member of Cherish Fallon Sherrock, English darts player Fallon Taylor, American barrel racer

fanchon.meaning_fr: Fanchon est le personnage principal de Fanchon la vielleuse, comédie en trois actes de Jean-Nicolas Bouilly et Joseph-Marie Pain. Cette pièce de théâtre a été représentée la première fois le 16 janvier 1803.

fancy.meaning_en: Fancy is a given name in occasional use in the Anglosphere. It is derived from the English vocabulary word fancy, a shortened version of the word fantasy. The word is also used in reference to an unusual, novel idea.

fannie.meaning_en: Fannie is a given name. Notable people with the name include:

fanny.meaning_en: Fanny is a feminine given name. It originated as a diminutive of the English given name Frances or the French Françoise, both meaning "free one", and of the Spanish name "Estefanía" and the French name Stéphanie, both meaning "crown".

faouzi.meaning_en: Fawzi, Faouzi, Fawzy or Fevzi is an Arabic name and surname meaning "triumph". Notable people with the name include:

farhaan.meaning_en: Farhan or Farhaan is an Arabic masculine given name which means "happy, joyful, blessed, delightful, rejoicing, merry, inclined to hopefulness". The name is the male variant from the female stem given name Farah, and is widely used in West Asia, North Africa and South Asia.

farhana.meaning_en: Farhana is a given name and a surname.

farid.meaning_en: Farid, also spelt Fareed or Ferid and accented Férid, is an Arabic masculine personal name or surname meaning "unique, one-of-a-kind, incomparable".

farida.meaning_en: Farida is one of the common female names throughout West Asian culture. In Turkish it is spelled as Feride. In Persian, the name is rendered as Farideh in the Iranian dialect, but Farida in the Afghan and Tajik dialects.

faride.meaning_en: Faride is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Faride Alidou, German footballer Faride Mereb, Venezuelan editor and graphic designer Faride Raful, Dominican Republic lawyer

faris.meaning_en: Faris is an Arabic masculine given name and surname. In Arabic, Faris translates to "knight." In the Balkans, Faris is popular among Bosniaks in the former Yugoslav nations. It is similar to other popular names in the region, such as Haris and Daris.
faris.meaning_fr: Faris est un nom de famille notamment porté par : Abou Faris, sultan de la dynastie saadienne ; Abu Inan Faris, sultan Mérinide ; Anna Faris, actrice américaine ; Donald Leonard Faris, homme politique provincial canadien ; Mustapha Faris, banquier et homme d'état marocain Muhammed Faris, spationaute syrien ; Sean Faris, acteur américain ; Valerie Faris, réalisatrice, productrice, scénariste et monteuse américaine.

farrah.meaning_en: Farah is an Arabic- and Persian-language feminine given name meaning "joy" in the former and "glory" in the latter.

farzana.meaning_en: Farzaneh, also transliterated as Farzana, Farzona or Farzane, is a Persian given name for girls common in Iran, South Asia, and Central Asia. The masculine equivalent is Farzan. Notable people with these names include:

faten.meaning_en: Faten is a given name of Arabic origin. Notable people with the name include:

fathia.meaning_en: Fathia is a feminine given name of Arabic origin. Notable people with the name include:

fatih.meaning_en: Fatih is a Turkish masculine given name originating from the Arabic Fateh, meaning "conqueror, victor". In Turkish, it's the title of the Ottoman Sultan Mehmed II. Notable people named Fatih include:
fatih.meaning_fr: Fatih est un prénom d’origine arabe qui signifie « victorieux », « conquérant » ou « celui qui a ouvert ».

fatima.meaning_en: Fatima, also spelled Fatimah, is a female given name of Arabic origin used throughout the Muslim world. Several relatives of the Islamic prophet Muhammad had the name, including, most famously, his daughter Fatimah bint Muhammad.

fatimah.meaning_en: Fatima, also spelled Fatimah, is a female given name of Arabic origin used throughout the Muslim world. Several relatives of the Islamic prophet Muhammad had the name, including, most famously, his daughter Fatimah bint Muhammad.

fatimata.meaning_fr: Fatimata est un prénom féminin qui vient d'Afrique de l'Ouest, équivalent de l'arabe Fatima, prénom de la dernière fille de Mahomet et Khadija. Son raccourci fréquent est Fatou et Fati . Une autre variante en est Fatoumata.

fatma.meaning_en: Fatima, also spelled Fatimah, is a female given name of Arabic origin used throughout the Muslim world. Several relatives of the Islamic prophet Muhammad had the name, including, most famously, his daughter Fatimah bint Muhammad.

fatou.meaning_fr: Fatou est un prénom féminin d'Afrique subsaharienne, raccourci fréquent de Fatoumata ou Fatimata. Il est l'équivalent de l'arabe Fatima, prénom de la dernière fille de Mahomet et Khadija.

fatoumata.meaning_en: Fatoumata is a West African feminine given name.
fatoumata.meaning_fr: Fatoumata est un prénom féminin et un ancien prénom arabe d'Afrique subsaharienne, équivalent de l'arabe Fatima, prénom de la dernière fille de Mahomet et Khadija. Son diminutif courant est Fatou.

faustine.meaning_fr: Faustine ou Faustina est un nom propre d'origine latine qui peut référer à :

fawaz.meaning_en: Fawaz is a masculine Arabic given name and a surname. Its literal meaning is "winner", as it is the masculine adjective from the verb فاز fāz, meaning "he won". Therefore, it can be thought of as the equivalent to the given name Victor.

fawn.meaning_en: Fawn is a feminine given name derived from the English name for a juvenile deer and the color. "Fawn" is also an English word meaning "to court favor from" or "to show affection." Fawne is a spelling variant. Fawna and Fawnia are other variants of the name.

faye.meaning_en: Faye is a given name in various cultures. In the West, the given name is usually feminine. Faye is derived from Middle English "faie", meaning "fairy", or possibly from the Old French word meaning loyalty or belief.

felecia.meaning_en: Felecia is a feminine given name. Notable people with the given name Felecia include: Felecia Angelle, American voice actress Felecia M. Bell, American actress Felecia Lindsey-Howse, member of the American hip-hop collective Mo Thugs Felecia M.

felice.meaning_en: Felice is a unisex given name. It is a common name in Italian, where it is equivalent to Felix. Notable people with the name include:

felicia.meaning_en: The name Felicia derives from the Latin adjective felix, meaning "happy, lucky", though in the neuter plural form felicia it literally means "happy things" and often occurred in the phrase tempora felicia, "happy times".

felicita.meaning_en: Felicita is an Italian female given name. The English counterpart is Felicity.

felicity.meaning_en: Felicity is a feminine given name of English origin meaning "happiness". It is derived from the Latin word felicitas meaning "luck, good fortune". It is also used as a form of the Latin name Felicitas, taken from the name of the Ancient Roman goddess Fortuna.

felipe.meaning_en: Felipe is the Spanish variant of the name Philip, which derives from the Greek adjective Philippos "friend of horses". Felipe is also widely used in Portuguese-speaking Brazil alongside Filipe, the form commonly used in Portugal. Notable people with this name include:

felix.meaning_fr: Félix ou Felix est un nom propre.

felton.meaning_en: Felton is a masculine given name.

feras.meaning_en: Feras and the alternative transliteration Firas is a masculine given name and surname of Arabic origin. Notable people with the name include:

ferdinand.meaning_en: Ferdinand is a Germanic name composed of the elements farð 'journey, travel', Proto-Germanic *farthi, abstract noun from root *far- 'to fare, travel', and nanth 'courage' or nand 'ready, prepared' related to Old High German nendan 'to risk, venture'.

fergus.meaning_en: Fergus or Feargus is a common and one of the oldest known Irish or Scottish male given name derived from Old Irish, meaning "the strong" or "the masculine". As a surname, Ferguson or Fergusson is common across Scotland but particularly in Perthshire and Ayrshire.

fernanda.meaning_en: Fernanda is a Portuguese, Spanish and Italian feminine equivalent of Fernando, a male given name of Germanic origin, with an original meaning of "adventurous, bold journey".

fernando.meaning_en: Fernando is a Spanish and Portuguese given name and a surname common in Spain, Portugal and former Spanish or Portuguese colonies in Latin America, Africa and Asia. It is the most used surname in Sri Lanka. Fernando is a common surname among the Tamil speaking Paravars.

fethi.meaning_en: Fethi is the Turkish spelling of the Arabic name Fathi which means "victorious, triumphant". Notable people with the name include:

ffion.meaning_en: Ffion [ˈfiː.ɔn] is a Welsh feminine given name meaning foxglove.

fidel.meaning_en: Fidel is a given name from the Latin "Fidelis" meaning "faithful." The feminine derivative is Fidelia.

fidelia.meaning_en: Fidelia is a feminine given name derived from the Latin fidelis, meaning faithful. It was in use by the Puritans as a virtue name and was particularly well used in various forms in the 19th century.

famous.name: Emanuele Filiberto I, Duke of Savoy
Prince Emanuele Filiberto, 2nd Duke of Aosta

filip.meaning_en: Filip is a masculine given name and a surname, cognate to Philip. The male name Filip comes from the Greek "philos" and "hippos", which means "horse lover". In Croatia, the name Filip was among the most common masculine given names in the 2000s.

filipe.meaning_en: Filipe is a common first name in Portuguese-speaking countries. It is a Portuguese and Galician spelling of the name Philip.

filiz.meaning_en: Filiz is a common feminine Turkish given name. In Turkish, "Filiz" means "Sprout", "Blossom" and/or "to Flower"; derived from the Greek word "fillís".

famous.name: Princess Maria Annunziata of Bourbon-Two Sicilies

filomena.meaning_en: Filomena is a form of the Greek female given name Philomena. It means "friend of strength" or "loved one". Filomena is the name of one of the storytellers in the frame story of The Decameron.

finn.meaning_en: Finn is a masculine given name. The name has several origins. In some cases it is derived from the Old Norse personal name and byname Finnr, meaning "Sámi" or "Finn". In some cases the Old Norse name was a short form of other names composed with this element.

fiona.meaning_en: Fiona is a feminine given name of Gaelic origins. It means white or fair, while the Irish name Fíona means 'of wine', being the genitive of fíon 'wine'. It was first used by the Scottish writer James Macpherson in his Ossianic poems.

fionn.meaning_en: Fionn is a masculine given name in Irish and Scottish Gaelic. In English, it is It is derived from a byname meaning "white" or "fair-haired". It is the original version of a name later anglicized as Find and Finn. It may refer to:

fionna.meaning_en: Fiona is a feminine given name of Gaelic origins. It means white or fair, while the Irish name Fíona means 'of wine', being the genitive of fíon 'wine'. It was first used by the Scottish writer James Macpherson in his Ossianic poems.

fiorella.meaning_en: Fiorella is an Italian female given name.

flavia.meaning_en: Flavia is a feminine given name of Latin origin. The name is most commonly used in Italy, Romania, Brazil (Portuguese and in Spanish-speaking countries. It is in occasional use in the United States, where 18 newborn girls were given the name in 2022.

flavie.meaning_en: Flavia is a feminine given name of Latin origin. The name is most commonly used in Italy, Romania, Brazil (Portuguese and in Spanish-speaking countries. It is in occasional use in the United States, where 18 newborn girls were given the name in 2022.

flavio.meaning_en: Flavio is an Italian, Spanish and Portuguese masculine given name, equivalent to Flavius in Latin, Flavi in Catalan, and Flávio in Portuguese.

fleur.meaning_en: Fleur is a feminine given name originated in France, eventually used in English speaking countries and other languages. It means "flower" in French.
fleur.meaning_fr: Fleur est un prénom français, mais peu courant en France, où on lui préfère les formes plus latines Flore et Flora, ou leur dérivé Florence. Mais le prénom est donné en anglais et néerlandais.

flora.meaning_en: Flora is a feminine given name of Latin origin meaning flower, ultimately derived from the Latin word flos, which had the genitive floris. Flora was a fertility goddess of flowers and springtime in Ancient Rome.

flore.meaning_en: Flore is a feminine given name.

florence.meaning_en: Florence is usually a feminine given name. It is derived from the French version of Florentia, a Roman martyr under Diocletian.
florence.meaning_fr: Florence est un prénom féminin ayant une étymologie latine Florentia, nom de femme, lui-même féminin de Florentius, nom d'homme, provenant de florens signifiant en fleur au sens propre et heureux au sens figuré. Il est principalement fêté le 1er décembre.

florencia.meaning_en: Florencia is a female given name of Latin origin, Florentia meaning flowering. It is very popular in Argentina, but also in the Hispanophone.

florent.meaning_en: Florent is a French version of the Latin personal name Florentius. It is also used as a surname.
florent.meaning_fr: Florent [floʁɑ̃] est un prénom français masculin issu du surnom romain masculin Flōrens. Cette origine latine a permis la diffusion de nombreuses variantes et formes féminines dans la plupart des langues européennes.

florentino.meaning_en: Florentino is both a masculine given name and a surname. Notable people with the name include:

florian.meaning_en: Florian is a masculine given name borrowed from the ancient Roman name Florianus. The name is derived from Florus, from Latin flōrus, related to flāvus. Saint Florian is a patron saint of Poland and Upper Austria.
florian.meaning_fr: Florian [floʁjɑ̃] est un prénom masculin dérivé du surnom romain Flōrens, signifiant « florissant » ou « prospère ». Ce prénom trouve son origine dans le latin Florianus, une déclinaison de florus.

floriane.meaning_fr: Floriane est un prénom féminin signifiant « Floraison ». Il vient du latin florianus.

florie.meaning_fr: Florie est un prénom féminin qui vient du latin Flora, nom de déesse et de femme, qui signifie « fleur ».

florimond.meaning_fr: Florimond est un prénom français fêté le 27 avril. Il a été remis sur le devant de la scène en 1983, avec la sortie du film L'Été meurtrier, Alain Souchon y jouant un personnage, surnommé « Pin Pon », se prénommant ainsi.

floyd.meaning_en: Floyd is a masculine Anglo-Welsh given name deriving from the Welsh Llwyd and thus cognate with Lloyd.

folasade.meaning_en: Folasade is a given Yoruba name. Notable people with the name include: Folasade Baderinwa, American broadcast journalist known as Sade Baderinwa Folasade Ogunsola, Nigerian microbiologist and professor Helen Folasade Adu, Nigerian-born British singer known as Sade

forrest.meaning_en: Forrest is a masculine given name. Notable persons with the name include: Forrest, born Forrest Thomas, American singer popular in the UK and Netherlands Forrest J.

foster.meaning_en: The given name Foster is a variation of the surname Forster, meaning one who 'works in the forest'. It may also derive from the French forcetier, meaning 'maker of scissors'. It is both a given name and a surname.

fouad.meaning_en: Fuad is a masculine Arabic given name, meaning "heart"—the beating circulating heart, the concept of "mind and spirit". Its root word is the Arabic verb fa’ada, meaning "burning or a flame", and lahmun fa'eed, meaning a "roasted meat on a fire".

foued.meaning_en: Fuad is a masculine Arabic given name, meaning "heart"—the beating circulating heart, the concept of "mind and spirit". Its root word is the Arabic verb fa’ada, meaning "burning or a flame", and lahmun fa'eed, meaning a "roasted meat on a fire".

fouzia.meaning_en: Fawzia or Faouzia or Fouzia is an Arabic female name meaning victorious. Notable people named Fawzia or alternative spellings include:

fox.meaning_en: Fox is a unisex, primarily masculine, given name, a transferred use of the English surname meaning “fox.” In some instances, it might have been used as a given name in honor of George Fox, the founder of the Quaker movement.

fran.meaning_en: Fran is a Spanish, Italian, Croatian and Albanian male name or a common short form of the English names Frances and Francis. The Spanish and Italian Fran is more common for men, while the English name is mostly used for women.

france.meaning_en: Joseph is a common male name, derived from the Hebrew Yosef. "Joseph" is used, along with "Josef", mostly in English, French and partially German languages. This spelling is also found as a variant in the languages of the modern-day Nordic countries.
france.meaning_fr: Youssouf, Yousouf, Youssef, Yūsuf, Yusuf et Youcef sont des variantes de la retranscription du prénom arabe يوسف, correspondant à Joseph dans la Bible.

frances.meaning_en: Frances is an English given name or last name of Latin origin. In Latin the meaning of the name Frances is 'from France' or 'the French.' The male version of the name in English is Francis.

francesca.meaning_en: Francesca is an Italian female given name, derived from the Latin male name Franciscus meaning 'the Frenchman' It is widely used in most Romance languages, including Italian, French and Catalan, and place of origin is Italy.

francesco.meaning_en: Francesco, the Italian version of the personal name "Francis", is one of the most common given names among males in Italy. Notable persons with that name include:

franchesca.meaning_en: Franchesca is a feminine given name.

francis.meaning_en: Francis is an English, French, German, Dutch and Scandinavian given name of Latin origin. Francis is a name that has many derivatives in most European languages. A feminine version of the name in English is Frances, or Francine.

francisca.meaning_en: Francisca is a feminine given name, the masculine form being Francisco. It is also related to many other names, such as Frances, Francis, Françoise, and Franz. It originated from the Germanic languages, before changing in form and meaning through Medieval Latin and into Spanish.
francisca.meaning_fr: Francisca est un prénom féminin d'origine latine équivalent du prénom Françoise, utilisé en espagnol et en portugais. On trouve également l'orthographe Franciska en hongrois ainsi que l'orthographe Franziska en allemand et en islandais.

francisco.meaning_en: Francisco is the Spanish and Portuguese form of the masculine given name Franciscus.

francisque.meaning_fr: Francisque est un prénom français masculin et féminin issu du latin Franciscus qui a également donné François, Francisque étant le doublet savant et François le doublet populaire. On retrouve le terme dans francisque, du latin francisca : franque.

franciszek.meaning_en: Franciszek is a masculine given name of Polish origin. It is a cognate of Francis, Francisco, François, and Franz.

franco.meaning_en: Franco is a surname that is common in Italy, Portugal, Spain, and Sephardic Jewish communities deriving from the word "Frank", in reference to the Germanic tribe of the Franks, who invaded Gaul during the Migration Period. It is also commonly used as a given name in Italian.

francois.meaning_en: François is a French masculine given name and surname, equivalent to the English name Francis.
francois.meaning_fr: François est un prénom français masculin et une forme ancienne du mot Français, dont il partage l'origine latine et germanique. Le passage du gentilé au nom de baptême est historiquement lié à la canonisation de Francesco Bernardone, en 1228.

frank.meaning_en: Frank is a masculine given name. While Frank has been a European name in its own right, the given name in the English-speaking United States arose in the 20th century as a short form of the traditional common English variant Francis.

franklin.meaning_en: Franklin is a masculine English given name. It is of English coming from the medieval English Frankeleyn, coming from the Anglo-Norman fraunclein. Its meaning is landowner of free but not noble origin.
franklin.meaning_fr: Pour l'ensemble des articles sur les personnes portant ce prénom, consulter : la liste des articles dont le titre commence par ce prénom les listes produites par Wikidata : Liste des personnes de prénom « Franklin » — même liste en incluant les éventuels prénoms composés qui contiennent « Franklin ».

frantz.meaning_en: Frantz is a masculine given name.

franz.meaning_en: Franz is a German name and cognate of the given name Francis. Notable people named Franz include:

francois-xavier.meaning_en: François-Xavier is a French masculine given name.
francois-xavier.meaning_fr: François-Xavier est un prénom masculin composé des prénoms François et Xavier. Au XXe siècle, il atteindra son pic de popularité dans les années 1970 et 1980.

francoise.meaning_fr: Françoise est un prénom féminin français. Il est fêté le 9 mars.

freda.meaning_en: Frida is a feminine given name. In central and eastern Europe, Frida is a short form of compound names containing the Germanic element fried meaning "peace".

freddy.meaning_en: Freddy is a unisex given name. It is often used by both men and women whose names contain the Germanic element -fred, such as Frederick, Frederica, and Alfred.

frederic.meaning_fr: Frédéric est un prénom d'origine germanique, existant dans de nombreuses langues. Il a notamment été porté par de nombreux souverain allemands et scandinaves, ainsi que par des ducs de Lorraine.

frederica.meaning_en: Frederica is a feminine given name meaning "peaceful ruler". It is closely related to the masculine name Frederick, of Germanic origin. Its meaning is derived from the Germanic word elements frid, or peace, and ric, meaning "ruler" or "power".
frederica.meaning_fr: Frederica est un prénom féminin signifiant monarque pacifique par les mots allemands frid et ric.

famous.name: George IV of the United Kingdom

frederick.meaning_en: Frederick is a male given name meaning "peace king" or "peaceful ruler". It is the English form of the German name Friedrich. Its meaning is derived from the Germanic word elements frid, or peace, and ric, meaning "king", "ruler", or "power".
frederick.meaning_fr: Frederick est un prénom masculin anglais et provenant du prénom allemand Friedrich. Frederick provient de l'allemand frid et ric.

frederico.meaning_en: Frederico is a male given name. It is a form of Frederick, most commonly found in Portuguese.
frederico.meaning_fr: Frederico est un prénom masculin portugais.

fredric.meaning_fr: Fredric est un prénom masculin anglais, norvégien et suédois.

fredrick.meaning_en: Frederick is a male given name meaning "peace king" or "peaceful ruler". It is the English form of the German name Friedrich. Its meaning is derived from the Germanic word elements frid, or peace, and ric, meaning "king", "ruler", or "power".
fredrick.meaning_fr: Fredrick est un prénom masculin anglais.

famous.name: Prince Gustaf Adolf, Duke of Västerbotten

fredrik.meaning_en: Fredrik or Frederik is a masculine Germanic given name derived from the German name Friedrich or Friederich, from the Old High German fridu meaning "peace" and rîhhi meaning "ruler" or "power". It is the common form of Frederick in Norway, Finland and Sweden.
fredrik.meaning_fr: Fredrik est un prénom masculin allemand dérivé de Friedrich ou Friederich et issu du vieux allemand fridu et rîhhi.

freeman.meaning_en: Freeman is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Freeman Asmundson Canadian ice hockey player Freeman Barr, Bahamian boxers Freeman Bosley Jr., American politician Freeman W.

freya.meaning_en: Freya or Freyja is an Old Norse feminine given name derived from the name of the Old Norse word for noble lady. The theonym of the goddess Freyja is thus considered to have been an epithet in origin, replacing a personal name that is now unattested.

friedrich.meaning_en: Friedrich is a German male given name and the origin of the English Frederick. People with the name include:

fritz.meaning_en: Fritz is a common German male given name and also a surname. The name originated as a German diminutive of Friedrich or Frederick, as well as of similar names including Fridolin and, less commonly, Francis.

frederique.meaning_en: Frederique is a French female given name, which is equivalent to the male name Frederick, meaning "peaceful ruler". Alternative spellings include Frédérique and Frederieke. The name Frederique may refer to:
frederique.meaning_fr: Frédérique est un prénom français, forme féminisée de Frédéric, parfois utilisé comme variante orthographique de Frédéric.

fuad.meaning_en: Fuad is a masculine Arabic given name, meaning "heart"—the beating circulating heart, the concept of "mind and spirit". Its root word is the Arabic verb fa’ada, meaning "burning or a flame", and lahmun fa'eed, meaning a "roasted meat on a fire".

fumiko.meaning_en: Fumiko is a feminine Japanese given name.

felicie.meaning_en: Félicie is a feminine given name of French origin.
felicie.meaning_fr: Félicie est un prénom féminin dérivé du latin felix. C'est l'équivalent féminin du prénom Félix.

famous.name: Honoré Gabriel Riqueti, comte de Mirabeau

gabriel.meaning_en: Gabriel is a given name derived from the Hebrew name Gaḇrīʾēl meaning "God's man".

gabriela.meaning_en: Gabriela is the Portuguese, Spanish, Czech, Slovak, Romanian, Latvian, Polish and Bulgarian feminine form of the Hebrew name Gabriel.

famous.name: Gabriel of Our Lady of Sorrows
famous.occupation: member of Roman Catholic religious orders and societies

gabriella.meaning_en: Gabriella is a feminine given name used in various languages. Its English spelling originates as an Italian feminine given name from the Hebrew name Gabriel. Girls who are named Gabriella often take on a shorter version of the name, such as Bella, Ella, Gab, Gabby, and Gabbi.

gabrielle.meaning_en: Gabrielle is the French feminine form of the given name Gabriel which translates to "God is my strong man".
gabrielle.meaning_fr: Gabrielle est un prénom féminin. Il signifie « force de Dieu » en hébraïque. Son équivalent masculin est Gabriel.

gaby.meaning_fr: Gaby est un prénom épicène, diminutif de Gabriel ou de Gabrielle, souvent utilisé comme pseudonyme. C'est aussi un nom de famille et un nom de lieu.

gadiel.meaning_en: Gadiel is both a given name and a surname. Notable people with the name include: An archangel in Jewish and Christian mysticism. Known as an angel of holiness and love.

gael.meaning_en: Gaël is a Breton given name. Its etymology is uncertain, it may be related to the ethnonym Gael; alternatively, it may be a variant of the name Gwenhael.
gael.meaning_fr: Gaël — avec un tréma sur la lettre e — est l’écriture francisée du prénom masculin breton Gael. Présent en Irlande et en Écosse à partir du VIe siècle av. J.-C. et connus sous le nom de Gaels, aussi couramment appelés Celtes.

gaetano.meaning_en: Gaetano is an Italian masculine given name. It is derived from the Latin Caietanus, meaning "from Caieta".

gaia.meaning_fr: Gaïa est un prénom épicène d'origine grecque.

gail.meaning_en: Gail is a masculine and feminine given name. As a feminine name, it can be a short form of the name Abigail. Gail has been used as a masculine and feminine name, and until the 1930s, was equally common on both sexes.

gaius.meaning_en: Gaius, sometimes spelled Caius, was a common Latin praenomen; see Gaius.

gale.meaning_en: Gale is a given name. It has seen masculine and feminine use consecutively in the United States. Gale as a man's name is from an English surname, ultimately from Middle English gaile "jovial". As a woman's name, it is often a short form of the name Abigail.

galen.meaning_en: Galen is an almost exclusively masculine given name. The best-known Galen was a Greek physician, surgeon and philosopher in Ancient Rome. Other Galens include:

gamze.meaning_en: Gamze is a female Turkish given name. It derived from the Arabic word, ġamza, meaning winking but common female name in Turkey. In Turkish, it denotes the dimple on someone's cheek when he or she smiles. It's considered as a feature of beauty. People named Gamze include:

gardner.meaning_en: Gardner is a male given name derived from the surname Gardner.

gareth.meaning_en: Gareth is a Welsh masculine given name. The name's popularity in Wales may be as a hypocorism of Geraint, which itself became popular after the famous hero and king of Dumnonia.

garret.meaning_en: Garret is a given name. It is an alternate spelling of Garrett.

garrett.meaning_en: Garrett is a surname and given name of Germanic and of Old French origins. It is one of the many baptismal surnames to have been derived from the popular given names of Gerardus, Gerard and Gerald in 12th-century England.

garth.meaning_en: A garth is an enclosed quadrangle or yard, especially one surrounded by a cloister. This led to the word being given as a last name to people who worked in or near a garden. Later it came to be used as a first name.

gary.meaning_en: Gary and Garry are English language masculine given names.

famous.name: Gaspar de Guzmán, Count-Duke of Olivares

gaspar.meaning_en: Gaspar is a given and/or surname of French, German, Portuguese, and Spanish origin, cognate to Casper or Casper. It is a name of christian origin, per Saint Gaspar, one of the three wise men mentioned in the Armenian Infancy Gospel. Notable people with the name include:

gaspard.meaning_fr: Gaspard est un prénom masculin utilisé en français. La forme « Gaspar » existe en espagnol, on trouve aussi la forme « Caspar » et des variantes dans d'autres langues.

gaurav.meaning_en: Gaurav is an Indian and Nepalese male name. The name literally means 'honor', 'pride' or 'respect'.

gauri.meaning_en: Gauri is a given name of India. It is derived from the Sanskrit गौरी, which is used as an epithet of the goddess Parvati, especially in the Mahagauri manifestation.

gautam.meaning_en: Gautama, also spelled Gautam, Goutam, Gautham, Gowtham, and Gotam is a given name and surname of Sanskrit origin. It means "relative of Gotama". Goutam is the usual Bengali transcription of the name.

gauvain.meaning_en: Gauvain is both a French masculine given name and a surname. Notable people with the name include:
gauvain.meaning_fr: Gauvain est un prénom masculin français, transcription du prénom gallois Gwalchmei ou Gwalchmai.

gavin.meaning_en: Gavin is a Celtic male given name. It is the Scottish variation of the medieval Welsh name Gawain, meaning 'God send' or 'white hawk/falcon'. Sir Gawain is a knight of King Arthur's Round Table.

gavino.meaning_en: Gavino is both a surname and a male given name. It is common in Sardinia, Italy, due to being the Italianised form of the Sardinian language personal name Gavinu or Baingiu.

gavyn.meaning_en: Gavyn is a masculine given name and a variant spelling of Gavin.

gay.meaning_en: Gay is a male or female given name, the 795th and 1295th most common female name in the United States, according to the 1990 U.S. census. It can also be used as a short form of the female names Gaynell and Gaynor and as a short form of the male name Gaylord.
gay.meaning_fr: Gay est un prénom épicène, c'est-à-dire féminin ou masculin. Il est aussi un surnom anglo-saxon.

gayle.meaning_en: Gayle is a variant spelling of Gail, a short form of the name Abigail. Abigail is a feminine English name with Hebrew origins, meaning "my father is joy." In the Old Testament Abigail was King David's third wife, described as 'good in discretion and beautiful in form'.

gaylord.meaning_en: Gaylord is a given name of Norman French origin, transferred from the surname, ultimately from the Old French gaillard meaning "joyful" or "high-spirited". Notable people with the given name include:

gaelle.meaning_en: Gaël is a Breton given name. Its etymology is uncertain, it may be related to the ethnonym Gael; alternatively, it may be a variant of the name Gwenhael.

gemma.meaning_en: Gemma is an Italian female name, of Latin origin, meaning "bud" or "precious stone". The name has been amongst the most popular in England and Scotland during the 1980s.

gene.meaning_en: Gene is a unisex given name. It is often a short form of Eugene or Genevieve. Notable people with the name include:

geno.meaning_en: Geno is a masculine given name, usually of Italian origin. It is occasionally a short form of Eugene and other names.

geoffrey.meaning_en: Geoffrey is an English masculine given name. It is generally considered the Anglo-Norman form of the Germanic compound *gudą 'god' and *friþuz 'peace'. It is a derivative of Dutch Godfried, German Gottfried and Old English Gotfrith and Godfrith.

george.meaning_en: George is a male given name derived from the Greek name Georgios. It may have been a theophoric name, with origins in Zeus Georgos, an early title of the Greek god Zeus.

georgeann.meaning_en: Georgeanna is an English female given name. It is a variant of Georgina, which in turn is the feminine form of George. The name Georgeanna has never been particularly popular.

georgeanna.meaning_en: Georgeanna is an English female given name. It is a variant of Georgina, which in turn is the feminine form of George. The name Georgeanna has never been particularly popular.

georgene.meaning_en: Georgene is an English given name and a feminine form of George. It is a variant of the French Georgine.

georges.meaning_en: Georges is a French name with the same origin as the English name George. Notable people with the name include:
georges.meaning_fr: Georges est un prénom masculin d’étymologie grecque.

georgi.meaning_en: Georgy is a Slavic masculine given name, derived from the Greek name Georgios. It corresponds to the English name George.

georgia.meaning_en: Georgia is a feminine given name originating from the Greek word Γεωργία, meaning "agriculture". It shares this origin with the masculine version of the name, George.

georgiana.meaning_en: Georgiana is a Catalan, English, Greek, and Romanian name. It is a variation of the female names Georgina and Georgia. It comes from the Greek word Γεώργιος, meaning "farmer". A variant spelling is Georgianna.

georgianna.meaning_en: Georgiana is a Catalan, English, Greek, and Romanian name. It is a variation of the female names Georgina and Georgia. It comes from the Greek word Γεώργιος, meaning "farmer". A variant spelling is Georgianna.

georgie.meaning_en: Georgie is a unisex given name, often a hypocorism of Georgina, Georgiana, or George. Bearers of the name include:

georgina.meaning_en: Georgina is a given name and the feminine form of George, along with Georgia and Georgiana. It comes from the Greek word γεωργός, meaning "farmer".
georgina.meaning_fr: Georgina est un prénom féminin et un diminutif de Georgia, la forme féminine de Georges.

georgine.meaning_en: Georgine is a feminine given name.

famous.name: Prince George of Greece and Denmark

georgios.meaning_en: Georgios is a Greek male given name derived from the word georgos. The word georgos is a compound of ge and ergon. It is one of the most usual male given names in Greece and Cyprus. The name day is 23 April. The English form of the name is George, the Latinized form is Georgius.

gerald.meaning_en: Gérald is a French male given name, a variant of the old Géraud and more common Gérard, both equivalent to Gerald in English.

geraldine.meaning_en: Geraldine is a feminine form of the first name Gerald.

gerhard.meaning_fr: Gerhard est un prénom germanique, dont l'équivalent français est Gérard.

geri.meaning_en: Geri is a feminine given name and a shorter form of the given name Geraldine. It is also an alternative spelling of the masculine given name Jerry.

german.meaning_en: German is a given name, often the Slavic form of Herman. For the Spanish given name People with the name German include:

gerome.meaning_en: Gerome is an American masculine given name. The spelling Gérôme is also occasionally found for Jérôme in France, both as a surname and first name.

gerrie.meaning_en: Gerrie is a Dutch and Afrikaans unisex given name. It is a diminutive of Ger, itself short for Gerard.

gerrit.meaning_en: Gerrit is a Dutch male name meaning "brave with the spear", the Dutch and Frisian form of Gerard.

gertrude.meaning_en: Gertrude is a feminine given name which is derived from Germanic roots that meant "spear" and "strength". "Trudy", originally a diminutive of "Gertrude", has developed into a name in its own right. In German-speaking countries, Gertraud is a familiar variation of the name.
gertrude.meaning_fr: Cette page contient les pages d'homonymie des prénoms Gertrude et Gertrud. Gertrude est un prénom féminin. Gertrud est son équivalent en anglais, en allemand et dans d'autres langues.

gervais.meaning_en: Gervais, or Gervaise, is an English and French name of Old French origin.

ghaith.meaning_fr: Ghaith ou Ghayt est un prénom arabe dont l'origine remonte avant la période islamique. Ghaith est un prénom d'origine arabe qui signifie "pluie bienfaisante" ou "secours".

ghislain.meaning_en: Masculine Ghislain, Guislain, Gislain or Ghiselin and feminine Ghislaine or Ghyslaine is a French personal name used in countries with French-speaking populations. It originated with a 7th century saint, Saint Ghislain of Hainaut and was Latinized as Gislenus.

ghislaine.meaning_en: Masculine Ghislain, Guislain, Gislain or Ghiselin and feminine Ghislaine or Ghyslaine is a French personal name used in countries with French-speaking populations. It originated with a 7th century saint, Saint Ghislain of Hainaut and was Latinized as Gislenus.

gia.meaning_en: Gia is an English female given name, used as short for the Italian name Gianna, Giada or Georgia.

giacomo.meaning_en: Giacomo is an Italian given name corresponding to English James. It is the Italian version of the Hebrew name Jacob.

giada.meaning_en: Giada is a feminine Italian given name meaning "jade".
giada.meaning_fr: Jade est un prénom donné majoritairement à des filles dans les pays francophones, mais présent chez les deux sexes dans les pays anglophones et arabophones.

gian.meaning_en: Gian is a given name of Italian origin. It is a shortened version of Giovanni, another name of Italian origin.

giancarlo.meaning_en: Giancarlo or Gian Carlo is a masculine double name, composed of the Italian names Giovanni and Carlo. Giancarlo or Gian Carlo is an apocopated and blended form of the name Giovanni Carlo. Giancarlo is the equivalent form of the English double name John Charles.

gianfranco.meaning_en: Gianfranco is a compound Italian given name, consisting of Gian- and Franco. Gian- comes from Giovanni and is used in compound names. It is closest to John or French Jean. Gianni means "God is gracious" and Franco means "Free man" or "Frenchman", a contracted form of Francesco.

gianina.meaning_en: Gianina is a feminine given name. Notable people with the name include: Gianina Beleaga, Romanian rower Gianina Ernst, German ski jumper GiaNina Paolantonio, American dancer, singer, choreographer Gianina Șerban, Romanian politician

gianluca.meaning_en: Gianluca is an Italian masculine given name. Its English translation is "John Luke" and it is often a shorter form of "Giovanni Luca".

gianmarco.meaning_en: Gianmarco, also spelled Gian Marco or Giammarco, is an Italian masculine given name. Its English equivalent is "John Mark" and it is short for Giovanni Marco.

gianna.meaning_en: Gianna is a female Italian given name, a diminutive form of Giovanna. In English, it is translated as "Jane", "Jean", "Joan", "Joanne" or "Joanna".

gianni.meaning_en: Gianni is an Italian name, a short form of the Italian Giovanni and a cognate of John, meaning God is gracious. Gianni is the most common diminutive of Giovanni in Italian.

giannis.meaning_en: Yannis, Yiannis, or Giannis is a common Greek given name, a variant of John meaning "God is gracious." In formal Greek the name exists only as Ioannis. Variants include Yannis, Iannis, Yannakis, Yanis, and the rare Yannos, usually found in the Peloponnese and Cyprus.

gifford.meaning_en: Gifford is a masculine given name.

gil.meaning_en: Gil is a masculine given name. In English it is often a diminutive form of Gilbert. Another version of this name is Gill. In Spanish, Gil is the equivalent of English Giles, and as such a common baptismal name honouring Saint Giles. It may refer to:

gila.meaning_en: Gila is a feminine given name which is borne by: Gila Almagor, Israeli actress Gila Finkelstein, Israeli former politician Gila Flam, Israeli musicologist, ethnomusicologist, and a librarian, a researcher of Jewish music Gila Gamliel, Israeli politician Gila Golan, Polish-born actress who immigrated to Israel in the 1950s Gila Goldstein, Israeli actress, singer and transgender rights activist Gila Hanna, Canadian mathematics educator and philosopher of mathematics Gila Katsav, Israel's first lady Gila Martow, Canadian politician Gila von Weitershausen, German actress

famous.name: Gilbert du Motier, Marquis de Lafayette

gilbert.meaning_en: Gilbert is a given name of Norman-French origin, itself from Germanic Gisilberht or Gisalberht. Original spellings included Gislebert, Guilbert and Gilebert.

gilberte.meaning_en: Gilberte is a name of French-Norman origin. It is the feminine version of the name Gilbert.

gilberto.meaning_en: Gilberto is the Iberian and Italian version of the originally Norman-French given name Gilbert, used in Italian, Portuguese and Spanish languages. In Galician, it's spelled Xilberto or Xilberte. Gilbert is ultimately derived from the Germanic words gisel and beraht.

giles.meaning_en: Giles or Gyles is a masculine given name. It is the Medieval English form of the name of the French hermit Saint Giles, which itself is the Old French form of the Latin name Aegidius. The modern French forms are Gilles and the less common Égide.

gilles.meaning_en: Gilles is a French masculine given name. It is derived from that of the medieval Saint Giles. People with the name Gilles include:

gillis.meaning_en: Gillis is a masculine given name.

gina.meaning_en: Gina is a feminine given name, in origin a hypocoristic form of names ending in -gina, such as Luigina, Regina or Georgina, also of Virginia or Eugenia. The short form was popularized in the 1950s by the actress Gina Lollobrigida, whose birth name is Luigina.
gina.meaning_fr: Gina est un prénom féminin, forme hypocoristique de prénoms se terminant par -gina tels que Luigina, Regina ou Georgina. Il est notamment porté par l'actrice italienne Gina Lollobrigida, née en 1927, dont le prénom de naissance est Luigia.

ginnie.meaning_en: Ginny or Ginnie is an English feminine given name or diminutive, frequently of the name Virginia. It may also serve be the diminutive form of Jennifer, Genevieve, Ginevra, or Geneva. "Ginny" is also a slang term for the U.S.

ginny.meaning_en: Ginny or Ginnie is an English feminine given name or diminutive, frequently of the name Virginia. It may also serve be the diminutive form of Jennifer, Genevieve, Ginevra, or Geneva. "Ginny" is also a slang term for the U.S.

gino.meaning_en: Gino is a name of Italian origin. It may also be the short form of other Italian names like Ambrogino or Luigino or Eugenio, which are from the Ancient Greek name Ambrosios, which means "ever-living", and/or Eugenios, which means "well-born, noble".

giorgia.meaning_en: Giorgia is the Italian version of the female name Georgia. Notable people with the name include:

giorgio.meaning_en: Giorgio is a male Italian given name derived from the Greek Georgios and sometimes a surname. It is equivalent to the English name George. Notable people with the name include:

giovana.meaning_en: Giovanna is an Italian feminine first name. It is the feminine form of the masculine Giovanni, which is the Italian equivalent of John. As such, Giovanna corresponds to names like Joan, etc.

giovanna.meaning_en: Giovanna is an Italian feminine first name. It is the feminine form of the masculine Giovanni, which is the Italian equivalent of John. As such, Giovanna corresponds to names like Joan, etc.

giovanni.meaning_en: Giovanni is a male Italian given name. It is the Italian equivalent of the English name John. Giovanni is frequently contracted to Gianni, Gian, or Gio, particularly in the name Gianbattista, and can also be found as a surname.

gisela.meaning_en: Gisela is a female given name of Germanic origin. The name derives from the Old High German word gīsal, "pledge".
gisela.meaning_fr: Gisela est un prénom féminin d'origine germanique. Français: Gisèle, Giselle Espagnol: Gisela, Gicela, Gicelberta Catalan: Gisela Hongrois: Gizella Italien: Gisella Polonais: Gizela Portugais: Gisela

gisele.meaning_en: Gisele or Gisèle is a given name. The name is from Old German gesel meaning to "pledge" and variant of Giselle, Gisela etc. Notable people with the name include:

gisella.meaning_en: Gisella is an Italian variant of the feminine given name Gisela.

giselle.meaning_en: Giselle is a female given name of French origin. It is derived from the Germanic word geisil, "pledge". Variants include Ghislain, Ghislaine, Gisela, Gisele, Gisèle, Gizel and Gizele.

gita.meaning_en: Gita, or Geeta is an Indian feminine given name.

giulia.meaning_en: Giulia is the Italian version of the feminine given name Julia. The corresponding Italian male name is Giulio. People with that name include:

giulian.meaning_en: Giulian is a male given name. Notable people with the name include: Giulian Biancone, French footballer Giulian Ilie, Romanian boxer Giulian Pedone, Swiss motorcycle racer

giuliana.meaning_en: Giuliana is an Italian language given name ultimately derived from the Latin Iuliana, the feminine form of Iulianus. The name is also often thought to be a combination of Julia and Anna.

famous.name: Giuliano de' Medici, Duke of Nemours

giulio.meaning_fr: Giulio est un prénom masculin, l'équivalent italien du prénom français Jules.

giuseppina.meaning_en: Giuseppina is an Italian feminine given name. It is the Italian version of the English name Josephine. It has the alternative form Giuseppa and a number of hypocorisms.

gizella.meaning_fr: Gisèle est un nom propre, essentiellement utilisé comme prénom féminin Issu du germanique Gisila, anthroponyme basé sur un radical gīsal, gisl signifiant « otage », il a entre autres pour variantes Giselle, Gisela et Gisella .

gizem.meaning_en: Gizem is a common feminine Turkish given name. In Turkish, "Gizem" means "Mystery", and/or "Enigma". Pronunciation is "GI-ZEM," with a hard "g" and emphasis on the second syllable.
gizem.meaning_fr: Gizem est un nom féminin turc. En langue turque, « Gizem » signifie « mystère » ou « énigme ».

gladys.meaning_en: Gladys is a female given name from the Welsh name Gwladus or Gwladys, which is of uncertain meaning. It was the name of Gwladys, a Welsh queen who lived in the late 5th century and early 6th century and became a Christian saint.

glen.meaning_en: Glen is a masculine given name.

glenda.meaning_en: Glenda is a feminine given name.
glenda.meaning_fr: Glenda est un prénom féminin anglais et gallois, fêté le 11 septembre.

glenna.meaning_en: Glenna is a feminine given name.

gloria.meaning_en: Gloria is the anglicized form of the Latin feminine given name gloriae, meaning immortal glory; glory, fame, renown, praise, honor. The name, as Maria de Gloria, was in regular use in Spain by 1700, one of a number of Titles of Mary in use for Portuguese and Spanish girls.

godeleine.meaning_fr: Godeleine est un prénom féminin porté essentiellement dans les Hauts-de-France et en Belgique. Il est la forme française du prénom flamand Godelieve. On le rencontre aussi sous les formes Godeliève, Godelaine ou Godelive. Les Godeleine sont fêtées le 6 juillet.

goldie.meaning_en: Goldie is a nickname or given name used in reference to an informal English diminutive word for gold or an English version of the Yiddish name Golda or Golde, also meaning gold. It was often used as a pet name for a girl with blonde hair.

gonzague.meaning_en: Gonzague is a masculine given name. Notable people with the name include: Gonzague de Reynold, Swiss writer and historian Gonzague Truc, French writer Gonzague Vandooren, Belgian footballer Gonzague Saint Bris, French novelist, biographer and journalist
gonzague.meaning_fr: Gonzague est un nom propre issu du patronyme d'une famille princière italienne d'origine vénitienne, les Gonzague, Gonzaga en italien. Gonzague est devenu un prénom en France depuis le XVIIIe siècle. Il est rare de nos jours.

gonzalo.meaning_en: Gonzalo is a Spanish masculine given name of Germanic origin. The name is given for Galician Saint Gonzalo, bishop of Mondoñedo from 1071. It derives from a Gothic name with the first element gunþi-.

goran.meaning_en: Goran is a Slavic male first name, mostly used in south Slavic countries such as Croatia, Serbia, North Macedonia, Montenegro and Bosnia and Herzegovina. Goran is a Slavic, Pre-Christian name, meaning "highlander" or a mountain-man, someone who lives in the mountains.
goran.meaning_fr: Goran est un prénom masculin de plusieurs origines :

gorden.meaning_en: Gorden is an English variant of Gordon.

gordon.meaning_en: Gordon is a masculine given name in the English language. The name is derived from the Scottish surname Gordon. It is uncertain if this surname originated from a place name in Scotland or in France.

grace.meaning_en: Grace is a female name from the Latin gratia. It is often given in reference to the Christian concept of divine grace and used as a virtue name. As one of the theological virtues, Grace was in regular use by English Puritans in the 16th through the 18th centuries.

grady.meaning_en: Grady is a given name of Irish origin, derived from the Irish word gráda, meaning "noble" or "renowned". Notable people with the given name "Grady" include:

grant.meaning_en: Grant is an English given name derived from the French grand meaning 'tall' or 'large'. It was originally a nickname given to those with remarkable size.

grayce.meaning_en: Grayce is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Grayce Hampton, British film and stage actress Grayce Sills, American psychiatric nurse, educator, author, and nurse administrator Grayce Uyehara, Japanese-American social worker and activist

graydon.meaning_en: Graydon is a name. Notable people with the name include:

grayson.meaning_en: Grayson is primarily a masculine given name. Notable people with the name include:
