graziella.meaning_en: Graziella is a feminine given name.

greer.meaning_en: Greer is a unisex given name of Scottish origin. Notable people called Greer include:

gregor.meaning_en: Gregor is a masculine given name.

gregory.meaning_en: The masculine first name Gregory or Grégory derives from the Latin name "Gregorius", which came from the late Greek name "Γρηγόριος" meaning "watchful, alert".. Through folk etymology, the name also became associated with Latin grex meaning "flock" or "herd".

greta.meaning_en: The name Greta is derived from the name Margareta, which comes from the Greek word margarites or "pearl".

gretchen.meaning_en: Gretchen is a female given name of German origin that is most prevalent in the United States. Its popularity increased because a major character in Goethe's Faust has this name.

gretel.meaning_en: Gretel is a German shortening of the given name Margarete, meaning "pearl".

griffin.meaning_en: Griffin is a masculine given name of Welsh origin. The name derives from Griffinus, which is a Latinised version of Griffith which was commonly used in medieval Wales. Griffith is an Anglicized form of Gruffydd, which ultimately derives from the Old Welsh Grippiud.

griselda.meaning_en: Griselda, also spelled Grizelda, is a feminine given name from Germanic sources that is now used in English, Italian, and Spanish as well. According to the 1990 United States Census, the name was 1,066th in popularity among females in the United States.

gregoire.meaning_fr: Grégoire est un prénom masculin français issu du latin Gregorius, lui-même emprunt au grec Γρηγόριος Grêgorios, anthroponyme basé sur le verbe grec grêgoreîn signifiant « veiller » ou « être éveillé ».

guadalupe.meaning_en: Guadalupe is a unisex given name in the Spanish language. The name initially designated the Guadalupe river in the province of Extremadura, Spain.

guenael.meaning_fr: Guénaël ou Gwenaël est un prénom breton masculin .

guido.meaning_en: Guido is a given name. It has been a male first name in Italy, Austria, Germany, Switzerland, Argentina, the Low Countries, Scandinavia, Spain, Portugal and Latin America, as well as other places with migration from those.

guilherme.meaning_en: Guilherme is a Portuguese given name, equivalent to William in English. The feminine form of this name is Guilhermina. Diminutive forms include Guilhermino. Vilma is another female variant of the name.

famous.name: Guillaume V, Grand Duke of Luxembourg

guillaume.meaning_en: Guillaume is the French equivalent of William, which is of old Germanic origin from wille + helm. It is an Oïl form corresponding to Occitan Guilhem and the Catalan form Guillem. People with this given name include:

guillem.meaning_en: Guillem is a Catalan first name, equivalent to William in the English language, which occasionally can appear as a surname. Its origin and pronunciation are the same as its Occitan variant Guilhèm, with a different spelling.
guillem.meaning_fr: Guillem est la forme catalane du prénom Guillaume, déformation du prénom germanique Wilhelm.

guillemette.meaning_fr: Guillemette est un prénom féminin de même origine que Guilhem ou Guillaume. Le prénom féminin peut également se décliner sous la forme Guillaumette et sous d'autres formes telles que Guilhemine et Wilhelmine.

guiseppe.meaning_en: Giuseppe is the Italian form of the given name Joseph, from Latin Iōsēphus from Ancient Greek Ἰωσήφ, from Hebrew יוסף. The feminine form of the name is Giuseppa or Giuseppina. People with the given name include: Note: Some people are listed multiple times, in different sections.

gunnar.meaning_en: Gunnar is a male first name of Nordic origin. Gunder is a nordic variant, Günther is the modern German variant. Notable people with the name Gunnar include:
gunnar.meaning_fr: Gunnar est un prénom masculin scandinave issu du vieux norrois Gunnarr, formé des éléments gunnr « combat, bataille » et herr « armée ». Actuellement, ce prénom se rencontre surtout en Suède et en Norvège.

gus.meaning_en: Gus is a masculine name, often a diminutive for Angus, August, Augustine, Gustave, Constantine, Konstantinos, Augusten, Gustavo, Gusten, Augustus, Aengus, Argus, Fergus, Gustav, Gustafson, Ferguson, and Gussie.
gus.meaning_fr: Gus est un prénom et surnom masculin anglais diminutif de Angus, Auguste, Augustine, Augustin et Augustus, mais aussi d'autres prénoms tel que Angus, Aengus, Fergus, Ghassan, Gustave, Gustav, Gustafson, Gustavo et Gussie.

gustav.meaning_en: Gustav, also spelled Gustaf, is a male given name of Old Swedish origin, used mainly in Scandinavian countries, German-speaking countries, and the Low Countries. The origin of the name is debated.

gustavo.meaning_en: Gustavo is the Latinate form of a Germanic male given name with respective prevalence in Portuguese, Spanish, and Italian. It is derived from Gustav

guy.meaning_en: Guy is a masculine given name derived from an abbreviated version of a Germanic name that began either with witu, meaning wood, or wit, meaning wide. In French, the letter w became gu and the name became Guy, Gui or Guido. In Latin, the name was written as Wido.
guy.meaning_fr: Guy ou Gui est un prénom masculin d'origine germanique et fêté le 12 juin.

gwen.meaning_en: Gwen is a Welsh feminine given name meaning "white, holy".
gwen.meaning_fr: Gwen est un prénom féminin. D'origine galloise, il signifie « blanc, pur, sacré, béni ». Le prénom gallois Gwen et le prénom breton Gwenn ont la même étymologie.

gwenael.meaning_fr: Gwenael est un prénom breton masculin d’étymologie celtique. La forme féminisée Gwenaelle n'existe pas en langue bretonne. C'est un composé issu du breton gwenn « blanc, pur, sacré » cf. prénom Gwen, et hael « généreux ». Hael peut avoir aussi le sens de « noble, magnanime ».

gwendolen.meaning_en: Gwendolen is a feminine given name, in general use only since the 19th century. It has come to be the standard English form of Latin Guendoloena, which was first used by Geoffrey of Monmouth as the name of a legendary British queen in his History of the Kings of Britain.

gwendoline.meaning_en: Gwendoline is a feminine given name, a variant of Gwendolen.

gwendolyn.meaning_en: Gwendolyn is a feminine given name, a variant spelling of Gwendolen. This has been the most popular spelling in the United States.

gweneth.meaning_en: Gwyneth is a Welsh feminine given name which derives from the kingdom of Gwynedd. It gained popularity, first in Wales and then across the English speaking world, in the 19th century.

gwenn.meaning_fr: Gwenn est un prénom épicène. En breton, c'est un prénom féminin, avec pour variante masculine Gwen. En gallo il est seulement féminin.

gwenola.meaning_fr: Gwenola est un prénom d'origine celtique. Étymologie celtique : De gwenn, blanc.

gwyneth.meaning_en: Gwyneth is a Welsh feminine given name which derives from the kingdom of Gwynedd. It gained popularity, first in Wales and then across the English speaking world, in the 19th century.
gwyneth.meaning_fr: Gwynneth ou Gwyneth, ainsi que les variantes : Gwynyth , Gwynetth, Gweneth ou Guyneth, est un prénom féminin d'origine galloise ; il dérive du nom du royaume de Gwinned, l'un des principaux royaumes du pays de Galles au Moyen Âge, et signifie « blanc, pur, sacré ».

habib.meaning_en: Habib is an Arabic masculine given name, occasional surname, and honorific, with the meaning "beloved" or "my love", or "darling". It also forms the famous Arabic word "Habibi" which is used to refer to a friend or a significant other in the aspect of love or admiration.
habib.meaning_fr: Habib est un nom propre en syriaque et en arabe qui peut désigner :

haddon.meaning_en: Haddon is a masculine given name.

hadrien.meaning_en: Hadrien is a French masculine given name.

hafsa.meaning_en: Hafsa or Hafsah (Arabic: حفصة is an Arabic female given name. It originated from Hafsa, the fourth wife of the Islamic prophet Muhammad and daughter of second Muslim caliph Umar. It is a popular name among Sunni Muslims.
hafsa.meaning_fr: Hafsa est un prénom féminin arabe . Signification: Petite lionne.

hagen.meaning_en: Hagen is a masculine given name.

haidar.meaning_en: Haydar, also spelt Hajdar, Hayder, Haidar, Heidar, Haider, Heydar, Hyder, and other variants, is an Arabic male given name, also used as a surname, and means an epithet for "lion".

hailey.meaning_en: Hayley is an English given name. It is derived from the English surname Haley, which in turn was based on an Old English toponym, a compound of heg "hay" and leah "clearing or meadow". While it can be used for males, Hayley is most commonly a female given name.

hailie.meaning_en: Hailie is a feminine given name.

haisley.meaning_en: Haisley is a modern created given name of English origin or a spelling variant and transferred use of the surname or place name Hazley or Hazeleigh or Hazeley, a name which has various origins, among them a place name meaning “enclosure on the hill” or “wet haylands.” The surname might also be derived from the Old English name Haegel in combination with the word “leah” meaning forest clearing.

haitham.meaning_en: Haytham, Haitham or Haitem is an Arabic male name meaning "young hawk" or "young eagle". It is highly popular among Middle Eastern communities and originated in Arab States of the Persian Gulf.

honey.meaning_en: Honey is an English hypocorism, independent given name, and surname meaning “honey”, which has long been used to sweeten foods and is a common English term of endearment. The word is derived from the Old English term hungi.

honor.meaning_en: Honor is a primarily feminine given name derived from the word "honour", taken from a Latin root word honos, honoris. It was a virtue name in use by the Puritans.

famous.name: Honoré Gabriel Riqueti, comte de Mirabeau

honour.meaning_en: Honor is a primarily feminine given name derived from the word "honour", taken from a Latin root word honos, honoris. It was a virtue name in use by the Puritans.

hope.meaning_en: Hope is a given name derived from the Middle English hope, ultimately from the Old English word hopian referring to a positive expectation or to the theological virtue of hope. It was used as a virtue name by the Puritans.

horace.meaning_en: Horace is a masculine given name, derived from the Roman poet Quintus Horatius Flaccus.

horacio.meaning_en: Horacio a masculine given name, is a variant of Horace. The given name Horacio is found sporadically throughout all of Latin America. Horacio is a boy's name with Latin origins said to mean 'timekeeper'. The Portuguese spelling is Horácio. A related name is Horatio.

horatio.meaning_en: Horatio is an English male given name, an Italianized form of the ancient Roman Latin nomen Horatius, from the Roman gens Horatia. The modern Italian form is Orazio, the modern Spanish form Horacio.

horton.meaning_en: Horton is a masculine given name. People or fictional characters named Horton include: Horton Foote, American playwright and screenwriter Horton D. Haight, Mormon pioneer Horton H.

houda.meaning_en: Houda is a given name and a surname of Arabic origin. Notable people with these names include:

howard.meaning_en: Howard is a masculine given name derived from the English surname Howard.

howell.meaning_en: Howell is a surname and given name originating from Wales. It is an anglicised form of the Welsh name Hywel. It originates in a dynasty of kings in Wales and Brittany in the 9th and 10th-centuries, most notably king Hywel Dda and three Welsh royal houses of that time onwards.

howie.meaning_en: Howard is a masculine given name derived from the English surname Howard.

hubert.meaning_en: Hubert is a Germanic masculine given name, from hug "mind" and beraht "bright". It also occurs as a surname. Saint Hubert of Liège is the patron saint of hunters, mathematicians, opticians, and metalworkers.

huda.meaning_en: Huda is a female name in Arabic, sometimes spelled as Houda or Hoda which means "right guidance". Notable people with the name include:

hudson.meaning_en: Hudson is an English masculine given name which originated from the surname Hudson.

hugh.meaning_en: Hugh is the English-language variant of the masculine given name Hugues, itself the Old French variant of Hugo, a short form of Continental Germanic given names beginning in the element *hug- "mind, spirit".

hughes.meaning_en: Hughes is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Hughes Cleaver, Canadian politician Hughes Eng, Canadian community activist Hughes Rudd, American television journalist and news correspondent Hughes Winborne, American film editor

hughie.meaning_en: Hughie is a masculine given name and nickname. People named Hughie include:

hugo.meaning_en: Hugo is a surname and a masculine given name of German origin. The English version of the name is Hugh, the Italian version is Ugo. The name Hugo is actually a short form of old names like Hugbert and Hugbald.

hugues.meaning_en: Hugues is a masculine given name most often found in Francophone countries, a variant of the originally Germanic name "Hugo" or " Hugh". The final 's' marks the nominative case in Old French, but is not retained by modern pronunciation. The old oblique case Hugon disappeared.

huguette.meaning_en: Huguette is a feminine French given name.

hulda.meaning_en: Hulda is a feminine given name derived from חולדה Chuldah or Huldah, a Hebrew word meaning weasel or mole. Huldah was a prophetess in the Old Testament Books of Kings and Chronicles.

huldah.meaning_en: Hulda is a feminine given name derived from חולדה Chuldah or Huldah, a Hebrew word meaning weasel or mole. Huldah was a prophetess in the Old Testament Books of Kings and Chronicles.

humbert.meaning_en: Humbert, Umbert or Humberto is a Germanic given name, from hun "warrior" and beraht "bright". It also came into use as a surname.

humza.meaning_en: Hamza is an Arabic masculine given name in the Muslim world. Meaning strong, and steadfast, it is an Arabic epithet for lion.

hunter.meaning_en: Hunter is an English unisex given name. Notable people with the name include:

famous.name: Hussein bin Abdullah, Crown Prince of Jordan

hussein.meaning_en: Hussein, Hossein, Hussain, Hossain, Huseyn, Hüseyin, Husayn, Husein, Hussin, Hoessein, Houcine, Hocine or Husain, coming from the triconsonantal root ḥ-s-n, is an Arabic name which is the diminutive of Hassan, meaning "good", "handsome" or "beautiful".

huw.meaning_en: Huw is a Welsh given name, a variant of Hugo or Hugh.
huw.meaning_fr: HUW ou huw est un code qui peut désigner : HUW, Aérodrome d'Humaitá au Brésil, selon la liste des codes AITA des aéroports ; huw, le hukumina, selon les normes ISO 639 des codes de langue.

hyacinthe.meaning_en: Hyacinthe is a given name. It is generally a male name. The form Hyacinth may be masculine or feminine.
hyacinthe.meaning_fr: Le prénom Hyacinthe, masculin à l'origine et devenu épicène, est peu usité aujourd'hui. Il a aussi une existence comme prénom révolutionnaire, attribué sous la Terreur.

hyla.meaning_en: Hyla is a given name and surname. Notable people with the name Hyla include: Hyla Bristow Stallard, English runner and ophthalmologist Hyla Willis, American artist Adolf Hyła, Polish artist

helio.meaning_en: Hélio is a Portuguese given name: Hélio, Brazil-born Hong Kong footballer Hélio José de Souza Gonçalves Helio Alves, is a jazz pianist and son of pianists Helio André, Angola footballer Helio Batista, Brazilian footballer Hélio Batista, Brazilian footballer Hélio Bicudo, Brazilian jurist and politician Hélio Ferraz de Almeida Camargo, Brazilian zoologist and lawyer Hélio Castroneves, Brazilian auto racing driver Hélio Cruz, Portuguese footballer Hélio Delmiro, Brazilian guitar player and composer Hélio Dias, Brazilian former football goalkeeper Hélio Garcia, Brazilian lawyer and politician Hélio Gomes, Portuguese athlete Hélio Gonçalves Heleno, Roman Catholic bishop Hélio Gracie, a founder of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Hélio Gueiros, Brazilian politician Hélio José, Brazilian politician Hélio Justino, Brazilian handballer Hélio Fernando Barbosa Lopes, Brazilian politician and military officer Hélio Marques Pereira, Brazilian basketball player Helio Melo, American politician Hélio José Muniz Filho, Brazilian vigilante murderer Hélio Oiticica, Brazilian visual artist, sculptor, painter, performance artist, and theorist Hélio Lourenço de Oliveira, Brazilian physician and academic Helio Pereira, Brazilian footballer Hélio Gelli Pereira, Brazilian-British virologist Hélio Pestana, Portuguese actor and model Hélio Pinto, Portuguese footballer Hélio Quaglia Barbosa, Brazilian judge Helio R.

iain.meaning_en: Ian or Iain is a male name of Scottish Gaelic origin, which is derived from the Hebrew given name יוֹחָנָן‎ and corresponds to the English name John. The spelling Ian is an Anglicization of the Scottish Gaelic forename Iain.

ian.meaning_en: Ian or Iain is a male name of Scottish Gaelic origin, which is derived from the Hebrew given name יוֹחָנָן‎ and corresponds to the English name John. The spelling Ian is an Anglicization of the Scottish Gaelic forename Iain.

ibrahim.meaning_en: Ibrahim is the Arabic name of Abraham, the common Hebrew patriarch of the Abrahamic religions, including Judaism, Christianity, and Islam.
ibrahim.meaning_fr: Ibrahim est un prénom masculin arabe, dérivé du nom Abraham ou Abram, principal patriarche des religions juive, chrétienne et musulmane, nommé Ibrahim dans le Coran.

ibrahima.meaning_en: Ibrahima is a male given name, a form of Ibrahim common in parts of Western Africa. Notable people with the name include: Ibrahima Aya, Malian writer Ibrahima Maiga, Burkinabe, activist and journalist.

ibtisam.meaning_en: Ibtisam Arabic: ابتسام, romanized: ibtisām is an Arabic ism "given name" meaning "smile". Among Arabic speakers, it is considered a woman's name, but among South Asian Muslims, it is also used as a male name. Notable people with the name include:

ibtissam.meaning_en: Ibtissam is a female Arabic name that means "smile". Notable people with the name include:
ibtissam.meaning_fr: Ibtissem ou Ibtissam , est un prénom féminin d'origine arabe qui a pour signification : sourire, joie. Ce prénom, qui est aussi un nom patronymique, est notamment porté par les personnalités suivantes :

ibtissem.meaning_fr: Ibtissem ou aussi Ibtissam , est un prénom féminin d'origine arabe qui a pour signification « sourire » ou « joie ». C'est l'un des prénoms évoquant le sourire.

famous.name: Marie Christine, Princess Michael of Kent

ida.meaning_en: Ida is a feminine given name found in Europe and North America. It is popular in Scandinavian countries, where it is The name has an ancient Germanic etymology, according to which it means ‘industrious’ or ‘prosperous’. It derives from the Germanic root id, meaning "labor, work".

idil.meaning_en: İdil is a feminine Turkish given name and a feminine Somali given name. İdil means “pure and sincere love”. Another meaning the name carries is Volga in Turkic languages, referring to the river in Europe and the name of a district in Turkey.

idrissa.meaning_en: Idrissa is a masculine given name.

ieuan.meaning_en: Ieuan is a masculine Welsh given name – one of several Welsh names derived from Latin Johannes or Ioannes and, therefore, analogous to the English language name John. Other Welsh names derived from Ioannes/Johannes or John include Ioan, Iwan, Iefan, Ifan, Evan, and Sion.

ifan.meaning_en: Ifan is one of several Welsh forms of the male given name Ieuan. Like the English name John, it ultimately derives from the Latin Johannes.

ignace.meaning_en: Ignace is a surname and given name of French origin. It can also be combined with other common given names and surnames. Notable people with the name include:

ignacio.meaning_en: Ignacio is a male Spanish name originating in the Latin name "Ignatius" from ignis "fire". This was the name of several saints, including the third bishop of Antioch and Saint Ignatius of Loyola.

famous.name: Franz Joseph II, Prince of Liechtenstein

ignatius.meaning_en: Ignatius is a male name and a surname, from ignis "fire". Notable people with the name include:

ignazio.meaning_fr: Ignazio est un prénom masculin basque et italien. L'équivalent du prénom est « Ignacio » en espagnol et « Ignace » en français.

igor.meaning_en: Igor is a common East Slavic given name derived from the Norse name Ingvar, that was brought to ancient Rus' by the Norse Varangians, see Igor of Kiev. The name can be translated as warrior under the protection of the god Ing or protector of the gods.

ihsan.meaning_en: Ihsan is an Arabic masculine given name.

ijeoma.meaning_en: Ijeoma is a common Igbo feminine given name. It means "good journey". Similarly, there is the name Ijemma, which means “beautiful journey”, but this is rarely used.

ikenna.meaning_en: Ikenna is a male Igbo given name meaning “the strength of the father”. The “father” here could either be one’s birth parent or God.

iker.meaning_en: Iker is a Basque male given name. The corresponding female name is Ikerne.

ila.meaning_en: Ila is a feminine and masculine given name, with multiple origins.

ilan.meaning_en: Ilan is an Israeli masculine given name and a surname which means "tree" in the Hebrew language. Variants of the name include Alon and Elon. Notable people with the name include:

ilana.meaning_en: Ilana is a feminine given name from Hebrew. In Hebrew, it is the female form of the word ilan, meaning "tree", or of the masculine name Ilan.
ilana.meaning_fr: Ilana est un prénom féminin hébreu, signifiant « arbre ».

ilaria.meaning_en: Ilaria is an Italian female given name, equivalent to the English names Hilary or Hillary. Ilaria is derived from the Latin hilarius meaning "cheerful", from hilaris, "cheerful, merry". Ilaria was the eighth most popular name for Italian baby girls born in 2006.

ilario.meaning_fr: Ilario peut désigner : Ilario Antoniazzi, archevêque de Tunis depuis le 21 février 2013 Ilario Di Buò, archer italien anciennement numéro un Ilario Carposio, artiste photographe qui possède un studio important à Fiume Ilario Casolano, peintre italien de la période Baroque Ugolino di Prete Ilario, peintre italien Ilario Lanivi, homme politique italien impliqué dans la formation de plusieurs partis Ilario Pegorari, skieur alpin

ileana.meaning_en: Ileana is a feminine given name commonly used in Romanian and other Romance language-speaking countries such as Spain and Italy.

ilia.meaning_en: Ilia is a given name and variant of Ilya. Ilia is the name of:

ilias.meaning_en: "Ilias Greek: Ηλίας is the Greek version of the name of the Prophet Elijah. It is also commonly spelled Elias.

ilona.meaning_en: Ilona is a feminine given name used primarily in Hungary and Finland, as well as in other parts of Central and Eastern Europe.

ilsa.meaning_fr: Ilsa est un prénom féminin. Il s'agit d'une des abréviations germaniques du prénom Elizabeth, qui est lui-même d'origine hébraïque. Une autre variante de ce prénom est Ilse. Il a pour référence le prénom hébraïque "Elisheba". dont la signification est " Dieu est plénitude".

ilse.meaning_en: Ilse is a Germanic feminine given name. It is technically a German diminutive of Elisabeth, functioning as a given name in its own right chiefly in Austria, Belgium, Germany, the Netherlands, Switzerland, South Africa and all of the Scandinavian countries including Finland.

ilya.meaning_en: Ilya, Iliya, Ilia, Ilja, Ilija, or Illia is the East Slavic form of the male Hebrew name Eliyahu, meaning "My God is Yahu/Jah." It comes from the Byzantine Greek pronunciation of the vocative of the Greek Elias. It is The diminutive form is Iliusha or Iliushen'ka.

ilyana.meaning_en: Ilyana is a female given name. Notable people with the name include: Illeana Douglas, American actress Iliana Iotova, Bulgarian politician Ilyana Kuziemko, American professor of economics Illyana Rasputina or Magik, comic character

ilyas.meaning_en: Ilyas is a form of the masculine given name Elias or Elijah.

imad.meaning_en: Emad is an Arabic masculine given name and surname and means "support" or "pillar". What they trust. This name conjures up images of trust, strength, and stability.

iman.meaning_en: Iman is a given name found in many cultures, that can be both masculine and feminine. Variations of spelling include Eman, Emon, and Imaan. In Islamic cultures, the name Iman comes from the Arabic word meaning 'faith' or 'belief'.

imane.meaning_en: Imane is a unisex given name.

imed.meaning_en: Emad is an Arabic masculine given name and surname and means "support" or "pillar". What they trust. This name conjures up images of trust, strength, and stability.

imelda.meaning_en: Imelda is a feminine Spanish/Italian given name derived from the German form of Irmhild.

immanuel.meaning_fr: Emmanuel ou Emanuel ou encore Immanuel est un prénom dérivé de l'hébreu ‘immânû ’él, qui signifie « Dieu est parmi nous ».

imogen.meaning_en: Imogen, or Imogene, is a feminine given name; see Innogen § Name for its origins.
imogen.meaning_fr: Imogen ou Imogène est un prénom féminin à l'étymologie incertaine, possiblement irlandaise ou grecque. Ce prénom est notamment populaire au Royaume-Uni.

inaya.meaning_en: Inaya is a Bengali version of the Urdu name Inayat, meaning "care" or "concern".

india.meaning_en: India is a feminine given name derived from the name of the country India, which itself takes its name from the Indus River. The name was used for India Wilkes, a character in the novel and film Gone with the Wind.

indigo.meaning_en: Indigo is a given name often used in reference to the color, a shade between the colors blue and violet. Deep blue indigo dye was originally derived from the plant called true indigo. The name is in use for both boys and girls in the Anglosphere.

indra.meaning_en: Indra is a given name which occurs independently in Latvia, where it is feminine, and in India and Nepal, where it can be masculine or, less often, feminine. In Latvia, the associated name day is February 1.

inez.meaning_en: Inez is a feminine given name. It is the English spelling of the Spanish, Portuguese and French name InésThe name is Agnes is a woman's given name, which derives from the Greek word hagnē, meaning "pure" or "holy".

inga.meaning_en: The feminine given name Inga is a variant of the German and Scandinavian name Inge. It derives from the Germanic deity Ing.

inge.meaning_en: Inge is a given name in various Germanic language-speaking cultures. In Swedish and Norwegian, it is mostly used as a masculine, but less often also as a feminine name. In Danish, Estonian, Frisian, German and Dutch it is exclusively feminine.

famous.name: Ingeborg of Denmark, Queen of France

ingeborg.meaning_en: Ingeborg is a Germanic feminine given name, mostly used in Germany, Denmark, Sweden and Norway, derived from Old Norse Ingiborg, Ingibjǫrg, combining the theonym Ing with the element borg "stronghold, protection".

inger.meaning_en: Inger is a Scandinavian given feminine name, originally short for a name in Ing-, either Ingrid or Ingegerd.

ingrid.meaning_en: Ingrid is a feminine given name. It continues the Old Norse name Ingiríðr, which was a short form of Ingfríðr, composed of the theonym Ing and the element fríðr "beloved; beautiful" common in Germanic feminine given names.

inna.meaning_en: Inna is a European given name. It was the name of an early East Orthodox male martyr, but is currently used as a feminine name only. In ancient Greece, the name Ἴννα is also attested, however a connection with the Russian Inna has not been confirmed.

innocent.meaning_fr: Innocent est un nom propre utilisé comme prénom ou comme patronyme, venant du latin innocens qui veut dire in-nocens, c'est-à-dire « qui ne nuit pas, inoffensif ».

ioan.meaning_en: Ioan is a variation on the name John found in Aromanian, Romanian, Bulgarian, Russian, Welsh, and Sardinian. It is usually masculine. The female equivalent in Romanian and Bulgarian is Ioana. In Russia, the name Ioann is usually reserved for the clergy.

ioana.meaning_en: Ioana or Oana is a female given name of Romanian origin. It is the equivalent of the English name Joan, and the male version John, all of which derive from the Hebrew name Yohanan. A common diminutive is Ionela. People with this name include:
ioana.meaning_fr: Joana est un prénom féminin qui est traditionnellement usité en Occitanie et au Pays basque. En hébreu, il signifie « Dieu fait grâce ». Ce prénom est relativement rare et est très peu attribué aujourd'hui. Sa tendance pour 2005 est stable.

ioanna.meaning_en: Joanna is a feminine given name deriving from Koine Greek: Ἰωάννα, romanized: Iōanna from Hebrew: יוֹחָנָה, romanized: Yôḥānāh, lit. 'God is gracious'. Variants in English include Joan, Joann, Joanne, and Johanna.

ioannis.meaning_en: Ioannis or Ioannes, shortened to Giannis or Yannis is a Greek given name cognate with Johannes and John, ultimately from Hebrew Yohanan.
ioannis.meaning_fr: Ioánnis ou Ioannis est le prénom grec équivalent à Jean. Il peut être abrégé en Giannis ou Yannis.

ion.meaning_en: Ion is a masculine given name. The written form corresponds to two names that are different and unrelated in origin. The first is the Greek name Ἴων, after the mythical founder of the Ionians; the modern Greek equivalent is Ionas.

iona.meaning_en: Iona is a given name that is taken from the Scottish island of Iona, which has a particular significance in the history of Christianity. The derivation of this island name itself is uncertain. The earliest forms of the name enabled toponymist William J.

iqra.meaning_en: Iqra is a feminine given name of Arabic origin. Notable people with the name include:

ira.meaning_en: Ira is a unisex given name. As a Sanskrit male name, its meaning is that of the wind god, Vayu. As a female name its meaning is "the Earth". She is daughter of Daksha Prajapati and is wife of Kashyapa Maharishi and she is mother of plants, creepers and trees.

iran.meaning_en: Iran is a unisex given name. Notable people with the name include:

irby.meaning_en: Although more commonly a surname, Irby is also a given name.

irena.meaning_en: Irena is a traditionally European feminine given name.

irenee.meaning_en: Irénée is a French male given name, derived from Irenaeus.

irina.meaning_en: Irina or Iryna is a feminine given name of Ancient Greek origin, commonly borne by followers of the Eastern Orthodox Church. It is derived from Eirene, an ancient Greek goddess, personification of peace.

iris.meaning_en: Iris is a feminine name. The name came into use in English-speaking countries in the 1500s, first in reference to the goddess, and was later used along with other Ancient Greek names revived by 17th-century British poets, such as Doris and Phyllis.
iris.meaning_fr: Iris est un prénom feminin. En Europe, le prénom est surtout populaire en Allemagne. En Espagne, ce prénom est souvent utilisé sous Franco comme rébellion aux normes établies et chrétiennes.

irma.meaning_en: Irma is a female given name. It is also used in combination with other names in the abbreviated form "Irm-," for example, Irmine, Irmela, Irmgard, Irmgardis, and Irmentraud. The name comes from the Old High German "irmin", meaning "world".

irmgard.meaning_en: Irmgard is a feminine German given name.
irmgard.meaning_fr: Irmgard est un prénom d'origine allemande :

irven.meaning_en: Irvin is a male given name of Indo-European origin. In Old Gaelic, the meaning of the name is "freshwater" or "friend of the sea." It can also be used as a variant of Ervin, the Eastern European version of the German name Erwin.

isaak.meaning_en: Isaac transliterated from Yitzhak, Yitzchok was one of the three patriarchs in the Hebrew Bible, whose story is told in the book of Genesis.

famous.name: Rose of Lima
famous.occupation: member of Roman Catholic religious orders and societies

isabel.meaning_en: Isabel is a female name of Spanish origin. It originates as the medieval Spanish form of Elisabeth. Arising in the 12th century, it became popular in England in the 13th century following the marriage of Isabella of Angoulême to the king of England.

isabell.meaning_en: Isabel is a female name of Spanish origin. It originates as the medieval Spanish form of Elisabeth. Arising in the 12th century, it became popular in England in the 13th century following the marriage of Isabella of Angoulême to the king of England.

famous.name: Princess Maria Annunziata of Bourbon-Two Sicilies

isabella.meaning_en: Isabella or Isabela is a feminine given name, the Latinate and Italian form of Isabel, the Spanish form, Isabelle, the French form, and Isobel, the Scottish form of the name Elizabeth. All are ultimately derived from the Hebrew Elisheba.

isabelle.meaning_en: Isabelle is a feminine given name. Notable people with the name include:
isabelle.meaning_fr: Isabelle est un prénom féminin d’origine espagnole, forme altérée d'Elisabeth, fêté le 22 février.

isadora.meaning_en: Isidora or Isadora is a female given name of Greek origin, derived from Ἰσίδωρος, Isídōros. The male equivalent is Isidore.
isadora.meaning_fr: Isadora est un prénom féminin d'origine grecque signifiant « don d'Isis », en référence à la déesse égyptienne Isis. C'est la forme féminine du prénom masculin Isidore.

isadore.meaning_en: Isidore is a masculine given name. The name is derived from the Greek name Isídōros and can literally be translated to 'gift of Isis'. The name has survived in various forms throughout the centuries.

isaia.meaning_en: Isaia is a given name and surname. Notable people with the name include:

isaiah.meaning_en: Isaiah is a masculine name of biblical origin. It comes from the Hebrew: יְשַׁעְיָהוּ‎, meaning 'Yahweh is salvation'. The best known Isaiah is a prophet, in the Book of Isaiah.

isaias.meaning_en: Isaías is the Spanish and Portuguese language form of the biblical name Isaiah.

isak.meaning_en: Izak is a given name which is an alternate spelling for Isaac. Notable people and characters with the name include:

isaline.meaning_fr: Ysaline est un prénom féminin ancien très peu répandu mais qui semble jouir d'une nouvelle popularité ces dernières années dans les statistiques françaises et belges.

isam.meaning_en: Isam is a masculine given name. It means "safeguard". Notable people with the name include: Isam al-Attar, Muslim Brotherhood leader Isam Bachiri, Danish rapper Isam Dart, American cattlemen Isam Faiz, Moroccan football player Isam al-Qadi, Palestinian Ba'thist politician

isamu.meaning_en: Isamu is a masculine Japanese given name.

isao.meaning_en: Isao is a masculine Japanese given name which was popular during the Shōwa period.

ishaan.meaning_en: Ishaan is a given name of Indian origin.

ishana.meaning_en: Ishaan, is a Hindu god and the dikpala of the northeast direction. He is often considered to be one of the forms of the god Shiva, and is also often counted among the eleven Rudras. He is venerated in Hinduism, some schools of Buddhism and Jainism.
ishana.meaning_fr: Ishana est un nom de plusieurs dieux dans l'hindouisme. Chronologiquement il fut d'abord donné à Agni, puis à Shiva; et dans une forme féminine il désigne Dourga, la parèdre de Shiva.

ishika.meaning_en: Ishika is a feminine given name. Notable people with the name include:

isidora.meaning_en: Isidora or Isadora is a female given name of Greek origin, derived from Ἰσίδωρος, Isídōros. The male equivalent is Isidore.

isidore.meaning_en: Isidore is a masculine given name. The name is derived from the Greek name Isídōros and can literally be translated to 'gift of Isis'. The name has survived in various forms throughout the centuries.

isla.meaning_en: Isla is a feminine given name traditionally of primarily Scottish usage, derived from "Islay", which is the name of an island off the west coast of Scotland. It is also the name of two Scottish rivers. The root word has no known origin.

islam.meaning_en: Islam is an Arabic male and female given name and surname meaning "acceptance, agreement approval", "god-fearing, humility, devoutness", "acknowledgment, admission, yield, obeyance", "obedience, preservation, protection, safeguarding, keeping", "piety, loyalty, devotion", "subjection, submissiveness, wonder, admiration, respect, submitting".
islam.meaning_fr: Islam est un prénom porté notamment par : Islam Bayramukov est un lutteur kazakh spécialiste de la lutte libre.

isobel.meaning_en: Isobel is the Scottish form of the female given name Isabel. It originates from the medieval form of the name Elisabeth.

isobelle.meaning_en: Isobelle is a feminine given name. Notable people with the name include: Isobelle Carmody, Australian writer Isobelle Ann Dods-Withers, Scottish artist Isobelle Mary Ferguson, Aboriginal Australian nurse and activist Isobelle Jones, British runner Isobelle Molloy, English actress

isolde.meaning_en: Isolde is a German feminine given name derived from either the Old High German words īs and hiltja, or the Brythonic adsiltia.

issam.meaning_en: Issam Arabic: عصام is an Arabic masculine given name.
issam.meaning_fr: Issam est un prénom masculin d’origine arabe. Il a été porté par certains grands guerriers et savants. La signification littérale est la courroie qui maintient les choses. Peut aussi prendre le sens du lien et du nœud d'une corde ou encore de l'engagement.

itai.meaning_en: Itai is a masculine given name of Hebrew origin, and also a Shona name. The name can also be written: Itai, Itahy, Ittai, Ittay, Etay, Eitay, Itay, Ytai, Etai, Itaj, Ithai, or Eatai.

italia.meaning_en: Italia is a feminine given name and a surname. Notable people with the name are listed below:

italo.meaning_en: Italo is a male Italian given name.

ivan.meaning_en: Ivan is a male given name of Slavic origin, related to a variant of the Greek name Iōánnēs, which in turn derives from the Hebrew יוֹחָנָן, meaning "God is gracious". The name is strongly associated with Slavic countries and cultures.

jem.meaning_en: Jem is a given name, sometimes as a nickname for James, Jeremiah, Jeremy, Jemma, or Jemima, and sometimes as an anglicized version of the Turkish name Cem.

jena.meaning_en: Jena is a female given name of Arabic origin, meaning small bird. Jena is also a variant form of names such as Jenna, Gina, Jeanna and has been associated with the Arabic names Jannah and Jana.

jene.meaning_en: Jene is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Bobbi Jene Smith Jene Golovchenko Jene Jansen Jene Newsome Jené Morris Jene Vickrey

jenna.meaning_en: Jenna is a female given name. In the English-speaking world it is a variation of Jenny, which is itself a diminutive of Jane, Janet, Jennifer and is often used as a name in its own right.
jenna.meaning_fr: Jenna est un prénom féminin, porté surtout aux États-Unis depuis la seconde moitié du XXe siècle.

jennie.meaning_en: Jenny is a female given name. The name was originally the diminutive form of Jane, but it is now associated with Jennifer. It may also be spelt Jennie, which was the most common spelling before the 20th century.

jennifer.meaning_en: Jennifer, also spelled Jenifer or Jenefer, is a feminine given name, the Cornish form of Guinevere, that became popular in the English-speaking world in the 20th century.

jenny.meaning_en: Jenny is a female given name. The name was originally the diminutive form of Jane, but it is now associated with Jennifer. It may also be spelt Jennie, which was the most common spelling before the 20th century.

jens.meaning_en: Jens is a male given name and a Danish, Dutch, German, Norwegian, Swedish, Icelandic, Faroese and Frisian derivative of Johannes. It was the top given name for boys in Denmark in 2008.

jensen.meaning_en: Jensen is a unisex given name. Notable people with the given name include:

jenson.meaning_en: Jenson is an English language patronymic surname meaning "son of Jen", with Jen being a short form of Old French Jehan i.e. John. It may also be an Americanized form of the surnames Jensen or Jenssen. Jenson is also used as a given name.
jenson.meaning_fr: Jenson est un nom de famille notamment porté par : Dan Jenson, joueur de squash australien ; Nicolas Jenson, imprimeur et graveur de caractères français ; Roy Jenson, acteur canadien ; Sasha Jenson, acteur américain ; Terry Jenson, homme politique provincial canadien.

jeramie.meaning_en: Jeramie is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Jeramie Kling, American drummer, audio engineer Jeramie Rain, American actress Jeramie Richardson, American football player

jered.meaning_en: Jared is a given name of Biblical derivation.

jerell.meaning_en: Jerell is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Jerell Adams, American football player Jerell Sellars, English footballer Jerell Springer, American basketball player

jeremia.meaning_en: Jeremia is a male given name, a variant of Jeremiah. People with the name include: Jeremia Nambinga, Namibian politician Jeremia Nyembe, South African airman Jeremía Recoba, Uruguayan footballer

jeremiah.meaning_en: Jeremiah is a male given name meaning "Yahweh loosens", or "Yahweh will raise", or "God is high", and having its origin in ancient Hebrew. Jeremias is a form that it takes in some Romance languages.

jeremias.meaning_en: Jeremias is an alternate spelling of Jeremiah, the biblical prophet.

jeremy.meaning_en: Jeremy is a Hebrew male given name, deriving from various translations and interpretations as the anglicized and diminutive form of the Hebrew name Jeremiah, a major prophet of the Old Testament known for his prophecies of judgment and hope.

jericho.meaning_en: Jericho is a masculine given name originating from the city of Jericho. Because of its biblical associations, it is often given by parents of Christian faith.

jermaine.meaning_en: Jermaine is a masculine given name of Latin origin, derived from the French given name Germain, which is in turn derived from the Latin given name Germanus.
jermaine.meaning_fr: Jermaine est un prénom masculin, porté surtout aux États-Unis depuis la seconde moitié du XXe siècle et l'émergence des prénoms afro-américains.

jerome.meaning_en: Jerome is a masculine name of Greek origin, derived from the Greek given name Ἱερώνυμος, Hierōnymos, "sacred name"; from ἱερός, hierós, "sacred", and ὄνυμα, ónyma, an alternative form of ὄνομα, ónoma, "name".

jeronimo.meaning_en: Jeronimo or Jerónimo is the Portuguese and Spanish form of "Jerome". Those bearing it as a surname include: Tonicha Jeronimo, a British actress Vlademir Jeronimo Barreto, Brazilian footballer Claudemir Jerônimo Barreto, Brazilian-born German footballer a.k.a.

jerrel.meaning_en: Jerrel is a masculine given name.

jerrell.meaning_en: Jerrell is a masculine given name.

jerrick.meaning_en: Jerrick is a surname and given name.

jerry.meaning_en: Jerry is a given name, usually used for males. It is of Old English origin, and sometimes can be spelled Gerry, Gerrie, Geri, Jery, Jere, Jerrie, or Jeri.

jesica.meaning_en: Jessica is a female given name of English origin. The oldest written record of the name with its current spelling is found as the name of the Shakespearean character Jessica, from the play The Merchant of Venice.

jessa.meaning_en: Jessa is a feminine given name.

jessalyn.meaning_en: Jessalyn is a feminine given name. Notable people with the name include: Jessalyn Gilsig, Canadian actress Jessalyn Van Trump, American actress Jessalyn Wanlim, Canadian actress and model

jesse.meaning_en: Jesse is a given name of Hebrew origin. It derives its popularity from the biblical figure Jesse, father of Israelite monarch David. The English version is derived from the Latin Iesse, borrowed from the Ancient Greek Iessaí, and ultimately from the Hebrew Yišay.

jessica.meaning_en: Jessica is a female given name of English origin. The oldest written record of the name with its current spelling is found as the name of the Shakespearean character Jessica, from the play The Merchant of Venice.
jessica.meaning_fr: Jessica est un prénom biblique féminin d'origine hébraïque.

jessie.meaning_en: Jessie is a given name in its own right, but may also be a nickname for the given name Jessica. It is generally considered the feminine form of Jesse. The name Jess is also a given name. It, or Jesse, may be used in Spanish as a nickname for the male name Jesus.

jessika.meaning_en: Jessica is a female given name of English origin. The oldest written record of the name with its current spelling is found as the name of the Shakespearean character Jessica, from the play The Merchant of Venice.

jessyca.meaning_en: Jessica is a female given name of English origin. The oldest written record of the name with its current spelling is found as the name of the Shakespearean character Jessica, from the play The Merchant of Venice.
jessyca.meaning_fr: Jessica est un prénom biblique féminin d'origine hébraïque.

jesus.meaning_en: Jesus is a masculine given name derived from Iēsous, the Ancient Greek form of the Hebrew name Yeshua. As its roots lie in the name Y'shua in Aramaic and Yeshua in Hebrew, it is etymologically related to another biblical name, Joshua.

jethro.meaning_en: Jethro is a male given name meaning "excellence". It is derived from the Hebrew word Yithrô.

jevan.meaning_en: Jeevan is an Indian sub-continent first name meaning "life" or "bringer of life," which may be used by males or females. The name originates from the Sanskrit language but is more often used as a Nepalese language name, a Sikh or a Hindu name.

jewel.meaning_en: Jewel is an English given name often given in reference to the English vocabulary word meaning gemstone. The word jewel comes from the Old French word jouel, meaning toy or delight, and was ultimately derived from the Latin term jocus.

jhon.meaning_en: Jhon is an alternative spelling of the Hebrew given name John. Its usage is popular in South America, especially in Colombia, where it is one of the most common names in the country.

jihad.meaning_en: Jihad is used as a given name. People with the name Jihad, Jihaad, or Jehad include:

jihan.meaning_fr: Jihane ou Jihène ou Jihan est un prénom arabe et perse féminin. Ce prénom signifie la vie sur terre et il est courant dans tous les pays arabes et surtout en Égypte. Anciennement, dans la langue arabe classique, il a été utilisé avec la prononciation جيْهان.

jill.meaning_en: Jill is an English feminine given name, often a short form of the name Gillian or Jillian, which in turn originated as a Middle English variant of Juliana. Jill was such a common name that it had an everygirl quality, as in the 15th century English nursery rhyme Jack and Jill.

jim.meaning_en: Jim is a masculine given name. It is often short for James, Jimena, or Jimmy.

jimena.meaning_en: Jimena is a feminine given name. It is the feminine version of the given name Jimeno. The French rendering of the name is Chimène. People with the name include:

jimmy.meaning_en: Jimmy is a masculine given name. It is often used as a diminutive form of the given name James, along with its short form, Jim.

jo.meaning_en: Jo is a given name, often a short form of Joanna, Joanne, Joseph, Josephine, George, etc. Notable people with the name include:

jo-anne.meaning_en: Jo-Anne, Jo Anne, Jo-Ann, JoAnn, JoAnne, and Jo Ann is a feminine given name derived from the name Joanne. Unlike the name Joanne, which originates from the Greek Joanna, Jo-Anne is a compound name consisting of the names Jo and Anne.

joab.meaning_en: Joab is a masculine given name. Notable people with the name include: Joab H.

joachim.meaning_en: Joachim is a masculine given name, derived from the Hebrew Yehoyaqim, meaning "raised by Yahweh".

joah.meaning_en: Joah is a Hebrew masculine given name, which means "Yahu is his brother" or "God is his brother." It is derived from the two words "Yahu" and "ach". Joah may refer to:

joakim.meaning_en: Joakim or Joacim is a male given name primarily used in Scandinavian languages, Estonian and Finnish. It is derived from a transliteration of the Hebrew יהוֹיָקִים, and literally means "lifted by Jehovah". In the Old Testament, Jehoiakim was a king of Judah.
joakim.meaning_fr: Joakim est un prénom masculin scandinave pouvant désigner :

famous.name: Juan Prim, 1st Marquis of los Castillejos

joan.meaning_en: Joan is both a feminine form of the personal name John given to girls in the Anglosphere as well as the native masculine form of John in the Catalan-Valencian and Occitan languages.
joan.meaning_fr: Joan est un prénom masculin hébraïque et catalan, et féminin en anglais, équivalents respectifs de Jean et Jeanne.

joana.meaning_fr: Joana est un prénom féminin qui est traditionnellement usité en Occitanie et au Pays basque. En hébreu, il signifie « Dieu fait grâce ». Ce prénom est relativement rare et est très peu attribué aujourd'hui. Sa tendance pour 2005 est stable.

joani.meaning_en: Joani is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Joani Blank, American sex educator Joani Reid, Scottish politician Joani Tremblay, Canadian painter

joanna.meaning_en: Joanna is a feminine given name deriving from Koine Greek: Ἰωάννα, romanized: Iōanna from Hebrew: יוֹחָנָה, romanized: Yôḥānāh, lit. 'God is gracious'. Variants in English include Joan, Joann, Joanne, and Johanna.

joanne.meaning_en: Joanne is a female name derived from the Greek name Joanna via the French Johanne. In modern English, Joanne has sometimes been reinterpreted as a compound of the two names Jo and Anne, thus forming the name Jo-Anne, or one of its variants, which include JoAnne and Jo Anne.

joao.meaning_en: João is a given name of Portuguese origin. It is equivalent to the given name John. The diminutive is Joãozinho and the feminine is Joana. It is widespread in Portuguese-speaking countries. Notable people with the name are enumerated in the sections below.

joaquim.meaning_en: Joaquim is the Portuguese and Catalan version of Joachim.

joaquin.meaning_en: Joaquín or Joaquin is a male given name, the Spanish version of Joachim.

joash.meaning_en: Joash is a masculine given name of Hebrew origin, meaning "gift of YHWH". Notable people with the given name include: Joash Gesse,, Canadian CFL linebacker Joash Onyango, Kenyan footballer Joash Woodrow, English artist Joash of Israel, King of Israel Joash of Judah, King of Judah

job.meaning_en: Job is a major figure in the Bible.

joceline.meaning_en: Joceline is a unisex given name. Notable people with the name include:

jocelyn.meaning_en: Jocelyn is a given name and surname; as a given name it is a unisex name.

jocelyne.meaning_en: Jocelyne is a feminine given name.
jocelyne.meaning_fr: Jocelyne ou Josseline est un prénom féminin. Il peut être orthographié Jocelyn au féminin dans les pays anglophones.

jock.meaning_en: Jock is a Scottish diminutive form of the forename "John"; It is also a nickname for someone of Scottish origin, as well as being the collective name for Scottish soldiers, collectively known as "the Jocks". It corresponds to Jack in England and Wales.

jodie.meaning_en: Jodie is a unisex given name. It is related to names Cody, Jodi, Jody, Codey, and Jodey. It is also a rare surname. It can be used as a nickname for Joseph, Jude, Judith, Joan and Jonathan, and a variant for Jo.

jody.meaning_en: Jody is a unisex given name. For men, it is sometimes a short form for Joseph and other names. Notable people with the given name include:

joe.meaning_en: Joe is a masculine given name, usually a short form of Joseph.

joel.meaning_en: Joel or Yoel is a male name derived from יוֹאֵל Standard Hebrew, Yoʾel, Tiberian Hebrew, or Yôʾēl, meaning "Yahu is god", "YHWH is God", or the modern translation "Yahweh is God". Joel as a given name appears in the Hebrew Bible.

joelle.meaning_en: Joëlle is a French feminine given name, the feminine form of Joel.

joely.meaning_en: Joely is a given name. It is a variation of either the name Joelle or Joel. Notable people with this name include:

joey.meaning_en: Joey is a unisex given name or nickname, more commonly used for males. It can be a diminutive of names that begin with J, most commonly Joseph, Joshua, Joe, Josephine and Johanna.

johan.meaning_en: Johan is a Scandinavian and Dutch form of Iōhannēs / Jōhannēs, the Latin form of the Greek name Iōánnēs, from the Hebrew name Yochanan, itself derived from the extended form Yehochanan, meaning "Yahweh is gracious". It is uncommon as a surname. Its English equivalent is John.

johann.meaning_en: Johann is a German male given name. It is derived from Iōhannēs / Jōhannēs, which is the Latin form of the Greek name Iōánnēs, itself derived from Hebrew name Yochanan in turn from its extended form Yehochanan, meaning "Yahweh is gracious" or "Yahweh is merciful".

famous.name: Joanna of Austria, Grand Duchess of Tuscany

johanna.meaning_en: Johanna is a feminine name, a variant form of Joanna that originated in Latin in the Middle Ages, including an -h- by analogy with the Latin masculine name Johannes.
johanna.meaning_fr: Johanna, Johana ou Joanna est un prénom féminin équivalent à Jeanne.

johanne.meaning_en: Johanne is an Old French equivalent of Joanna that is now a common French Canadian female given name.

johannes.meaning_en: Johannes is a Medieval Latin form of the personal name that usually appears as "John" in English language contexts. It is a variant of the Greek and Classical Latin variants, itself derived from the Hebrew name Yehochanan, meaning "YHWH is gracious".

john.meaning_en: John is a very common given male name in the English language, ultimately of Hebrew origin. The English form is from Middle English Ioon, Ihon, Iohn, Jan, itself from Old French Jan, Jean, Jehan, from Medieval Latin Johannes, an altered form of Late Latin Ioannes.

johnathan.meaning_en: Johnathan is a given name. It is an alternative spelling of Jonathan. Notable people with the name include:

johnnie.meaning_en: Johnny is an English language personal name. It is often a nickname, but from the 16th century it has sometimes been a given name in its own right for males and, less commonly, females. Variant forms of Johnny include Johnnie, Johnney, Johhny, Johnni and Johni.

johnny.meaning_en: Johnny is an English language personal name. It is often a nickname, but from the 16th century it has sometimes been a given name in its own right for males and, less commonly, females. Variant forms of Johnny include Johnnie, Johnney, Johhny, Johnni and Johni.

johnson.meaning_en: Johnson is a masculine given name. It is a patronym of the given name John and literally means "son of John". Notable people with the name include: J. Kwabena Asamoah-Gyadu, Ghanaian academic Johnson Bademosi, American football player Johnson N.

jolene.meaning_en: Jolene is a feminine given name derived from a combination of the name Jo with the suffix -lene, common in other names in fashion during the middle of the 20th century such as Marlene.

joline.meaning_en: Joline is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Joline Beam, American politician Joline Blais, American writer, educator, and designer Joline Godfrey, American businesswoman Joline Henry, American netball player Joline Höstman, Swedish swimmer
joline.meaning_fr: Joline est un prénom féminin, porté notamment par : Joline Henry, joueuse de netball néo-zélandaise ; Joline Höstman, nageuse suédoise spécialiste de la brasse.

jon.meaning_en: Jon is a masculine given name. It is often short for Jonathan. The name is spelled Jón in Iceland and on the Faroe Islands. In the Nordic countries, it is derived from Johannes.

jonah.meaning_en: Jonah is a masculine given name derived from the Hebrew: יוֹנָה, Yonā, meaning dove or pigeon. It is the name of the Abrahamic prophet Jonah.

jonas.meaning_fr: Jonas est un prénom masculin peu usité en France, fêté le 21 septembre. On trouve les variantes Younes, Youness, Younesse, Younous, Younouss et Younousse, et au féminin la forme Yona.

jonathan.meaning_en: Jonathan is a common name given to males which means "YHWH has given" in Hebrew. The earliest known use of the name was in the Bible; one Jonathan was the son of King Saul, a close friend of David. Variants of Jonathan include Jonatan, Djonathan.

jonathon.meaning_en: Jonathon is a male given name. It is an often used alternative spelling of "Jonathan", as is "Johnathan".

jone.meaning_en: Jone is a predominantly Fijian masculine given name, a cognate of the English-language name John. In the Basque language, it is a female counterpart to Jon / Ion, again an equivalent of John.

jonelle.meaning_en: Jonelle is a feminine given name.

joni.meaning_en: Joni is a unisex given name.

jonnie.meaning_en: Jonnie is a unisex given name. It is a variant form of Jonny.

jonny.meaning_en: Jonny is a masculine given name, and pet name, in the English language. A pet form of Jon, the natural diminutive of given name Jonathan, in some cases it can also mean a condom. A variant form of Jonny is Jonnie.

jonty.meaning_en: Jonty is an English masculine given name, that occurs as a diminutive form of Jonathan.

joran.meaning_en: Joran, Jöran or Jøran is a masculine given name.

jordy.meaning_en: Jordy is a gender neutral name, and sometimes a diminutive of the name Jordan. Notable people and characters with the name include:

jorge.meaning_en: Jorge is the Spanish and Portuguese form of the given name George. While spelled alike, this name is It is derived from the Greek name Γεώργιος via Latin Georgius; the former is derived from γεωργός, meaning "farmer" or "earth-worker".

jose.meaning_en: José is a predominantly Spanish and Portuguese form of the given name Joseph.

josee.meaning_en: Josée is a female given name of French origin.

josef.meaning_en: Josef is a variant of the male given name Joseph, notably used in Austria, the Czech Republic, Germany and Switzerland. The name also appears in Scandinavia. Notable people with the surname include:

josefa.meaning_en: Josefa is a given name. It can be both feminine and masculine.

josefine.meaning_en: Josefine is a feminine given name.

joselyn.meaning_en: Jocelyn is a given name and surname; as a given name it is a unisex name.

joseph.meaning_en: Joseph is a common male name, derived from the Hebrew Yosef. "Joseph" is used, along with "Josef", mostly in English, French and partially German languages. This spelling is also found as a variant in the languages of the modern-day Nordic countries.

josepha.meaning_en: Josepha is a given name, a feminine variant of the name Joseph.

josephine.meaning_en: Josephine is a female name. It is the English version of the French name Joséphine, itself a female variant of the name Joseph , which is ultimately derived from the Hebrew name Yosef, meaning "he shall add/grow".

josette.meaning_fr: Le prénom féminin Josette est un diminutif de Joséphine, Josèphe ou Josephte, versions féminines de Joseph selon les régions. Il a été créé, en tant que prénom à part entière, au XXe siècle et a "succédé" à Joséphine.

josey.meaning_en: Josey is an abbreviated form of the given name Joseph.

josh.meaning_en: Josh is a masculine given name. It is frequently a diminutive of the given name Joshua and historically a diminutive of Josiah but has been used independently as a given name. The diminutive has been in use since the 19th century. It may refer to:

joshua.meaning_en: Joshua is a given name derived from the Hebrew יְהוֹשֻׁעַ‎, prominently belonging to Joshua, an early Hebrew leader of the Exodus period who has a major role in several books of the Bible.

josi.meaning_en: Josi is a given name. Notable people with the given name include: Josi S. Kilpack, American novelist Josi W. Konski, Cuban-born American film producer Josi Meier, Swiss politician and feminist Josef "Josi" Singer, Israeli President of Technion – Israel Institute of Technology

josiah.meaning_en: Josiah is a masculine given name derived from the Hebrew Yoshi-yahu (Hebrew: יֹאשִׁיָּהוּ, Modern: Yošiyyáhu, Tiberian: Yôšiyyāhû, "Yahweh has healed". Josiah was a King of Judah in the Bible. The Latin form Josias was used in some early English translations of the Bible.

josiane.meaning_fr: Josiane est un prénom féminin d'origine hébraïque. Ce prénom provient de Joseph .

josie.meaning_en: Josie is a given name that is often a diminutive of the female given name Josephine.

josseline.meaning_fr: Jocelyne ou Josseline est un prénom féminin. Il peut être orthographié Jocelyn au féminin dans les pays anglophones.

jostin.meaning_en: Jostin is a masculine given name. Notable people with the name include: Jostin Alarcón, Peruvian footballer Jostin Tellería, Costa Rican footballer

josua.meaning_en: Josua or Jozua is a male given name and a variation of the Hebrew name Yeshua.

jovan.meaning_en: Jovan is a Serbian male given name equivalent to English "John" or Slavic "Ivan", from Hebrew: יהוחנן. The name is common amongst Orthodox Christians as a result of John the Baptist

jovana.meaning_en: Jovana is a Serbian feminine name.

jovie.meaning_en: Jovie or Jovi is a unisex given name with diverse origins. The name Jovie was popularized in the Anglosphere for girls by a character played by American actress Zooey Deschanel in the 2003 American Christmas comedy film Elf.

joy.meaning_en: Joy is a common unisex given name meaning joy, happiness, joyful. A common variant of the name is the other female given name Joyce. Notable people with the given name include:

jozef.meaning_en: Jozef or Józef are variants of the masculine given name Joseph in several European languages. A selection of people with that name follows. For a comprehensive list, see All pages with titles beginning with Jozef and All pages with titles beginning with Józef.

juan.meaning_en: Juan is a given name, the Spanish and Manx versions of John. The name is of Hebrew origin and has the meaning "God has been gracious." It is very common in Spain and in other Spanish-speaking countries around the world and in the Philippines, and also in the Isle of Man.

famous.name: Sor Juana Inés de la Cruz
Joanna of Austria, Princess of Portugal

juana.meaning_en: Juana is a Spanish female name. It is the feminine form of Juan, and thus corresponds to the English names Jane, Jean, Joan, and Joanna. The feminine diminutive form is Juanita.

juanita.meaning_en: Juanita is a feminine given name. Juanita is the Spanish diminutive for the name Juana, but it is sometimes given as a name in its own right, across linguistic contexts. English speakers sometimes use a phonetic spelling of the name, such as Waneta or Wanita.

juda.meaning_fr: Jud ou Jude est un nom d'origine hébraïque qui signifie « celui qui est aimé de Dieu », « digne de louange divine » ou « confesseur divin ». Selon d'autres sources[Lesquelles ?], il signifierait simplement « appartenant à la tribu de Juda » ou Juif.

judah.meaning_en: Judah is a masculine given name of Hebrew origin. It is the English form of Yehudah, the Hebrew name of the biblical figure Judah, founder of the Tribe of Judah and thus, the eponym of the Kingdom of Judah and the Jews.

jude.meaning_en: Jude is an English unisex, primarily masculine given name. It is ultimately derived from the Hebrew name יְהוּדָה, which can be transliterated as Yehuḏa, means "praise", and whose short form was more directly adopted into English as Judah.

judee.meaning_en: Judee is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Judee Sill, American singer-songwriter Judee K. Burgoon, American professor

judie.meaning_en: Judie is a variant spelling of Judy or Judi. As such, it is a feminine personal name which is sometimes a given name, but more commonly a hypocorism. When a hypocorism, it is usually a shortening of the given name Judith.

judit.meaning_en: Judit is a feminine given name of Hungarian and Catalan origin related to Judith.

judith.meaning_en: Judith is a feminine given name derived from the Hebrew name Yəhūdīt, meaning "praised" and also more literally "Woman of Judea". It is the feminine form of Judah.

judy.meaning_en: Judy is a female personal name. It is sometimes a given name, but more often it is a hypocorism which takes the place of a given name, usually Judith. Jude is another occasionally used short form of the name.

julee.meaning_en: Julee is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Julee Cerda, American actress Julee Cruise, American singer and songwriter Julee Rosso, American cook and food writer

julen.meaning_en: Julen is a given name. Notable people with the name include:

jules.meaning_en: Jules is the French form of the Latin "Julius". In the anglosphere, it is also used for females although it is a predominantly masculine name.
jules.meaning_fr: Jules est un prénom masculin provenant du latin Julius. Il est tiré du nom de famille de Jules César, la gens Julia qui prétendait descendre du Troyen Ascagne, fils du demi-dieu Énée.

julia.meaning_en: Julia is a feminine given name. It is a Latinate feminine form of the name Julio and Julius. The given name Julia had been in use throughout Late Antiquity but became rare during the Middle Ages, and was revived only with the Italian Renaissance.

julian.meaning_en: Julian is a common male given name in the United States, Germany, Austria, the United Kingdom, Ireland, the Netherlands, France, Italy, Russia [Iulian] Spain, Latin America, Iulian in Romanian and elsewhere.

juliana.meaning_en: Juliana is a feminine given name which is the feminine version of the Roman name Julianus. Juliana or Giuliana was the name of a number of early saints, notably Saint Julian the Hospitaller, which ensured the name's continued popularity in the medieval period.

famous.name: Princess Juliane of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha

juliann.meaning_en: Juliann is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Juliann Bluitt Foster, American dentist Juliann Graham, American church choir singer and actress

julianna.meaning_en: Julianna is a feminine given name.
julianna.meaning_fr: Julianna est un prénom hongrois féminin, polonais et anglais.

julianne.meaning_en: Julianne is an English language given name ultimately derived from the Latin Iuliana, the feminine form of Iulianus, probably via the French Julienne. The name is often thought to be made up from Julia + Anne.

juliano.meaning_en: Juliano is a masculine given name. Notable people with the given name include the following:

julie.meaning_en: Julie is a Latin first name which originally comes from the Latin Julia, itself derived from the Latin Julius, which is believed to either stem from Ancient Greek: ἴουλος, romanized: íoulos, lit. 'downy-haired' or Latin: Iovilius, lit. 'devoted to Jove'.
julie.meaning_fr: Julie est un prénom féminin francophone d'origine latine, venant de Julius, ou de Iulius, autre nom d'Ascagne, ancêtre légendaire du fondateur de Rome.

julienne.meaning_fr: Julienne est un prénom féminin. C'est la variante féminine de Julien. Il a pour variantes Giliane, Gilianne, Gilliane, Gillianne, Juliana, Juliane, Julianie, Julianna, Julianne, Julienna * Jhullène en poitevin[réf. nécessaire] Julienne est aussi un patronyme.

juliet.meaning_en: Juliet is a feminine given name, an English form of the Italian Giulietta, which is a diminutive form of Italian Giulia. It is also an English form of the French Juliette, which is a diminutive form of the French Julie.

julieta.meaning_en: Julieta is a predominantly Spanish, Catalan and Portuguese variant of the given name Julia or Júlia.

julio.meaning_en: Julio is a Spanish male given name. It can also be a family name or surname. See Julio. The equivalent in Portuguese is the accented Júlio.
julio.meaning_fr: Julio est un prénom espagnol dont l'équivalent en français est Jules. Julio signifie également « juillet ».

julissa.meaning_en: Julissa is a feminine given name. Notable people with the name include the following: Julissa, Mexican actress, producer and singer.

julius.meaning_en: Julius is a masculine given name and a surname, derived from the nomen of a Roman family, most famously Julius Caesar. The name may be derived from Greek ιουλος lit. 'downy-bearded' or from Latin Jovilius lit. 'devoted to Jove'. Julio

jumana.meaning_en: Jumana or Jumanah, meaning "rarest pearl", is an Arabic feminine given name.

jun.meaning_en: Jun is a Japanese given name used by either gender.

junaid.meaning_en: Junayd or Junaid or Junayed and sometimes Jounaid is a male given name which means soldier or warrior.

june.meaning_en: June is a gender-neutral given name. It is a common feminine name and a less common masculine name in English-speaking countries. It comes from the name of the month, which is derived from Juno, the name of a Roman goddess of youth and protection.

juniper.meaning_en: Juniper is a given name used either in reference to the English common name for the juniper tree or berry, or in reference to a derivation of the Welsh name Guinevere. Juniper has historically been used as both a boys' name and a girls' name.

jupiter.meaning_en: Jupiter is a given name of Latin origin which is given in reference either to the Roman god Jupiter or to the planet named after the mythological deity. The name is traditionally masculine but has also been used for girls in recent years.

justin.meaning_en: Justin is a masculine given name of Latin origin. It is the anglicized form of the Latin given name Justinus, a derivative of Justus, meaning "just", "fair", or "righteous".

justina.meaning_en: Justina is an anglicised version of the Latin name Iustina, feminine of Iustinus, a derivative of Iustus, meaning fair or just. For the masculine version of the name, see Justin.

kelsey.meaning_en: Kelsey is a given name of English origin. The name most probably derives from an Old English given name Cēolsiġe, which meant "ship's victory", or it could be a place name meaning "Cenel's island".

kelsie.meaning_en: Kelsie is a unisex given name. Notable people with the name include: Kelsie B.

kelvin.meaning_en: Kelvin is a masculine given name, ultimately derived from the title of William Thomson, 1st Baron Kelvin, who received a baronage named for the River Kelvin in 1892.

kemuel.meaning_en: Kemuel is a minor Hebrew masculine name.

ken.meaning_en: Ken is a masculine given name of Japanese and Scottish Gaelic origin. The Japanese given name is common among males. It can have many different meanings depending on the kanji used. Ken is also a masculine given name of Scottish / Scottish Gaelic origin.

kenan.meaning_en: Kenan is a male given name. The name refers to the Abrahamic patriarch Kenan and to the region of Canaan. In the Balkans, Kenan is used among Bosniaks in the former Yugoslav nations. The name is also used in Turkey.

kendall.meaning_en: Kendall is a unisex given name. Notable people and characters with the name include:

kendra.meaning_en: Kendra is a female name of disputed origins. Kendra is a moderately popular female first name, ranking 403 out of 4275 for females of all ages in the 1990 U.S. Census. The name was at its most popular in the United States from the mid-1980s to mid-1990s, peaking in 1987.
kendra.meaning_fr: Kendra est un prénom porté par plusieurs personnages : Kendra Dumbledore dans la saga Harry Potter. Kendra Young, la Tueuse de vampires dans la série Buffy contre les vampires. Kendra est aussi un épisode en deux parties de la saison 2 de Buffy contre les vampires.

kenji.meaning_en: Kenji or Kenzi is a masculine Japanese given name.
kenji.meaning_fr: Kenji est un prénom japonais très courant pour les garçons.

kennedi.meaning_en: Kennedy is a unisex given name in the English language. The name is an Anglicised form of a masculine given name in the Irish language.

kennedy.meaning_en: Kennedy is a unisex given name in the English language. The name is an Anglicised form of a masculine given name in the Irish language.

kenney.meaning_en: Kenney is a given name and surname of Irish, Scottish, and English origin. In Ireland, the surname is an Anglicisation of the Irish Ó Cionnaith. It is also a variation of Kenny, MacKenny, O'Kenney, or Keaney.

kenny.meaning_fr: Kenny est un prénom d'origine celtique.

keno.meaning_en: Keno is a male Germanic given name, specifically of Frisian origin. The name derives from the Old Germanic name Kuonrat, from conja meaning "bold" and rad "counsel". It is a diminutive of Konrad.

kenta.meaning_en: Kenta is a masculine Japanese given name..
