keny.meaning_en: Kenneth is a given name of Gaelic origin. The name is an Anglicised form of two entirely different Gaelic personal names: Cainnech and Cináed. The modern Scottish Gaelic form of Cainnech is Coinneach; the name was derived from a byname meaning "handsome", "comely".

kenya.meaning_en: Kenya is a given name. It is considered to be an African-American name in the United States.

kenyatta.meaning_en: Kenyatta is an African masculine name of Kenyan origin from the Kikuyu tribe. It derives from the surname of Jomo Kenyatta, the first Prime Minister and then President of Kenya from 1964 to 1978. It may also refer to other artists such as: Kenyatta A.C.

kerem.meaning_en: Kerem is a Turkish male given name of Arabic origin.

keren.meaning_en: Keren is Hebrew for "ray" and can be used as both a given name and a surname. It is also a variant of the name Karen. Notable people named Keren include:

kermit.meaning_en: Kermit is a male given name found mainly in the United States. It is a variant spelling of Kermode, a surname in the Isle of Man, which itself is a Manx language variant of Mac Diarmata, an Irish language patronymic anglicised MacDermot.

kerrie.meaning_en: Kerrie is a feminine given name. Notable people with the name include:

kersten.meaning_en: Kersten is a German given name and a Dutch/Low German surname.

kerstin.meaning_en: Kerstin is a female German and Swedish given name; it is the European version of Christina. Notable persons with this name include:

keshav.meaning_en: Keshav is a South Asian male given name which is a modern form of name Keshava, one of the many names of Lord Krishna and Lord Vishnu.

keshawn.meaning_en: Keshawn is an African American male given name.

kevan.meaning_en: Kevan is a given name, a variant of the name Kevin. The feminine variant is Caoimhe. Kevan is also an Irish surname, an anglicization of Ó Géibheannaigh or Caomhánach.

keven.meaning_en: Kevin is the anglicized form of the Irish masculine given name Caoimhín. It is composed of caomh "dear; noble"; Old Irish cóem and -gin. The variant Kevan is anglicised from Caoimheán, an Irish diminutive form. The feminine version of the name is Caoimhe.

kevin.meaning_en: Kevin is the anglicized form of the Irish masculine given name Caoimhín. It is composed of caomh "dear; noble"; Old Irish cóem and -gin. The variant Kevan is anglicised from Caoimheán, an Irish diminutive form. The feminine version of the name is Caoimhe.

kevon.meaning_en: Kevon is a given name of Irish origin.
kevon.meaning_fr: Kevon est un prénom masculin, porté surtout à Trinidad et Tobago et aux États-Unis depuis la seconde moitié du XXe siècle et l'émergence des prénoms afro-américains.

keyan.meaning_en: Keyan is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Keyan Tomaselli, South African communication professor and author Keyan Varela, Portuguese footballer Zhao Keyan, Chinese rapper

keziah.meaning_en: Keziah or Kezia is a Hebrew name. Keziah was a daughter of Job in the Hebrew Bible. The name Keziah means 'cinnamon bark'. Job gave the name to his second daughter after his restoration following the trials he faced in the first part of his life.

khadija.meaning_en: Khadija, Khadeeja or Khadijah is an Arabic female given name, the name of Khadija bint Khuwaylid, first wife of the Islamic prophet Muhammad. In 1995, it was one of the three most popular Arabic female given names in the Muslim world, along with Fatima and Aisha.
khadija.meaning_fr: Khadija est un prénom féminin porté notamment par les personnalités suivantes : Khadija al-Salami, réalisatrice, diplomate, écrivaine yéménite ; Khadija Arib, femme politique néerlandaise d'origine marocaine ; Khadija Benguenna, journaliste algérienne de la chaîne d'information arabe Al Jazeera ; Khadija bint Khuwaylid, première épouse du prophète de l'islam Mahomet ; Khadija du Maroc, fille du roi du Maroc, Mohammed VI, et de son épouse la princesse Lalla Salma ; Khadija Ismayilova, journaliste d'investigation et chroniqueuse radio azerbaïdjanaise ; Khadija Jamal, actrice marocaine ; Khadija Ryadi, militante marocaine des droits de l'homme, ancienne présidente de l'Association marocaine des droits humains ; Khadijah Rushdan, joueuse américaine de basket-ball ; Khadija Zamouri, femme politique belge flamande.

khady.meaning_en: Khady is a female given name common in Senegal.

khaleesi.meaning_en: Khaleesi is a feminine given name derived from the Dothraki title meaning queen that was used for the fictional character Daenerys Targaryen in American author George R.R. Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire books and in Game of Thrones, the television series based upon the novels.

khalil.meaning_en: Khalil or Khaleel means friend and is a common male first name in the Middle East, the Caucasus, the Balkans, North Africa, West Africa, East Africa, Central Asia and among Muslims in South Asia and as such is also a common surname.

khalilah.meaning_en: Khalilah is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Khalilah Ali, actress and martial artist Khalilah Sabra, American Muslim advocate and author Aisha Khalilah Steiner or A. L. Steiner, American multimedia artist, author and educator

khalis.meaning_en: Khalis is a given name and surname. Notable people with the name include: Khalis Bayyan or Ronald Bell, American singer-songwriter Mehdi Khalis, Moroccan footballer Mohammad Yunus Khalis, Afghan mujahideen commander Khalis, fictional character from DC Comics

kian.meaning_en: Kian is the English variant of the Gaelic Irish given name Cian, meaning 'ancient'. A variant spelling is Kyan. Kian is also a common Persian given name meaning 'king' or 'realm'.

kiana.meaning_en: Kiana or Kianna is a feminine given name with origins in multiple languages and cultures. It is sometimes regarded as a modern English name formed from the elements ki and ana or anna.

kiara.meaning_en: Kiara is a given name with various origins. It may be a variant of the Italian name Chiara, meaning bright, or the Irish name Ciara, meaning dark-haired.

kiera.meaning_en: Kiera is a female given name. It is an Anglicized version of Ciara, the name of a 7th-century saint, and means 'dark' or 'dark haired' in Irish.

kieran.meaning_en: Ciarán or Ciaran is a traditionally male given name of Irish and Scottish origin. It means "little dark one" or "little dark-haired one", produced by appending a diminutive suffix to ciar. It is the masculine version of the name Ciara.
kieran.meaning_fr: Kieran est un prénom masculin d'origine irlandaise.

kieren.meaning_en: Ciarán or Ciaran is a traditionally male given name of Irish and Scottish origin. It means "little dark one" or "little dark-haired one", produced by appending a diminutive suffix to ciar. It is the masculine version of the name Ciara.

kieron.meaning_en: Ciarán or Ciaran is a traditionally male given name of Irish and Scottish origin. It means "little dark one" or "little dark-haired one", produced by appending a diminutive suffix to ciar. It is the masculine version of the name Ciara.

kierra.meaning_en: Kierra is a female given name. The name may be a variant of the Irish name Kiara meaning "dark" or a variant of the Greek name Kira meaning "lord". US usage of the name reached a peak in 1995.

kiesha.meaning_en: Keisha is a female given name which has multiple meaning across languages like "Favourite", "Restored to the heart of God" or "Cassia Tree". In Hebrew, Keisha is likely derived from Keziah, a Hebrew name that means 'cinnamon bark'.

kiki.meaning_en: Kiki is a female given name, a unisex nickname and a surname.

kilian.meaning_en: Killian or Kilian, as a given name, is an Anglicized version of the Irish name Cillian. The name Cillian was borne by several early Irish saints including missionaries to Artois and Franconia and the author of the life of St Brigid.

kim.meaning_en: Kim is a unisex given name. It is also used as a diminutive or nickname for names such as Kimber, Kimberly, Kimberley, Kimball and Kimiko. In Kenya, it is short for various male names such as Kimutai and Kimani. In Vietnam, it is also a unisex name.
kim.meaning_fr: Kim est un prénom. Il s'agit d'un prénom mixte, donné dans différentes cultures et pays à travers le monde, comme en Europe et aux États-Unis. En 2024, Kim fait partie des 200 prénoms les plus populaires au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

kimball.meaning_en: Kimball is a given name derived from the English surname Kimball. Notable people and characters with the name include:

kimberlee.meaning_en: Kimberley is a unisex given name of Old English origin. John Wodehouse, 1st Earl of Kimberley, a place in Norfolk, England, popularised the name by giving it to a town in South Africa and a region in Australia.

kimberley.meaning_en: Kimberley is a unisex given name of Old English origin. John Wodehouse, 1st Earl of Kimberley, a place in Norfolk, England, popularised the name by giving it to a town in South Africa and a region in Australia.

kimberly.meaning_en: Kimberley is a unisex given name of Old English origin. John Wodehouse, 1st Earl of Kimberley, a place in Norfolk, England, popularised the name by giving it to a town in South Africa and a region in Australia.

kimia.meaning_en: Kimia is an Ancient Greek word and a feminine given name in Persian language. It means elixir of life, alchemy, or the philosopher’s stone.

kimiko.meaning_en: Kimiko is a feminine Japanese given name.

kinsley.meaning_en: Kinsley is a given name of English origin that is a transferred use of an English place name and surname.

kirstyn.meaning_en: Kirstyn is a feminine given name. Notable people with the name include: Kirstyn Goodger, New Zealand rower Kirstyn McDermott, Australian writer Victoria Kirstyn Williams, Welsh politician and former Minister for Education

klervi.meaning_fr: Klervi est un prénom féminin d’origine celtique.

kloe.meaning_en: Chloe, also spelled Chloë, Chlöe, or Chloé, is a feminine name meaning "blooming" or "fertility" in Greek. The name ultimately derives, through Greek, from the Proto-Indo-European root *ǵʰelh₃-, which relates to the colors yellow and green.

knox.meaning_en: Knox is a primarily masculine given name, a transferred use of a Scottish surname and place name from the Scots Gaelic "cnoc" or Old English cnocc, referring to a small hill with a round top.

konstantinos.meaning_en: Konstantinos or Constantinos is a Greek male given name.

kortney.meaning_en: Courtney is a unisex given name that is a transferred use of the Norman French surname and place name Courtenay, meaning "domain of Curtius". Courtenay was used as a given name for men beginning in the 17th century.

kory.meaning_en: Kory is a unisex given name. It is a male version of the name Cora, which has Greek origins and is the maiden name of the goddess Persephone. The name also can have origins from the Gaelic word coire, which means "in a cauldron", or "In a hollow".

kristi.meaning_en: Kristi is a female name of Latin origin, meaning "follower of Christ". Other spellings include Christie, Christy, Kristy, Kristie, Christi, and Kryste.

kristian.meaning_en: Kristian is a given name in several languages, and is a variant spelling of Christian.

kristin.meaning_en: Kristin is a female given name. It is a variation of Christine. It was the seventh most popular first name for girls born in Iceland between 2000 and 2004.

kristina.meaning_en: Kristina is a feminine given name and a variant of Christina. Notable people and characters with the name include:

The constituent parts are Χριστός, "Christ" or "Anointed", and φέρειν, "to bear"; hence the "Christ-bearer". As a given name, 'Christopher' has been in use since the 10th century.

kristy.meaning_en: Kristy is a female given name of Latin origin, which means "follower of Christ".

krys.meaning_en: Krys is a primarily masculine given name and a surname. Notable people with the name include:

krystle.meaning_en: Krystle is a feminine given name.

krystyna.meaning_en: Krystyn is a masculine Polish given name. Feminine equivalent: Krystyna.

krzysztof.meaning_en: Krzysztof is a Polish male given name, equivalent to English Christopher. The name became popular in the 15th century.

ksenia.meaning_en: Xenia is a female given name. The below sections list notable people with one of the variants of this given name. Related names include Oksana, Ksenija; Kseniya; Xénia, and Senja.

kurt.meaning_en: Kurt is a male given name in Germanic languages. Kurt originated as short forms of the Germanic Konrad/Conrad, depending on geographical usage, with meanings including counselor or advisor.

kwaku.meaning_en: Kwaku, is an Akan given name for male children born on Wednesday to the Akan and Ewe ethnic groups. Akan birthday names are associated with appellations that give an indication of the character of people born on such days.

kwame.meaning_en: Kwame is an Akan masculine given name among the Akan people in Ghana which is given to a boy born on Saturday. Traditionally in Ghana, a child would receive their Akan day name during their Outdooring, eight days after birth.
kwame.meaning_fr: Kouamé ou Kwame est un prénom akan, devenu aussi nom de famille. Il s'applique à un garçon né le samedi. Le prénom correspondant pour les filles est Amoin. Ama est le correspondant féminin de Kouamé/Kwamé chez les Abrons.

kwasi.meaning_en: Kwasi is an Akan day name given in Ghana to a boy born on a Sunday.

kwesi.meaning_en: Kwesi is a Ghanaian male given name. In the Ghanaian tradition of "day names", it refers to children born on a Sunday.

kye.meaning_en: Kye is a common variant of the names Kai, Kay or Kyle. Kye also occurs, via numerous spellings, in many languages. For example, "sea" in Hawaiian, and "narrow" or "slender" in Celtic.

kylan.meaning_en: Kylan is a unisex given name. Notable people with the given name include: Kylan Boswell, American basketball player Kylan Darnell, American internet personality and Miss Ohio Teen USA 2022 Kylan Hamdaoui, French rugby union player

kyle.meaning_en: Kyle is a unisex English-language given name. It is a transferred use of the Scottish surname Kyle or of place names such as Kyle, Ayrshire on the southwest coast of Scotland. Kyle is also a Scots word for a strait, derived from the Gaelic caol.

kylee.meaning_en: Kylie is an English feminine given name with multiple origins. It might be a variant of the name Kyle. It might be derived from the Aboriginal Australian Noongar word kiley, meaning 'curved, returning stick, boomerang'.

kylen.meaning_en: Kylen or Kylian is a variant of the name Kyle, and "means narrow or straight" Notable people with the name include: Kylen Granson, American football player Kylen Schulte, American female murder victim Kylian Hazard, Belgian football player Kylian Mbappé, French football player

kyler.meaning_en: Kyler is a masculine given name and an alternate spelling of Cuyler.

kylie.meaning_en: Kylie is an English feminine given name with multiple origins. It might be a variant of the name Kyle. It might be derived from the Aboriginal Australian Noongar word kiley, meaning 'curved, returning stick, boomerang'.

kylo.meaning_en: Kylo is a primarily masculine name usually given in reference to the Star Wars character Kylo Ren. Usage of the name has increased in the United States and United Kingdom and elsewhere.

kyndra.meaning_en: Kyndra is a feminine given name. Notable people with the name include: Kyndra Rotunda, American lawyer and writer Kyndra de St. Aubin, American broadcaster and sports commentator

kyra.meaning_en: Kyra is a feminine given name that may derive from the Greek word kurá or from Cyra, the feminine form of Cyrus.

kyran.meaning_en: Ciarán or Ciaran is a traditionally male given name of Irish and Scottish origin. It means "little dark one" or "little dark-haired one", produced by appending a diminutive suffix to ciar. It is the masculine version of the name Ciara.

kyrie.meaning_en: Kyrie is a unisex given name. Notable people with the name include: Kyrie Irving, American basketball player Kyrie Kristmanson, Canadian singer, songwriter, and musician Kyrie O'Connor, American writer and newspaper editor Kyrie Wilson, American gridiron football player

kyron.meaning_en: Kyron is a masculine given name.

lachlan.meaning_en: Lachlan is a masculine given name of Scottish Gaelic origin.

ladarius.meaning_en: LaDarius, Ladarius or La'Darius is a masculine given name of American origin which may either be a combination of the element la and the name Darius, which means 'hold firm the good', or a combination of the Greek word lados and the Latin word arius, which means 'princely' or 'noble'.

ladislas.meaning_en: Ladislav is a Czech, Slovak and Croatian variant of the Slavic name Vladislav. The female form of this name is Ladislava. Folk etymology occasionally links Ladislav with the Slavic goddess Lada.

ladji.meaning_en: Ladji is both a given name and a surname. Notable people with the name include: Ladji Diakité, Malian filmmaker Ladji Doucouré, French track and field athlete Ladji Keita, Senegalese footballer Ladji Mallé, Malian footballer Mekeme Tamla Ladji, Ivorian footballer

laetitia.meaning_en: Laetitia also Laëtitia and Lætitia, is a girl's name that is quite popular in the south of France and is also used in Québec. It is originally a Latin name Lætitia.

lafe.meaning_en: Lafe is a masculine given name or nickname, often a short form or hypocorism of Lafayette. People with the name include: Lafayette B.

lahcen.meaning_en: Lahcen is a masculine given name of Arabic origin. Notable people with the given name include:

laia.meaning_en: Laia is a shortened version of the Catalan feminine given name Eulàlia. Saint Eulalia is the patron saint of Barcelona, so her name and its derivatives are popular in Spain. Laia means "fair of speech" or "well spoken" in Greek.

laila.meaning_en: Leila, also spelt Layla, is a feminine given name of Arabic origin. It is popular in the Middle East, including Arabic-speaking countries, Iran, Turkey, and Palestine, as well as the Nordic countries, India and Anglosphere.

lailani.meaning_fr: Lailani est un patronyme très rare et également un prénom féminin d'origine polynésienne très rare.

lainey.meaning_en: Lainey is a usually feminine given name or nickname with multiple origins and multiple spelling variants.

laird.meaning_en: Laird is a masculine given name.

laith.meaning_en: Laith is a name that is an Arabic epithet for "lion". It also comes from a variant in Scottish from Leith, a placename element from Scottish Gaelic laith meaning "liquid", likely borrowed from Proto-Brythonic *lleɨθ "moist". See Water of Leith.

lakhdar.meaning_en: Lakhdar is an Arabic masculine given name and surname. Notable people with the name include:

lakshmi.meaning_en: Lakshmi, or Laxmi, is a name derived from Lakshmi, one of the principal goddesses in Hinduism.

lalie.meaning_fr: Lalie est un prénom féminin francophone.

lalla.meaning_en: Lalla is an honorific title meaning 'lady', 'my lady', 'miss' or 'mrs', used in the Maghreb to politely address or refer to any woman. In Morocco, if a woman is known to the speaker, they would address her as 'Lalla' followed by her personal or family name.
lalla.meaning_fr: Lalla ou Lella est un titre honorifique, signe de distinction et hagionyme donné au Maghreb aux femmes importantes ou issues de grandes familles. Le nom peut aussi être utilisé, de façon ponctuelle, en signe de respect.

lamar.meaning_en: Lamar or Lamarr is a given name.

lamia.meaning_en: Lamia, Lamyae or Lamiya is a feminine given name borne in Libyan-Greek mythology by a Libyan queen that transformed into a mythological creature. In Arabic it has been derived from the word which means "shining" or "radiant". The Bosnian form of the name is Lamija.

lamine.meaning_en: Lamine is a given name and a surname, a local form of Al-Amin. Notable people with the name include:

lan.meaning_en: Lan is a personal name, frequently used in Chinese and Vietnamese contexts as a feminine given name, which means "orchid" in Vietnamese.

lana.meaning_en: Lana is a female given name and short name of multiple origins.

lance.meaning_en: Lance is a given name. Notable people with the name include:

lancelot.meaning_fr: Lancelot est un prénom issu du vieux français lancel, « serviteur, assistant ». Il est porté par l'un des personnages de la légende arthurienne. Peu utilisé au Moyen Âge et à l'époque classique, l'historicisme des romantiques du XIXe siècle l'ont remis à la mode.

landa.meaning_en: Landa is a surname of multiple origins.

lander.meaning_fr: Lander est un prénom masculin basque. Variante de Leandro, proche de la forme latine de Leander, et provenant de la tradition sabinienne.

lanell.meaning_en: Lanell or LaNell is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Lanell Cofer, American politician and lawyer Lanell Tyrone Culver, American football player LaNell Williams, American physicist and virologist

lanette.meaning_en: Lanette is a feminine given name and variant of Lana. Notable people with the name include: Lanette Scheeline, American artist Lanette Phillips, American film and music video producer Lanette Prediger, Canadian skeleton racer

lanna.meaning_en: Lanna is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Lanna Commins, Thai singer Lanna Saunders, American actress

lantz.meaning_en: Lantz is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Lantz Lamback, American swimmer Lantz L'Amour, American musician

larisa.meaning_en: Larisa is a feminine given name.

larissa.meaning_en: Larissa is a female given name of Greek origin that is common in Eastern European nations of Orthodox church heritage.

larnell.meaning_en: Larnell is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Larnell Bruce, American murder victim Larnell Cole, English footballer Larnell Lewis, Canadian musician, producer, and educator

laron.meaning_en: Laron or LaRon is a given name. Notable people with the given name include: LaRon Byrd, American football player LaRon Landry, American football player Laron Profit, American basketball player and coach Laron Scott, American football player Juelz Santana, American rapper

lars.meaning_en: Lars is a common male name in Scandinavian countries and Germany.
lars.meaning_fr: Lars est un prénom masculin scandinave dérivé du latin Laurentius « celui qui porte le laurier ». Il est surtout porté au Danemark et en Norvège. Le prénom Lars est à l'origine du patronyme dano-norvégien Larsen et du patronyme suédois Larsson signifiant « Fils de Lars ».

laszlo.meaning_en: László is a Hungarian male given name and surname after the King-Knight Saint Ladislaus I of Hungary. It derives from Ladislav, a variant of Vladislav. The name has a history of being frequently anglicized as Leslie.

latasha.meaning_en: Latasha, LaTasha or La Tasha is a feminine given name, an English-language variant of Slavic Natasha, meaning 'Christmas Day'. It is often found among African Americans.

latif.meaning_en: Al-Latif is one of the names of God in Islam, meaning "kind". Latif can also be a masculine given name, as short form of Abdul Latif, meaning "servant of the Gentle". Its feminine form is Latifa. "Al-Latif" also means "The Subtle".

latifa.meaning_en: Latifa, Lateefa or Lateefah is a feminine Arabic given name which means "gentle", "nice" or "pleasant". It corresponds to the masculine Latif.

latika.meaning_en: Latika is a Hindu/Sanskrit Indian feminine given name, which means a "Beautiful Hindu Goddess".

latisha.meaning_en: Latisha is a feminine given name. It is similar to Larissa, Tisha or Letitia.

latonya.meaning_en: La Tonya or LaTonya is a feminine African-American given name from the root name Antonius used in the United States.

latoya.meaning_en: Latoya is a feminine given name. Other variations of Latoya include Letoya. It is considered to be an African-American name in the United States.

laura.meaning_en: Laura is a traditionally feminine given name in Europe and the Americas, of Latin origin, whose meaning is a metonym for a victor, and an early hypocorism from Laurel and Lauren.

lauralee.meaning_en: Lauralee is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Lauralee Bell, American soap opera actress Lauralee Martin, American businesswoman Lauralee Martinovich, 1997 New Zealand Miss World contestant

laurel.meaning_en: Laurel is a unisex given name. The name is of English origin from the Latin Lauras, referring to the laurel tree. Various names related to Laurel are Laura, Lauren, Lori, and Lorraine.

laureline.meaning_fr: Laureline est un prénom féminin composé formé par la juxtaposition de Laure et de Line.

lauren.meaning_en: Lauren is mostly a feminine given name. The name's meaning may be "laurel tree", "sweet of honor", or "wisdom". It is derived from the French name Laurence, a feminine version of Laurent, which is in turn derived from the Roman surname Laurentius.

laurence.meaning_en: Laurence is in modern use as an English masculine and a French feminine given name. The modern English masculine name is a variant of Lawrence and originates from a French form of the Latin Laurentius, a name meaning "man from Laurentum".

laurene.meaning_fr: Laurène est un prénom féminin, forme française du prénom anglais Lauren. Il a pour autres formes Lauren, Laurenn, Laureine, Laurenne, Laurena, Laurenna, Lorène, Loren, Lorenn, Lorenne, Lorena, Lorenna.

famous.name: Lorenzo de' Medici, Duke of Urbino

laurent.meaning_en: Laurent is a French masculine given name of Latin origin. It is used in France, Canada, and other French-speaking countries. The name was derived from the Roman surname Laurentius, which meant "from Laurentum".
laurent.meaning_fr: Laurent est un prénom français, nom de baptême popularisé par la renommée de saint Laurent de Rome.

lauretta.meaning_en: Lauretta is a feminine given name, which is probably derived from the name Laura. Notable people with the name include:

laurette.meaning_en: Laurette is a female given name, a diminutive of the name Laura.

lauriane.meaning_fr: Lauriane est un prénom féminin. Laurentius, dérivé de laurus, signifiant celui qui porte le laurier, en référence à la couronne de laurier dont on coiffait la tête des poètes et généraux victorieux à l'époque romaine.

laurianne.meaning_fr: Lauriane est un prénom féminin. Laurentius, dérivé de laurus, signifiant celui qui porte le laurier, en référence à la couronne de laurier dont on coiffait la tête des poètes et généraux victorieux à l'époque romaine.

laurinda.meaning_en: Lorinda and Laurinda are female first names. Notable people with the names include:

laurine.meaning_fr: Le prénom Laurine est un prénom féminin dérivé de Laure.

lauris.meaning_en: Lauris is a given name. In Latvia, it is exclusively a masculine name. In other regions, it can be both a masculine and feminine given name. Individuals bearing the name Lauris include:

lavender.meaning_en: Lavender is a given name often given in reference to the flowering plant or to the light purple color. It is derived from the Old French word lavendre from the Latin lavendula.

lavina.meaning_en: Lavina is a feminine given name. It is a variant of the name Lavinia, a name of Etruscan origin and a figure from Roman mythology. Lavina is a popular name for women and girls among the Amish.

lavonne.meaning_en: LaVonne is a name, mostly used as a feminine name in the United States, though variants like Lavon and LaVaughn are used more broadly. American First Lady Michelle Obama's middle name is LaVaughn; it was her paternal grandmother's first name.

lawrence.meaning_en: Lawrence is a masculine given name. It is an Anglicisation of the French Laurent, which is in turn derived from the Latin Laurentius or Old Greek Lavrenti. Pet forms of Lawrence include Larry, Lawrie and, less commonly, Law.

lawson.meaning_en: Lawson is a masculine given name borne by: Lawson Aschenbach, American racing driver Lawson Butt, British actor and director of the silent era Lawson Craddock, American former road and track racing cyclist Lawson Crouse, Canadian ice hockey player in the National Hockey League Lawson D'Ath, English footballer Lawson Duncan, American retired tennis player Lawson D.

layal.meaning_en: Layal, sometimes romanized as Layale, is an Arabic feminine given name.

layan.meaning_en: Layan is a feminine Arabic given name meaning "prosperity life", "soft, gentle." Leen is a related name. Both are among the most popular names given to newborn girls in the Arab world in the past decade.

layla.meaning_en: Leila, also spelt Layla, is a feminine given name of Arabic origin. It is popular in the Middle East, including Arabic-speaking countries, Iran, Turkey, and Palestine, as well as the Nordic countries, India and Anglosphere.

lazaro.meaning_en: Lázaro is a Spanish or Portuguese-based given name or surname. Notable people with the name include:

lea.meaning_fr: Léa est un prénom féminin fêté le 22 mars. Prénom hébraïque, Léa, ou Leah, est la cousine et première femme de Jacob dans l'Ancien Testament. D’abord promise à Esaü, qu’elle n’aimait pas, Léa convainquit son père, Laban, de lui permettre d’épouser Jacob, qui travaillait chez eux.

leah.meaning_en: Leah is a feminine given name of Hebrew origin. Its meaning is often deciphered as "delicate" or "weary". The name can be traced back to the Biblical matriarch Leah, one of the two wives of Jacob.

leana.meaning_en: Leana is a feminine given name. Notable people with the name include: Leana de Bruin, South African and New Zealand netball player Leana Wen, American physician and public health advocate
leana.meaning_fr: Léane ou Léanne est un prénom féminin fêté le 22 mars. Il peut s'agir de la contraction du prénom aujourd'hui désuet Léa-Anne.

leander.meaning_en: Leander is a given name. The most famous bearer of the name is mythological, from the story of Hero and Leander. Leandro is the Italian, Portuguese, and Spanish version of this name.

leandra.meaning_en: Leandra is a feminine form of the Greek name Leander. It is in use in Italian, Portuguese and Spanish and was among the top 10 most popular names for newborn girls in Albania in recent years.

leandre.meaning_en: Léandre is both a given name and a surname. Notable people with the name include:

leandro.meaning_en: Leandro is a masculine Italian, Portuguese and Spanish given name. The name is a variant of two other names: Leander, a character in the Greek myth Hero and Leander, and Lysander, a relative of the Greek name Alexander. There's also a variation of the name in French: Léandre.

leanne.meaning_fr: Léane ou Léanne est un prénom féminin fêté le 22 mars. Il peut s'agir de la contraction du prénom aujourd'hui désuet Léa-Anne.

leatrice.meaning_en: Leatrice is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Leatrice Eiseman, an American color specialist. Leatrice Joy, an American actress. Leatrice Morin, an American politician.

lee.meaning_en: Lee is a unisex given name from the English word 'lee'. It is also used as a surname, often confused with the Old English surname and given name leah, which evolved to 'leigh' in Middle English, and present-day 'lea' with the same meaning.

leeann.meaning_en: Leeann is a given name. Notable people with the surname include: Leeann Chin, Chinese-born American restaurateur Leeann Dempster, chief executive of Hibernian F.C. Leeann Tweeden, American radio broadcaster, model and sports commentator

leeanna.meaning_en: Leeanna or LeeAnna is a feminine given name. Notable people with the name include: Leeanna Walsman, New Zealand actress Leeanna Pendergast, Canadian politician LeeAnna Warner, American girl

leela.meaning_en: Leela or 'Lila' is a name of Sanskrit origin and related to Hindu religion and philosophy. Sanskrit word leela/lila can be translated as "play or divine play", as in the Hindu philosophical concept of leela between Radha and Krishna. It can also mean 'act of God'.

leeloo.meaning_fr: Lilou est un prénom féminin. Il est fêté le 15 mars qui est le jour de la sainte Louise de Marillac.

leelou.meaning_fr: Lilou est un prénom féminin. Il est fêté le 15 mars qui est le jour de la sainte Louise de Marillac.

leen.meaning_en: Leen is a name of multiple origins. It is a popular Arabic name for girls meaning “tender” and “delicate”. It is spelled لِينٌ in Arabic and has been translated into English in multiple spellings. It can also be a unisex given name of Dutch origin.

leena.meaning_en: Leena is a feminine given name. It is a variant spelling of Lina and Lena. It is a direct Quranic Arabic name, meaning "young palm tree", or figuratively "tender, young, delicate". In Persian, it means "light", "a ray of sunlight" or "beautiful girl".

leia.meaning_en: Leia is a variant of the Hebrew Leah, meaning languid in several languages, including Koine Greek and Portuguese. It is commonly used in reference to Leia Organa, a character from the Star Wars franchise who first appeared in the film Star Wars: A New Hope.

leif.meaning_en: Leif is a male given name of Scandinavian origin. It is derived from the Old Norse name Leifr, meaning "heir", "descendant".

leilani.meaning_en: Leilani is a Hawaiian given name meaning "heavenly garland of flowers" or "royal child". The Hawaiian word lei refers to flowers and lani to the sky or heavens, with an association to royalty.
leilani.meaning_fr: Leilani est un prénom polynésien d'origine hawaiienne qui peut se traduire par « couronne céleste » o u « couronne de fleurs ». Étymologiquement, ce prénom vient de lei qui signifie « couronne » et lani qui signifie « ciel » en hawaïen. Son équivalent paumotu est Heirani.

leisa.meaning_en: Leisa is a feminine given name. Notable people with the name include: Leisa Goddard, Australian television journalist Leisa Goodman, American Scientologist Leisa King, English field hockey player

leisha.meaning_en: Leisha is a feminine given name of Old Germanic origin, a variant of Alice via Alicia. It may also be linked with the name of the male prophet Elisha in the Old Testament. The meaning of Leisha is noble or exalted.

lemuel.meaning_fr: Lemuel est un prénom masculin hébreu signifiant « dévoué à Dieu » ou « appartenant à Dieu ».

lena.meaning_fr: Léna est un prénom féminin fêté le 11 juillet et le 18 août. Il a pour variante Lenna, Lena ou Leena. Le prénom Léna serait un dérivé d'Hélène, nom dont l'étymologie est obscure mais qui est en relation avec le peuple grec et peut-être avec le soleil.

leni.meaning_en: Leni is both a given name and a surname. Notable people with the name include:

lenna.meaning_en: Lenna is a female given name. It is the English and Estonian female form of the Old High German male name Leonhard containing the prefix levon and the suffix hardu. The name has come to mean "lion strength", "lion-strong", or "lion-hearted". It may also be from the Latin Leo.

lennie.meaning_en: Lenny or Lennie is a given name. Notable people with the name include:

lenny.meaning_en: Lenny or Lennie is a given name. Notable people with the name include:

leny.meaning_fr: Lény est un prénom masculin dérivé de Léonard qui signifie « fort comme un lion ». Il est fêté le 6 novembre.

leo.meaning_en: Léo is a proper noun in French, meaning "lion". Its etymological root lies in the Latin word Leo.

leon.meaning_fr: Léon est un prénom masculin issu du latin Leo qui signifie lion. Il est généralement porté en référence à saint Léon le Grand, pape de Rome au milieu du Ve siècle et Père de l'Église, fêté le 10 novembre.

leona.meaning_en: Leona is a female given name derived from the Latin word leo for "lion". People and fictional characters named Leona include:

leonard.meaning_en: Leonard is a common English surname and a masculine given name. The given name and surname originate from the Old High German Leonhard containing the prefix levon from the Greek Λέων through the Latin Leo, and the suffix hardu.
leonard.meaning_fr: Léonard est un prénom français d'origine germanique, fêté le 6 novembre.

leonardo.meaning_en: Leonardo is a masculine given name, the Italian, Spanish, and Portuguese equivalent of the English, German, and Dutch name, Leonard. Notable people with the name include:

leoncio.meaning_en: Leoncio or Leôncio is a given name.

leonid.meaning_en: Leonid is a Slavic version of the given name Leonidas. The French version is Leonide.

leonie.meaning_en: Leonie or Léonie or Leonie is a Latin-origin feminine given name meaning "lioness", from the masculine personal name Leon. It is rare as a surname.
leonie.meaning_fr: Léonie est un prénom féminin issu de Léon, prénom masculin, dont l'origine latine "leo" signifie Lion. La fête des Léonie est le 10 novembre.

famous.name: Eleanor of Aragon, Queen of Castile

leonora.meaning_en: Leonora is a feminine given name which is a variation of Eleanor. It was relatively common in the 19th century in Western countries, ranking as the 314th most popular female given name in the United States in 1880. The name has declined in popularity but remains in use.

leontine.meaning_fr: Léontine est un prénom féminin. Léontine Lippmann est une personnalité française. Léontine Massart est une actrice belge. Léontine Ponga est une femme politique néo-calédonienne. Léontine, personnage issu d'une série de films réalisés par Romeo Bosetti.

leopold.meaning_en: Leopold is the modern form of the Germanic name Luitbald, composed of two stems, common to Germanic names. The first part is related to Old High German liut meaning "people", the second part bald or balt is of Germanic origin and means "brave".

famous.name: Clémentine of Orléans, Princess of Koháry

leroy.meaning_fr: Leroy est un patronyme utilisé comme prénom d'abord en Amérique, ainsi que plus rarement en France depuis la fin du XXe siècle, en raison de l'influence américaine depuis la fin du XXe siècle.

lesia.meaning_en: Lesia is a feminine given name.

lesley.meaning_en: Leslie is a surname and given name, derived from the name of Clan Leslie. The name may also be spelled Lesley. The name derives from a placename in Aberdeenshire, perhaps an anglicisation of an originally Gaelic leas celyn "holly-garden".

lesli.meaning_en: Lesli is a feminine given name. Notable people with the name include: Lesli Brea, former Major League Baseball player Lesli Kay, Emmy Award-winning American actress Lesli Linka Glatter, American film and television director Lesli Margherita, American stage and screen actress

lester.meaning_en: Lester is an ancient Anglo-Saxon surname and given name.

leta.meaning_en: Leta is a feminine first name.

letitia.meaning_en: Letitia is a feminine given name, of Latin origin meaning "joy, gladness". The name Letitia has many variants, including but not limited to: Lætitia from lætus, Letja, Letizia, Leticia, Letisya and Letisha or Latisha.

letizia.meaning_en: Letizia is a predominantly Italian feminine given name.

lev.meaning_en: Lev is a traditional Slavic male name meaning "lion," derived from the Latin leo. It is strongly associated with strength, nature, and historic figures, often translated as Leo or Leon in Western languages.

levi.meaning_en: Levi is a masculine given name of Hebrew origin. It is the name of the biblical figure Levi, son of Jacob and founder of the Israelite tribe of Levi. The name is derived from the Hebrew verb לוה, meaning "to join" or "connect". Levi may refer to:

levin.meaning_en: Levin is a masculine given name. It is a modern German version of the Old English name Leofwine or the Old German Leobwin or Liebwin, meaning "dear friend." Dutch variants include Lieven and Lievin. A rare modern English variant is Lewin.

lew.meaning_en: Lew is the usual shortened form of Lewis or Llywelyn when they are used as first names in English. It can also be found in Slavic languages as a translation of Latin name Leon, where it may be written as "Lew" or "Lev".

lewis.meaning_en: Lewis is a masculine English-language given name. It was coined as an anglicisation of given names in other languages. "Lewis" has been used to anglicise the Irish name "Lugaid", the German name "Ludwig", and the French name "Louis".

lewys.meaning_en: Lewys is a Welsh masculine given name.

lex.meaning_en: Lex is a given name. It can refer to a shortened version of Alexander or Alexis.

lexi.meaning_en: Lexi and Lexie are given names, as well as nicknames of people with names starting with "Alex" or another variation of the name "Lex". Both forms usually, but not exclusively, refer to a female name. Lexy is a similar name. Notable people with these names include:

lexie.meaning_en: Lexi and Lexie are given names, as well as nicknames of people with names starting with "Alex" or another variation of the name "Lex". Both forms usually, but not exclusively, refer to a female name. Lexy is a similar name. Notable people with these names include:

leyla.meaning_en: Leila, also spelt Layla, is a feminine given name of Arabic origin. It is popular in the Middle East, including Arabic-speaking countries, Iran, Turkey, and Palestine, as well as the Nordic countries, India and Anglosphere.

li.meaning_en: Li is the pinyin and Wade–Giles romanization of several distinct Chinese surnames that are written with different characters in Chinese. Li 李 is by far the most common among them, shared by 93 million people in China, and more than 100 million worldwide.

lia.meaning_en: Lia is a feminine given name. In the Spanish-speaking world, it is accented Lía. In English-speaking countries, the name may be a variant of Leah or Lea.

liana.meaning_en: Liana is a female given name. It is a short form of Eliana, Juliana, Liliana, Liyana and other names that end in -liana. It can also be a botanical name derived from Liana. In French Liana comes from the word liane, this name means "to climb like a vine".
liana.meaning_fr: Léane ou Léanne est un prénom féminin fêté le 22 mars. Il peut s'agir de la contraction du prénom aujourd'hui désuet Léa-Anne.

libbie.meaning_en: Libby as a feminine given name is typically a diminutive form of Elizabeth, which is less commonly spelled 'Libbie' or 'Libi'. In recent years, it has been used as a shortened version of the name Liberty.

lidia.meaning_en: Lidia is a feminine name. It is the Greek, Italian, Polish, Romanian, and Spanish transcription of the name Lydia.

liesl.meaning_en: Liesl is a feminine given name of German origin. It is a diminutive of Lieselotte and Elisabeth.

lili.meaning_en: Lili is a feminine given name.

lilia.meaning_en: Lilia is a feminine given name.

lilian.meaning_en: Lillian, also spelled Lilian, Lilliann, or Lilliane, is a female given name. Its origin is the Latin word Lilium. In French, Lilian is the male form of the name, while Liliane is the female form.

liliana.meaning_en: Liliana is a form of Lillian used in various countries. Notable people and fictional characters with the name include:

liliane.meaning_en: Liliane is a given name for women, most often used where French is spoken, a variant of Lillian and Lily.

lilianna.meaning_en: Liliana is a form of Lillian used in various countries. Notable people and fictional characters with the name include:

lilibeth.meaning_en: Lilibeth is a feminine given name. It often a nickname for the given name Elizabeth. It can also be a combination of the names Lily and Beth. The name has historically been particularly well-used among Hispanic cultural groups.
lilibeth.meaning_fr: Élisabeth est un prénom féminin d'origine hébraïque.

lilith.meaning_en: Lilith is a feminine given name sometimes given in reference to Lilith, a character in Jewish folklore who was said to be the first wife of the first man Adam who disobeyed him, was banished from the Garden of Eden, and who became a mythical she-demon.

lilla.meaning_en: Lilla is a female given name, derived from Elizabeth.

lillian.meaning_en: Lillian, also spelled Lilian, Lilliann, or Lilliane, is a female given name. Its origin is the Latin word Lilium. In French, Lilian is the male form of the name, while Liliane is the female form.

lilly.meaning_en: Lilly is a feminine given name which is borne by:

lily.meaning_en: Lily is a feminine given name usually derived from lily, the flower. The name became particularly popular along with other flower names for girls during the 1800s and early 1900s. The lily also has associations with and has been symbolic of innocence and purity in Christian art.

lilyana.meaning_en: Liliana is a form of Lillian used in various countries. Notable people and fictional characters with the name include:

lina.meaning_en: Lina is a feminine given name with many origins in different nations.
lina.meaning_fr: Lina ou Lyna est un prénom féminin d'origine latine venant de « linum » qui signifie « lin ». Lyna est également un prénom féminin grec, signifiant messagère.

linda.meaning_en: Linda is an English feminine given name that has been widespread in the English-speaking world since the end of the nineteenth century.

linden.meaning_en: Linden is an English given name referring to the Linden tree. In the United States, the name was somewhat popular as a boys name from the 1930s to the 1960s.

lindley.meaning_en: Lindley is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Lindley Beckworth, U.S.

lindsay.meaning_en: Lindsay is both an English and Scottish surname and a given name.

lindsey.meaning_en: Lindsay is both an English and Scottish surname and a given name.

line.meaning_en: Line is a female given name, most common in Denmark, Norway, and France. It may be a short form of names which end in -line, like Caroline. Variants include Ine, in Norway, and Aline, Lina, and Lyna, in France.

linnea.meaning_en: Linnéa or Linnea is a female given name of Swedish origin. It has two derivations, both of which are linked to the famous 18th-century Swedish scientist Carl Linnaeus, who was ennobled as Carl von Linné later in life.
linnea.meaning_fr: Linnea ou Linnéa est un prénom féminin dérivé de Linnaea, féminisation du nom latin de Carl von Linné et nom scientifique de la Linnée boréale, une fleur des bois. Il est répandu en Scandinavie et aux États-Unis.

linsey.meaning_en: Lindsay is both an English and Scottish surname and a given name.

linton.meaning_en: Linton is a surname of English and Scottish origin. It is also used as a unisex given name.

mairead.meaning_en: Mairead, also spelt Maighread, is a feminine given name, the Scottish Gaelic equivalent of Margaret. The Irish form is spelt Mairéad, Máiréad, Maighréad, or Máighréad. Maisie is the pet form of Mairead.

maisie.meaning_en: Maisie, also spelt Maisy or other minor variations, is a feminine given name. It is a pet form of the Scottish Gaelic name Mairead or the Irish name Mairéad, which are the equivalent of the English name Margaret.

maisy.meaning_en: Maisie, also spelt Maisy or other minor variations, is a feminine given name. It is a pet form of the Scottish Gaelic name Mairead or the Irish name Mairéad, which are the equivalent of the English name Margaret.

maite.meaning_en: Maite also spelled Mayté, Maytee, Maytte or Maïté, is a female given name of Iberian origin popular throughout the Hispanic world and Brazil. The name is the Basque word for "love", though it can also be a nickname for "María Teresa" and "María Esther".
maite.meaning_fr: Maite est un prénom féminin d'origine basque. Mais aussi un nom commun qui signifie « bien-aimé », « chéri », « chérie », « amour » ou un adjectif qui signifie « cher », « chère ».

maizie.meaning_en: Maisie, also spelt Maisy or other minor variations, is a feminine given name. It is a pet form of the Scottish Gaelic name Mairead or the Irish name Mairéad, which are the equivalent of the English name Margaret.

maja.meaning_en: Maja is a Slavic and German feminine given name.

major.meaning_en: Major is an English-language given name, which often causes confusion with the military rank of the same name. People with the name or nickname include:

makayla.meaning_en: Michaela is a female given name. It is a female form of the Hebrew name Michael, which means "Who is like God". As of 2008, it was 357th in rank for newborn girls in the United States, and 325th in England and Wales.

maki.meaning_en: Maki is a very common feminine Japanese given name which can also be used as a surname.

makoto.meaning_en: Makoto is a unisex Japanese name, although it is more commonly used by males. As a noun, Makoto means "sincerity" or "truth".

maksim.meaning_en: Maxim is an epicene first name of Roman origin mainly given to males.

maksym.meaning_en: Maxim is an epicene first name of Roman origin mainly given to males.

maksymilian.meaning_en: Maksymilian is the Polish form of the male given name Maximilian.

malachi.meaning_en: Malachi is a male given name of Hebrew origin מַלְאָכִי‎ meaning "my messenger". The name is popularized by the Jewish prophet Malachi in the Bible.

malachy.meaning_en: Malachy is a given name of Irish origin. Notable bearers of the name include:

malak.meaning_en: Malak is a given name. It derives from the Semitic word for "angel".. The plural of malak is ملائكه malaa`ikahם malakim in Hebrew, and መላዕክት mala`ikt in Ge'ez. In Arabic and Turkish, it is also used as a given name. The Turkish form of the name is Melek.

malcolm.meaning_en: Malcolm, Malcom, Máel Coluim, or Maol Choluim is a Scottish Gaelic given name meaning "devotee of Saint Columba". Maol "shavenhead" is Scottish Gaelic for monk.

malick.meaning_fr: Malik est un prénom arabe signifiant « roi ». Son féminin est Malika, signifiant « reine ».

maliha.meaning_en: Maliha is a feminine given name. The name definitely stems from the Arabic adjective singular "malāḥah مَلَاحَة" which the plural variant form is "malīḥ مَليح" or "milāḥ مِلَاح", meaning "state of being gorgeous or graceful" or "state of beauty, grace, elegance".

malik.meaning_en: Malik, Maleek, Malek or Malyk is a given name of West Asian Semitic origin.
malik.meaning_fr: Malik est un prénom arabe signifiant « roi ». Son féminin est Malika, signifiant « reine ».

malika.meaning_en: Malika is the Arabic word for 'queen' and the feminine form of the name Malik.

malin.meaning_en: Malin is a Swedish form of the feminine given name Magdalene.

malo.meaning_en: Malo is a given name of the following notable people: Théophile-Malo de La Tour d'Auvergne-Corret, Breton military and linguist Charles Malo François Lameth, French politician and soldier Tez Cadey, French-American DJ, record producer and songwriter Malo Gusto, French football player Scribe, New Zealand rapper Malo Quéméneur, Breton slalom canoeist Malo Vaga, Samoan football manager and referee
malo.meaning_fr: Malo est un prénom masculin breton, surtout connu grâce aux villes de Saint-Malo et Malo-les-Bains. Les Malo sont honorés le 15 novembre en la mémoire de saint Malo, l'un des fondateurs de la Bretagne. Il naquit dans le Gwent au pays de Galles.

malvin.meaning_en: Malvin is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Malvin R.

malvina.meaning_en: Malvina is a feminine given name derived from the Scottish Gaelic Mala-mhìn, meaning "smooth brow". It was invented by the 18th century Scottish poet James Macpherson.

mamadou.meaning_en: Mamadou is a common given name in West Africa among predominantly Muslim ethnic groups such as the Mandé and Wolof people. It is a variant of the Arabic name Muhammad. In Francophone countries, the name is sometimes used as a slur towards people of African descent.

mame.meaning_en: Mame is a Senegalese given name.

mamoudou.meaning_en: Mamoudou is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Mamoudou Athie, American actor Mamoudou Hanne, French, former Malian, sprint athlete Mamoudou Kondo, Malian footballer Mamoudou Mara, Guinean footballer Mamoudou Sy, French basketball player

manasseh.meaning_en: Manasses or Manasseh is a biblical Hebrew name for men. It is the given name of seven individuals of the Bible, the name of a tribe of Israel, and the name of one of the apocryphal writings. The name is also used in the modern world.
manasseh.meaning_fr: Manassès est un prénom masculin français d'origine hébraïque, porté surtout à l'époque médiévale.

manav.meaning_en: Manav is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Manav Gohil, Indian actor Manav Gupta, Indian artist Manav Dayal I.C.Sharma, Indian philosopher, saint, and yogi Manav Kaul, Indian theatre director, playwright, actor and film-maker Manav Vij, Indian actor

mandeep.meaning_en: Mandeep or Mandip is a given name. It's commonly given to individuals of Hindu and Sikh background. It means "enlightened", "mind full of light", "light of the mind", or "light of heart and mind".

mandy.meaning_en: Mandy can be used as a given name, a diminutive, or a nickname, for both female and male genders. It is often used as a diminutive of the female names Amanda and Miranda, as well as being a given name in its own right.

manfred.meaning_en: Manfred is a given name of Alemannic origin, being derived from man and fridu, meaning "man of peace".

manish.meaning_en: Manish is a common Hindu masculine given name that literally means "The God of the Mind" or the one who has controlled and mastered one's mind, derived from the Sanskrit words "man" which means Mind and "ish" which refers to God or master.

manisha.meaning_en: Manisha is a Sanskrit term meaning intelligence and desire.

manley.meaning_en: Manley is the given name of: M. Caldwell Butler, U.S.

mannie.meaning_en: Mannie is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Mannie Fresh,, currently an artist and hip-hop producer who records for Def Jam South Mannie Garcia, American freelance photojournalist currently based in Washington, D.C.

manon.meaning_en: Manon is a Welsh, French and Dutch feminine given name. Its meaning in Welsh is: 'beautiful queen' and in French, it is a diminutive of the name Marie. Notable people with the name include:

mansour.meaning_en: Mansour; also spelled Mounsor, Monsur, Mansoor, Manser, Mansur, Mansyur or Mensur, is a male Arabic name that means "He who is victorious", from the Arabic root naṣr, meaning "victory." The first known bearer of the name was Mansur ibn Sarjun, Byzantine governor of Damascus in the late 500s and early 600s, who surrendered the city to the Muslims in 635.
mansour.meaning_fr: Mansour — parfois transcrit Mansoor — est un prénom masculin, parfois un nom de famille, arabe signifiant « victorieux par aide divine », littéralement « béni de Dieu pour être victorieux ». Le nom provient de la racine arabe victoire.

manuel.meaning_en: Manuel is a masculine given name originating in the Hebrew name Immanuel, which means "God with us." It was reportedly brought from the Byzantine Empire to Western Europe, mainly Germany, Portugal and Spain, where it has been used since at least the 13th century.

manuela.meaning_en: Manuela or Manuéla is a feminine Portuguese, Spanish and Italian given name. The name is a variant of the masculine "Manuel", which is in turn derived from the Hebrew name "Emanuel", meaning "God is with us".

manuelle.meaning_en: Manuelle is both a given name and a surname. Notable people with the name include: Manuelle Daumas, French singer-songwriter and performer Manuelle Gautrand, French architect Víctor Manuelle, Puerto Rican salsa singer and songwriter

mao.meaning_en: Mao is a unisex Japanese given name.

marcel.meaning_en: Marcel is an Occitan form of the Ancient Roman origin male given name Marcellus, which in Latin means "Belonging to Mars". The feminine counterpart of the name is Marcelle.

marcia.meaning_en: Marcia is a female given name of Italian origin, derived from Latin meaning "dedicated to Mars". It is a female form of Marcius. Marcy/Marcie is a short form. Notable people and characters with this name include:

marcin.meaning_en: Marcin is a male given name or surname. It is the Polish equivalent of the English name Martin; the female version is Martyna.
marcin.meaning_fr: Martin est un prénom français, nom de baptême popularisé par la renommée de Martin de Tours. Martin est aussi utilisé comme pseudonyme. Le prénom est devenu le nom de famille le plus répandu en France : Martin.

marcio.meaning_en: Márcio is a Brazilian or Portuguese male personal name Márcio Melo, general with the Brazilian air force Márcio Rezende de Freitas, Brazilian football referee Márcio Bittencourt, Brazilian football defensive midfielder and coach Márcio Santos, Brazilian football player, 1994 World Champion Márcio Garcia, Brazilian actor and television host Márcio Rogério de Andrade, Brazilian football forward Márcio May, Brazilian cyclist Márcio Araújo, Brazilian beach volleyball player Márcio Amoroso, Brazilian football forward Márcio Carlsson, Brazilian tennis player Márcio Cazorla, Brazilian football goalkeeper Márcio Mixirica, Brazilian football striker Márcio Cruz, Brazilian martial artist Márcio dos Santos Gaia, Brazilian football defender Márcio Careca, Brazilian rugby player Márcio Nobre, Brazilian football striker and manager Márcio Abreu, Portuguese football winger Márcio de Oliveira Barros, Brazilian football striker Márcio Luiz Silva Lopes Santos Souza, Brazilian football goalkeeper Márcio Augusto dos Santos Aguiar, Brazilian football goalkeeper Márcio Torres, Brazilian tennis player Márcio Luiz Adurens, Brazilian football attacking midfielder Márcio Diogo, Brazilian football attacking midfielder Márcio Rafael Ferreira de Souza,, Brazilian football right back Márcio Azevedo, Brazilian football left back Márcio Marcelo Leite Júnior, Brazilian football central defender Márcio Rosa, Cape Verdean football goalkeeper

marco.meaning_en: Marco is an Italian masculine given name of Etruscan and Latin origin, derived from Marcus. It derives from the Roman god Mars.

marcos.meaning_en: Marcos is a Spanish and Portuguese masculine given name of Latin origin derived from the name Marcus. Markos is the Greek equivalent, while Marco is the Italian equivalent. Marcos or Markos may refer to:

marcus.meaning_en: Marcus is a masculine given name of Ancient Roman pre-Christian origin derived either from Etruscan Marce of unknown meaning or referring to the god Mars. Mars was identified as the Roman god of war.

marek.meaning_en: Marek is a West Slavic masculine given name, the equivalent of Mark in English. It is also the 46th most popular masculine given name in Estonian. Notable people bearing the name Marek include:

maren.meaning_en: Maren is a Germanic feminine given name that originated as a Danish variant of the name Marina. Maren is also a surname. Notable people with the name include:

margaret.meaning_en: Margaret is a feminine given name, which means "pearl". It is of Latin origin, via Ancient Greek and ultimately from Old Iranian. It has been an English name since the 11th century, and remained popular throughout the Middle Ages.

famous.name: Archduchess Margaretha, Archduchess Karl Ludwig of Austria

margarete.meaning_en: Margarete is a German feminine given name. It is derived from Ancient Greek margarites, meaning "the pearl". Via the Latin margarita, it arrived in the German sprachraum.

margaretta.meaning_en: Margaretta is a feminine given name. It derives from Latin, where it came from the Greek word margaritari, meaning pearl, which was borrowed from the Persians. It is cognate with Margaret, Marguerite, and Margarita.

margarita.meaning_en: Margarita is a feminine given name in Latin and Eastern European languages. In Latin it came from the Greek word margaritari, meaning pearl, which was borrowed from the Persians. The daisy flower is called margarita in Spanish, Greek and other languages.

margaux.meaning_fr: Margot, Margaux ou Margault est un prénom féminin français, forme hypocoristique et contractée du prénom Marguerite. Il signifie « perle ».

marge.meaning_en: Marge is a feminine given name, often a shortened form of Marjorie, Margot, or Margaret. Notable people with the name include:

margery.meaning_en: Margery is a female given name derived from Margaret, which can also be spelled as Marjorie, Margaery, Margery or Marjory. From the Old French, the Middle English forms of Margaret equally derive from the Greek for pearl.

famous.name: Archduchess Margaretha, Archduchess Karl Ludwig of Austria

margherita.meaning_en: Margherita is an Italian feminine given name. It also is a surname. As a word, in Italian it means "daisy". The name is related to Margaret.

margit.meaning_en: Margit is a feminine given name, a version of Margaret.
margit.meaning_fr: Marguerite est un prénom féminin français. Il est principalement fêté le 20 juillet.

margo.meaning_en: Margo or Margó is a female given name, a form of Margaret. In Estonia, it is mainly a male given name. Notable people or characters named Margo include:

margot.meaning_en: Margot is a feminine given name, a French diminutive of Marguerite that has long been used as an independent name. Variant spellings in use include Margo and Margaux. It is also occasionally a surname.
margot.meaning_fr: Margot, Margaux ou Margault est un prénom féminin français, forme hypocoristique et contractée du prénom Marguerite. Il signifie « perle ».

famous.name: Margaret of France, Duchess of Berry

marguerite.meaning_en: Marguerite is a French female given name, from which the English name Margaret is derived. Marguerite derives via Latin and Greek μαργαρίτης, meaning "pearl". It is also a French name for the ox-eye daisy flower. Those with the name include:
marguerite.meaning_fr: Marguerite est un prénom féminin français. Il est principalement fêté le 20 juillet.

margy.meaning_en: Margy is a feminine given name.

mari.meaning_en: Mari is a feminine given name in the Breton, Japanese, Syriac-Aramaic language, Armenian, Estonian, Georgian, Hungarian, Finnish, Welsh, Swedish and Norwegian languages. It is also a devotional given name in Tamil.
mari.meaning_fr: Mari est un prénom breton équivalent de Marie, parfois Mai par contraction, orthographié Maï en français.

maria.meaning_en: Maria is a feminine given name. It is given in many languages influenced by Christianity.

mariah.meaning_en: Mariah is a variation of the feminine name Maria. Its use in an English-language context suggests the pronunciation mə-RY-ə, i.e. the traditional English pronunciation of Latin Maria.

mariam.meaning_fr: Mariam est une des graphies de Maryam, la mère de ʿĪsā, c'est ainsi qu'est appelé Jésus dans le Coran et la tradition musulmane.

mariame.meaning_en: Mariame is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Mariame Clément, French opera director Mariame Gbané, Ivorian basketball player Mariame Kaba, American activist Mariame Kolga, Ivorian basketball player Mariame Sylla, Ivorian basketball player

marian.meaning_en: Marian is a unisex given name. As a feminine given name, it is a variant spelling of Marion, a French diminutive form of Marie that has been used by English–speakers since the Middle Ages. It has also sometimes been considered a combination of the names Mary and Ann.
marian.meaning_fr: Marian ou Marián est un prénom slave que l'on trouve surtout en Slovaquie, en Roumanie et en Pologne. Marian est aussi un prénom féminin espagnol, équivalent de Marianne.

mariana.meaning_en: Mariana is a feminine given name of Latin origin. The masculine equivalent is Marianus, which is derived from Marius. Marianus became Mariano in Italian, Spanish and Portuguese.

mariane.meaning_en: Marianne is a female name. It is the French version of the Greek Mariamne, which is a variant of Mary, ultimately from the Hebrew Miriam, Mirjam. In late Greek Marianna was used. In 18th-century France, Marianne became a popular name as a variant of Marian and Marie.

marianna.meaning_en: Marianne is a female name. It is the French version of the Greek Mariamne, which is a variant of Mary, ultimately from the Hebrew Miriam, Mirjam. In late Greek Marianna was used. In 18th-century France, Marianne became a popular name as a variant of Marian and Marie.

marianne.meaning_en: Marianne is a female name. It is the French version of the Greek Mariamne, which is a variant of Mary, ultimately from the Hebrew Miriam, Mirjam. In late Greek Marianna was used. In 18th-century France, Marianne became a popular name as a variant of Marian and Marie.

mariannick.meaning_fr: Mariannick ou Maryannick est un prénom plutôt féminin, issu de la contraction entre les prénoms féminins Marie et Annick. Issu de la contraction avec le deuxième prénom Yannick, Maryannick peut être masculin et d'origine bretonne[réf. souhaitée].

mariano.meaning_en: Mariano is a masculine name from the Romance languages, corresponding to the feminine Mariana. It is an Italian, Spanish and Portuguese variant of the Roman Marianus which derived from Marius, and Marius derived from the Roman god Mars or from the Latin maris "male".

maribel.meaning_en: Maribel is a Spanish language name, formed as a contraction of María Isabel. Alternately, it is an English compound name, a combined version of Mary and Belle. Spelling variants include Maribell, Maribelle, Marybel, Marybell, Mary Belle, and Marybelle.

maricela.meaning_en: Marisela, or its alternative form Maricela, is a feminine given name.

marie.meaning_en: Marie is a variation of the feminine given name Maria. It is also the standard form of the name in Czech, and is also used in Danish, English, German, Norwegian, and Swedish. Marie, Marié or Mariê is also a feminine Japanese name.
marie.meaning_fr: Marie est un prénom féminin français. Il peut être épicène.

marie-andree.meaning_en: Marie-Andrée is a French feminine given name.
marie-andree.meaning_fr: Marie-Andrée est un prénom féminin français, composé de Marie, d'origine hébreu, et d'Andrée, d'origine grecque.

marie-antoinette.meaning_en: Marie Antoinette was Queen consort of France as the wife of Louis XVI from 10 May 1774 until the abolition of the French monarchy in 1792 during the French Revolution.

marie-caroline.meaning_fr: Marie-Caroline est un prénom féminin français. Ce prénom est composé de Marie et Caroline.

marie-charlotte.meaning_en: Marie-Charlotte is a feminine compound given name.

famous.name: Marie Christine, Princess Michael of Kent

marie-claude.meaning_en: Marie-Claude is a French feminine compound given name.

marie-eve.meaning_en: Marie-Ève or Marie-Eve is a French feminine given name.

marie-francoise.meaning_en: Marie-Françoise or Marie Françoise is a given name.
marie-francoise.meaning_fr: Marie-Françoise est un prénom féminin, fêté le 6 octobre.

marie-genevieve.meaning_en: Marie-Geneviève is a feminine compound given name borne by: Marie-Geneviève Bouliard, French painter Marie-Geneviève Dupré, French actress Marie-Geneviève Halévy, French salonnière and wife of composer Georges Bizet Marie-Geneviève Hérault, French painter Marie-Geneviève Martin, birth name of Marie Recio, French opera singer and second wife of composer Hector Berlioz Marie-Geneviève Meunier, French nun, martyred Catholic saint as one of the Martyrs of Compiègne Marie-Geneviève Navarre, French portrait artist and miniaturist

marie-helene.meaning_en: Marie-Hélène is a feminine compound given name.

marie-isabelle.meaning_fr: Marie-Isabelle est un prénom composé, formé des prénoms Marie et Isabelle.

famous.name: Gilbert du Motier, Marquis de Lafayette

marie-jose.meaning_fr: Marie-José est un prénom composé féminin, fêté le 15 août. Il a pour origine Marie-Josèphe, et pour variantes Marie-Joséphine, Marie-Josée, etc.

marie-julie.meaning_en: Marie-Julie is a compound given name.

marie-laure.meaning_en: Marie-Laure is a feminine compound given name which is borne by: Marie-Laure Augry, French journalist Marie-Laure Brunet, French biathlete Marie-Laure de Decker, French photographer Marie-Laure Delie, French footballer Marie-Laure Dougnac, French actress Marie-Laure Gaillot, French swimmer Marie-Laure Giraudon, French swimmer Marie-Laure de Lorenzi, French golfer Marie-Laure de Noailles, French artist, patron of the arts and art collector Marie-Laure Phinéra-Horth, French Guinean politician Marie-Laure Salles, French sociologist Marie-Laure Valla, French set dresser and set decorator

marie-lise.meaning_en: Marie-Lise or Marie Lise is a French feminine given name. Notable people with this name include: Marie-Lise Chanin, French geophysicist and aeronomist Marie Lise Monique Émond, Canadian actress

famous.name: Marie Thérèse of Savoy, Princesse de Lamballe

marie-louise.meaning_en: Marie Louise or Marie-Louise is a French feminine compound given name. In other languages, it may take one of several alternate forms: Maria Luiza Maria Luisa Maria Luise, Marie Luise Maria Louisa, Mary Louise or Mary Lou. Notable people with the name include:

marie-noelle.meaning_en: Marie-Noëlle is a French language feminine name, composed of the names Marie and Noëlle.

mariel.meaning_en: Mariel is a feminine given name, a diminutive of Mary and influenced by Muriel.

marielle.meaning_en: Marielle is a French female name, a diminutive of Marie.

marigold.meaning_en: Marigold is an English name taken from the common name used for flowers from different genera such as Calendula or Tagetes, among others. The flower name is derived from Mary's gold and was used in reference to the Virgin Mary.

marija.meaning_en: Marija is a feminine given name, a variation of the name Maria, which was in turn a Latin form of the Greek names Μαριαμ, or Mariam, and Μαρια, or Maria, found in the New Testament.

marijo.meaning_en: Marijo is a South Slavic masculine given name, cognate to Mario.

marika.meaning_en: Marika is a both a given name and surname. As a feminine given name, it is of Hungarian and Greek origin; a diminutive of Maria. Apart from Hungary and Greece, the name is also found in North Macedonia, Czechia, Estonia, Finland, Japan, Sweden, Slovakia and Poland.
marika.meaning_fr: Marika est un nom propre qui peut désigner :

mariko.meaning_en: Mariko is a feminine Japanese given name.
mariko.meaning_fr: Mariko est un prénom japonais féminin, ainsi qu'un nom de personnage de fiction.

marilou.meaning_en: Mary Lou, Mary-Lou, Marylou or Marilou is a feminine given name. It is a combination of the names Mary and Lou. Notable people and fictional characters with this name include:

famous.name: Princess Marina of Greece and Denmark

marina.meaning_en: Marina is a feminine given name. It is the female version of the Roman family name Marinus, which is a form of the Latin name Marius. The meaning of Marius might be connected to Mars, the Roman god of war, or with the Latin word maris, meaning virile.
marina.meaning_fr: Marina est un prénom féminin dans plusieurs langues, il est issu ultimement du latin marinus « marin ». La forme française est Marine. Marinella est un dérivé corse et italien.

marine.meaning_en: Marine can be used as a given name, usually female.
marine.meaning_fr: Marine, de son vrai nom Nathalie Duffau, est un mannequin et une ancienne coco-girl de Cocoricocoboy née le 16 mai 1968. Elle prit le nom de Marine car il y avait déjà deux Nathalie comme coco-girls.

marinette.meaning_fr: Marinette est un prénom francophone, d'origine française.

mario.meaning_en: Mario is the Italian, French, Croatian, Czech, Norwegian, Slovak, Serbian, Hungarian, Slovene, Polish, Spanish, Danish, Portuguese, Romanian, Swedish, Bulgarian, Greek, German, Dutch, and English form of the Latin Roman name Marius.
mario.meaning_fr: Mario est un prénom masculin et la variante italienne et espagnole du nom latin Marius.

marion.meaning_en: Marion is a unisex given name. As a feminine given name, it is a French diminutive of Marie that has been in use by English speakers since the Middle Ages. It was also occasionally considered a form of Margaret or Margery.

maris.meaning_en: Maris is a primarily female given name with various origins. The name can be derived from the Latin phrase Stella Maris, an epithet for the Virgin Mary. Because of its derivation, the name Maris is also related to other names that connote the ocean.

marisa.meaning_en: Marisa is a feminine given name. Like the given name Marissa, the name is derived from the Latin maris, meaning "of the sea". The name is also a Spanish, Portuguese or Italian contracted familiar nickname for Maria Isabel or Maria Luisa.

marisela.meaning_en: Marisela, or its alternative form Maricela, is a feminine given name.

mariska.meaning_en: Mariska is a female given name.

marit.meaning_fr: Marit est un prénom féminin scandinave, signifiant « perle » et analogue au prénom Marguerite, et est également un patronyme pouvant désigner:

marius.meaning_en: Marius is a male name, a Roman family name, and a modern given name. The name Marius was used by members of the Roman gens Maria. It is thought to be derived from either the Roman war god Mars or from the Latin root mas or maris meaning "male".
marius.meaning_fr: Marius est un prénom vraisemblablement d'origine latine, dérivé de mare, maris signifiant de la mer. L'étymologie est cependant incertaine, et une autre origine latine, dérivé cette fois de mas, maris signifiant le mâle est également possible.

famous.name: Grand Duchess Maria Nikolaevna of Russia
Grand Duchess Maria Alexandrovna of Russia
Grand Duchess Maria Pavlovna of Russia
Princess Maria of Greece and Denmark

mariya.meaning_en: Maria is a feminine given name. It is given in many languages influenced by Christianity.

marjan.meaning_en: Marjan is a Dutch, Polish, and Iranian version of the feminine given name Marianne. The Iranian feminine given name also means "coral". Marjan is also a Macedonian, Slovene, Croatian and Serbian version of the masculine given name Marius.

marjie.meaning_en: Marjie is a feminine given name. Notable people with the name include: Marjie Lawrence, English actress Marjie Lundstrom, American journalist Marjie Millar, American actress

marjorie.meaning_en: Marjorie is a female given name derived from Margaret, which means pearl. It can also be spelled as Margery, Marjory or Margaery. Marjorie is a medieval variant of Margery, influenced by the name of the herb marjoram.

marjory.meaning_en: Marjory is a female given name, a variant spelling of Margery or Marjorie. It is sometimes shortened to Marj.

mark.meaning_en: Mark is a common male name and is related to the Latin word Mars. It means "consecrated to the god Mars", and also may mean "God of war" or "to be warlike". Marcus was one of the three most common Roman given names.

marketa.meaning_en: Markéta is a feminine Czech given name, equivalent to English Margaret.

marketta.meaning_en: Margaret is a feminine given name, which means "pearl". It is of Latin origin, via Ancient Greek and ultimately from Old Iranian. It has been an English name since the 11th century, and remained popular throughout the Middle Ages.

marko.meaning_en: Marko is a masculine given name, a cognate of Mark. The male name Marko is a Roman personal name that comes from the Latin word "Marti-co-s" which is a derivative of Mars, the Roman god of war.

marla.meaning_en: Marla is a female given name in English. It is a variant of the name Marlene, which comes from Mary Magdalene, the biblical woman to whom Jesus Christ first appeared after his resurrection.

marlana.meaning_en: Marlana is a feminine given name.

marlee.meaning_en: Marlee is a female given name. Notable persons with this name include: Marlee Matlin, American actress Marlee Ranacher, Australian author Marlee Scott, Canadian country music singer now living in the United States

marta.meaning_en: Marta is a female given name derived from the Aramaic name ܡܳܪܬܳܐ, which translates as "the lady" in English. It had the male form "Martinus" in Roman culture. It has been described as a cognate of Martha.

martha.meaning_en: Martha is a feminine given name. Patti, Patsy, and Patty were in use in Colonial America as English rhyming diminutives of the diminutive Mattie. Molly has been used as a diminutive of Martha since the 18th century.

marthe.meaning_en: Marthe is a feminine given name.

martina.meaning_en: Martina is a female given name, the female form of Martin and Martino.
martina.meaning_fr: Martina est un prénom féminin d'origine latine utilisé dans de nombreuses langues européennes.

marvin.meaning_en: Marvin is a masculine given name, derived from the Welsh name Mervyn, an Anglicized form of Merfyn. The name Merfyn contains the Old Welsh elements mer, probably meaning "marrow", and myn, meaning "eminent".

marwa.meaning_en: Marwa or Marwah is an Arabic female given name derived from the word marū/maruw with the meaning of either minerals, 'flint', 'quartz' or 'a hard stone of nearly pure silica'. However, the Arabic name for quartz is ṣawwān. The name is written Marva in the Persian form.

maryam.meaning_en: Maryam or Mariam is the Aramaic form of the biblical name Miriam. It is notably the name of Mary the mother of Jesus.

maryannick.meaning_fr: Mariannick ou Maryannick est un prénom plutôt féminin, issu de la contraction entre les prénoms féminins Marie et Annick. Issu de la contraction avec le deuxième prénom Yannick, Maryannick peut être masculin et d'origine bretonne[réf. souhaitée].

marylou.meaning_en: Mary Lou, Mary-Lou, Marylou or Marilou is a feminine given name. It is a combination of the names Mary and Lou. Notable people and fictional characters with this name include:

masha.meaning_en: In Russian, Masha is a diminutive of Maria. Also as in Ukrainian is a diminutive of Mariia or Mariya. It has been used as a nickname or as a pet name for women named Maria or Marie. An alternative spelling in the Latin alphabet is "Macha".
masha.meaning_fr: Macha est la transcription francophone de Маша, diminutif russe de Мария. En anglais, ce diminutif est transcrit Masha, en allemand Mascha, en italien Mascia, en slovène Maša, en serbe Maša ou Маша.

mason.meaning_en: Mason is a traditionally masculine given name, although recently the name has been used for either sex. Its origin is from the occupational surname Mason, which means "one who works with stone". It is also occasionally a nickname.

massimiliano.meaning_en: Massimiliano is a masculine Italian given name.

massimo.meaning_en: Massimo is a masculine Italian given name.

massinissa.meaning_fr: Massinissa est un prénom masculin d'origine berbère. Le prénom vient de « Masensen », le fondateur de la Numidie. Ce terme se compose de « mas » qui signifie « maître » et « -nsen » qui signifie « leur », traduisant ainsi « Massinissa » en « leur maître ».

mat.meaning_en: Matt or Mat is a male given name, often used as a nickname for Matthew. Less commonly, it is used as a surname.

matan.meaning_en: Matan or Mattan is a Hebrew name, mostly for males in Israel. It comes from the word 'gift' and literally means "giving".

matea.meaning_en: Matea is a feminine given name. It is the feminine form of the male name Mateo, Matej or Matija, which are Croatian forms of Matthew.

mateusz.meaning_en: Mateusz is a Polish given name, equivalent to Hebrew names Matityahu and Matthew, meaning "gift of Yahweh".

matheo.meaning_en: Matheo is a given name, a variant of Matthew.

maud.meaning_en: Maud or Maude derived from the Old French name Mahaut for Matilda. It originated in Old High German and consisted of the two words 'maht' and 'hiltja'. Its meaning is thus "powerful battler" or "powerful in battle".
