padraig.meaning_en: Pádraig or Pádraic, also Pádhraig or Pádhraic, are Irish male given names deriving from the Latin Patricius, meaning "of the patrician class", introduced via the name of Saint Patrick. The name is often anglicised as its English language equivalent Patrick or phonetically, e.g.

page.meaning_en: Page is a unisex given name.

paige.meaning_en: Paige is an English surname and given name. The surname is a variant of Page, an occupational name derived from page. Its use as a given name was transferred from the surname. It became popular as a girl's name in the 20th-century in the United States.

palma.meaning_en: Palma is both a surname and a given name of Italian origin.

palmer.meaning_en: Palmer is a unisex given name that is a transferred use of a surname meaning palm bearer or pilgrim. Christian pilgrims to the Holy Land traditionally carried the palms.

palmira.meaning_en: Palmira is a feminine given name.

paloma.meaning_en: Paloma is a Spanish female given name, derived from Latin "palumbus", which means "dove", a symbol of peace. The name also can be understood as the Holy Spirit symbolized in this bird.
paloma.meaning_fr: Paloma est un prénom d'origine espagnole qui provient du mot paix[réf. nécessaire]. Il signifie « colombe » ou « palombe ».

pam.meaning_en: Pam is a feminine given name, often a diminutive form of Pamela.

pamela.meaning_en: Pamela is a feminine given name, often abbreviated to Pam. Pamela is also infrequently used as a surname.

panagiota.meaning_en: Panagiota, alternatively spelled as Panayiota, is a feminine Greek given name. It is derived from the Greek epithet Panagia, meaning 'All-holy', for Mary. It has five name days, which it shares with its male counterpart Panagiotis.

panagiotis.meaning_en: Panagiotis or Panayiotis is a common male Greek name. It derives from the Greek epithet Panagia or Panayia for Mary. The feminine form of the name is Panagiota or Panayiota.

pansy.meaning_en: Pansy is an English feminine given name taken from the name of the flower, which is derived from the Old French pensée, meaning “thought.” It is one of many botanical names that came into fashion in the Anglosphere during the Victorian era.

paola.meaning_en: Paola is a female given name, the Italian form of the name Paula. In Greek it is Polina. Notable people with the name include:

paolo.meaning_fr: Paolo est un prénom italien dérivé du latin Paulus porté par différentes personnes : Paolo, cardinal du XIIe siècle ; Paolo Boï, joueur d'échecs italien ; Pier Paolo Pasolini, écrivain, scénariste et metteur en scène italien ; Paolo Pininfarina, industriel italien ; Paolo Bettini, coureur cycliste italien ; Paolo Uccello, peintre italien ; Paolo Sarpi, historien vénitien ; Paolo Maldini, joueur de football italien ; Paolo Toscanelli, astronome, un cartographe et un médecin florentin du XVe siècle ; Paolo Conte, chanteur italien ; Paolo Barilla, pilote automobile italien.

paquita.meaning_en: Paquita is a given name of Spanish origin, a diminutive of the name Francisca, which is the feminine form of Francisco, which derives from the Latin given name Franciscus.

paris.meaning_en: Paris is a unisex given name. It is of Greek origin and is common among Anglophone countries.

parisa.meaning_en: Parisā is a Persian feminine given name.

parker.meaning_en: Parker is an English-language unisex given name of Old English origin, meaning 'park keeper', hence also an Old English occupational surname. Parker was more common in the 19th century as a personal name than it is now. The name has variants.

pascal.meaning_en: Pascal is a unisex given name. It is a Francophone name, cognate of Italian name Pasquale, Spanish name Pascual, Catalan name Pasqual and Portuguese name Pascoal. Pascal is common in French-speaking countries, Germany, Austria, and the Netherlands.
pascal.meaning_fr: Pascal est un prénom masculin, principalement fêté le 17 mai.

pascale.meaning_en: Pascale is a common Francophone given name, the feminine of the name Pascal. The same spelling is also an Italian form of the masculine name Pascal, and an Italian surname derived from the given name.
pascale.meaning_fr: Pascale est en français un prénom féminin. Il vient du latin paschalis ou pashalis qui signifie « celui qui est né à Pâques ».

pascaline.meaning_fr: Pascaline est un prénom féminin qui se fête le 17 mai.

paschal.meaning_en: Paschal is used as a name. Paschal, a variant of Pascal, from Latin Paschalis, is an adjective describing either the Easter or Passover holidays. People known as Paschal include:

pasquale.meaning_en: Pasquale is a masculine Italian given name and a surname found all over Italy. It is a cognate of the French name Pascal, the Spanish Pascual, the Portuguese Pascoal and the Catalan Pasqual.

patience.meaning_en: Patience is an English feminine given name referring to the virtue of patience. It was a name created by the Puritans in the 1600s. It has seen steady, though infrequent, usage in the United States throughout its history.

famous.name: Patrice Talon
famous.occupation: President of the Republic of Benin

patrice.meaning_en: Patrice is an English- and French-language given name of Latin origin, unisex in English but masculine in French. It is derived from the Latin term patricius, meaning "noble", and thus cognate with the more common names Patricia and Patrick.
patrice.meaning_fr: Patrice est un prénom épicène dérivé du mot latin patricius qui désignait à l'époque un membre de l'aristocratie : le patrice. En anglais, il peut être une variante, féminine, de Patricia.

patricia.meaning_en: Patricia is a feminine given name of Latin origin. Derived from the Latin word patrician, meaning 'noble', it is the feminine form of the masculine given name Patrick. Another well-known variant is Patrice.
patricia.meaning_fr: Patricia d'origine latine, fêté le 17 mars. Il vient du mot patricius, qui signifie « patricien ».

patrick.meaning_en: Patrick is a male given name of Latin origin. It is derived from the Roman name Patricius.

patrizia.meaning_en: Patrizia [paˈtrittsja] is a feminine Italian given name meaning "noble".

patryk.meaning_en: Patryk is a masculine given name of Polish origin, an equivalent of Patrick, which means "nobleman" or "patrician".

patsy.meaning_en: Patsy is a given name often used as a diminutive of the feminine given name Patricia or sometimes the masculine name Patrick, or occasionally other names containing the syllable "Pat". Among Italian Americans, it is often used as a pet name for Pasquale.

patti.meaning_en: Patti is a feminine given name related to Pattie and Patty. Patti is generally derived from a short form or diminutive of Patricia, derived from the Latin word patrician, referring to the nobility.

patty.meaning_en: Patty is an English given name that originated as a rhyming diminutive form of names such as Martha via the diminutive Mattie, much in the same way that Peggy was derived as a rhyming variant of Meg or Meggie, an English diminutive of Margaret, and Polly was originally derived as a rhyming variant of Molly, an English diminutive of Mary.

patxi.meaning_en: Patxi is a male given name in the Basque language area in northern Spain and south-west France, but more commonly a nickname for those officially named Francisco; the original Basque equivalent was Frantzisko, but this was rarely chosen as a forename by parents in the modern era, and along with Patxi it was forbidden to be given to babies under the language policies of Francoist Spain between the 1940s and 1970s, hence the widespread unofficial adoption during that period.

paul.meaning_en: Paul is a common Latin masculine given name in countries and ethnicities with a Christian heritage and, beyond Europe, in Christian religious communities throughout the world. Paul – or its variations – can be a given name or surname.
paul.meaning_fr: Paul est un prénom masculin provenant du latin paulus. Ce prénom a donné le patronyme Paul et des noms de lieux. Les Paul sont fêtés le 29 juin, en hommage à Paul de Tarse, apôtre et évangélisateur.

paul-henri.meaning_fr: Paul-Henri est un prénom masculin composé des prénoms Paul et Henri. Il est notamment porté par : ordre alphabétique Paul-Henri Mathieu, joueur de tennis français ; Paul-Henri Nargeolet, est un plongeur sous-marin ; Paul-Henri Spaak, homme d'État belge.

paul-louis.meaning_en: Paul-Louis is a masculine French given name.

paula.meaning_en: Paula is a common female given name. It is used in German, English, Estonian, Finnish, Spanish, Portuguese, Catalan, Romanian, Hungarian, Polish, Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Latvian, Lithuanian, Croatian and Greek languages. In Greek it is Polina.

paulette.meaning_en: Paulette is the French feminine given name diminutive of the FrenchThe masculine given name Paul comes from the same cognate. It is uncommon as a surname.

paulina.meaning_en: Paulina is a female given name. It is a female version of Paulinus, a variant of Paulus meaning the little. The Greek language. In Greek it means: Pavlina. Paula and Pauline are variants on this name.

pauline.meaning_en: Pauline is a female given name. It was originally the French form of Paulina, a female version of Paulinus, a variant of Paulus meaning the little, hence the younger. The corresponding form for the name in Italian is Paolina.

paulino.meaning_en: Paulino is a surname and a masculine given name. It is a Spanish and Portuguese form of the Roman family name Paulinus, which was itself derived from the Roman family name Paulus meaning "small" or "humble" in Latin.

pavel.meaning_en: Pavel is a male given name. It is a Slavic cognate of the name Paul. Pavel may refer to:

pawel.meaning_en: Pavel is a male given name. It is a Slavic cognate of the name Paul. Pavel may refer to:

payton.meaning_en: Payton is a given name in use in English speaking countries. One source indicates the name comes from a surname derived from a place name meaning "Pœga's town" in Old English. Another source indicates the name means "fighting man's estate".

peaches.meaning_en: Peaches is an English given name and hypocorism derived from the name of the fruit.

pearl.meaning_en: Pearl is a unisex given name derived from the English word pearl, a hard, roundish object produced within the soft tissue of a living, shelled mollusk. Pearls are commonly used in jewelry-making. The name has a history of usage among Jews.

peder.meaning_en: Peter is a common masculine given name. It is derived directly from Greek Πέτρος, Petros, which itself was a translation of Aramaic Kefa, the new name Jesus gave to apostle Simon bar Jonah. An Old English variant is Piers.

pedro.meaning_en: Pedro is a masculine given name. Pedro is the Spanish, Portuguese, and Galician name for Peter. Its French equivalent is Pierre while its English and Germanic form is Peter.

famous.name: Margaret Taylor
famous.occupation: First Lady of the United States

peggy.meaning_en: Peggy is a female first name derived from Meggy, a diminutive version of the name Margaret.
peggy.meaning_fr: Peggy est un prénom féminin, fêté le 8 janvier voire le 16 novembre. C'est un dérivé des prénoms anglais Margaret, Margret, Meggy.

pelagie.meaning_en: Pelagie is a name, a French form of the Greek Pelagia, The name refers to a saint of the early Christian Church called Pelagia.

penda.meaning_en: Penda is a feminine given name of Senegalese origin. In the European Early Middle Ages, it was also a masculine name used in the Anglo-Saxon kingdoms.

penina.meaning_en: Pnina is a Jewish feminine given name, meaning "pearl" in Hebrew. Alternative spellings include Peninnah, Penina, and Peninah.

penny.meaning_en: Penny is a feminine given name and nickname, often a short form of Penelope.

percival.meaning_en: Percival, also spelled Perceval, is a masculine given name derived from the Celtic name Peredur and likely influenced by the Old French percer, meaning pierce and val, meaning valley. The name was likely also influenced by the name Percy.

percy.meaning_en: The English surname Percy is of Norman origin, coming from Normandy to England, United Kingdom. It was from the House of Percy, Norman lords of Northumberland, and derives from the village of Percy-en-Auge in Normandy.

perl.meaning_en: Perl is a Yiddish feminine given name. Diminutive: Perele/Pereleh. The corresponding Hebrew names are Pnina and Margalit. The name gave rise to the Jewish matronymic surname Perlin. Notable people with the name include: Perl D.

permelia.meaning_en: Pamela is a feminine given name, often abbreviated to Pam. Pamela is also infrequently used as a surname.

perri.meaning_en: Perri is a predominantly feminine given name and a surname. Notable people with the name include:

perrine.meaning_en: Perrine is both used as a female given name and as a surname. The name is derived from the French word pierre, stone. Notable people with the name include:
perrine.meaning_fr: Perrine, Périne, Périnne ou Perryne est un prénom féminin français, dérivé du mot « pierre ». En tant que dérivé du prénom Pétronille de même origine, elle peut être fêtée le 31 mai.

persephone.meaning_en: Persephone is an Ancient Greek feminine name used in reference to Persephone, the Greek goddess of spring and the Greek underworld.

persis.meaning_en: Persis is a feminine given name, meaning "from Persia".

peta.meaning_en: Peta is a feminine given name. Notable individual with this name include:

pete.meaning_en: Pete is a masculine given name. Notable people with the name include:

peter.meaning_en: Peter is a common masculine given name. It is derived directly from Greek Πέτρος, Petros, which itself was a translation of Aramaic Kefa, the new name Jesus gave to apostle Simon bar Jonah. An Old English variant is Piers.

petra.meaning_en: Petra is a feminine given name. It is a feminine form of Peter, which is derived from the Greek word "πέτρα" meaning "stone, rock".

petros.meaning_en: Peter is a common masculine given name. It is derived directly from Greek Πέτρος, Petros, which itself was a translation of Aramaic Kefa, the new name Jesus gave to apostle Simon bar Jonah. An Old English variant is Piers.

petrus.meaning_en: Petrus is the Latin form of the Greek name Πέτρος meaning "rock", and is the common English prefix "petro-" used to describe rock-based substances, like petros-oleum or "rock oil." As the source of Peter, it is a common name for people from antiquity through the medieval era.

pharrell.meaning_en: Pharrell is a masculine given name, a variation of the name Farrell.

phil.meaning_en: Philip, also Phillip, is a male name derived from the Greek Φιλιππος, from a compound of φίλος and ἵππος. Prominent Philips who popularized the name include kings of Macedonia and one of the apostles of early Christianity. Philip has many alternative spellings.

philemon.meaning_en: Philemon is a given name. In the Bible, the Epistle to Philemon is addressed to Saint Philemon.

philip.meaning_en: Philip, also Phillip, is a male name derived from the Greek Φιλιππος, from a compound of φίλος and ἵππος. Prominent Philips who popularized the name include kings of Macedonia and one of the apostles of early Christianity. Philip has many alternative spellings.

philippa.meaning_en: Philippa is a feminine given name meaning "lover of horses" or "horses' friend", from the Greek Philippos, which is derived from philein, meaning to love and hippos, meaning horse. The English masculine form is Philip, which was formerly the vernacular form for both sexes.

philippe.meaning_fr: Philippe est un prénom français masculin, plus rarement féminin. Philippe peut être aussi un patronyme. Il est principalement fêté le 3 mai.

phillip.meaning_en: Philip, also Phillip, is a male name derived from the Greek Φιλιππος, from a compound of φίλος and ἵππος. Prominent Philips who popularized the name include kings of Macedonia and one of the apostles of early Christianity. Philip has many alternative spellings.

philomena.meaning_en: Philomena was a young woman believed by some to have been a Christian martyr.

philomene.meaning_en: Philomène is a given name, Philomena.

phoebe.meaning_en: Phoebe or Phœbe is a female name, the feminine form of the male name Phoebus, an epithet of Apollo meaning "bright", "shining", and “pure”. In Greek mythology, Phoebe was a Titan associated with the power of prophecy as well as the moon.

phoenix.meaning_en: Phoenix is a modern given name derived from the name for a mythological bird from Greek myth that has become a symbol of renewal, regeneration and immortality. It is a name in use for both boys and girls.

phyllis.meaning_en: Phyllis or Phillis is a feminine given name of Greek origin meaning foliage. Phyllis is a minor figure in Greek mythology who killed herself in despair when Demophon of Athens did not return to her and who was transformed into an almond tree by the gods.

pia.meaning_en: Pia is a feminine given name. In Spanish, it is spelled Pía.

pierre.meaning_en: Pierre is a masculine given name. It is a French form of the name Peter. Pierre originally meant "rock" or "stone" in French. It is a translation of Aramaic כיפא, the nickname Jesus gave to apostle Simon Bar-Jona, referred in English as Saint Peter.

pierre-antoine.meaning_fr: Pierre-Antoine est un prénom composé formé de Pierre et de Antoine. Étymologie : Pierre provient du grec petros qui signifie : « pierre », « rocher », et Antoine provient de anthonomos qui signifie : « qui se nourrit de fleurs ». Se fête le 29 juin ou 17 janvier.

pierre-emmanuel.meaning_fr: Pierre-Emmanuel est un prénom composé de Pierre et Emmanuel. Il est fêté le 29 juin.

pierre-francois.meaning_fr: Pierre-François est un prénom composé masculin formé de Pierre et de François. Les Pierre-François sont fêtés le 12 janvier, en hommage au bienheureux chrétien Pierre-François Jamet, prêtre né à Frênes, béatifié le 10 mai 1987 par Jean-Paul II à Rome.

pierrette.meaning_en: A Pierrette is, in the theatre, a female Pierrot Pierrette may also refer to: Marie-Anne Pierrette Paulze, French chemist, and wife of Antoine Lavoisier Olga Bancic, Jewish–Romanian activist in the French Resistance Paul and Pierrette Girault de Coursac, two French historians who specialise in the life of Louis XVI and Marie-Antoinette Pierrette Le Pen, ex-wife of Jean-Marie Le Pen and mother of Marine Le Pen Pierrette Adams, singer from the Republic of the Congo Pierrette Alarie, CC, CQ, French Canadian coloratura soprano Pierrette Mari, French composer Pierrette Ringuette, Canadian Senator Pierrette Venne, member of the Canadian House of Commons from 1988 to 2003 Pierrette-Henriette Clostermann, a.k.a.

pierrick.meaning_en: Pierrick is a given name, from Brittany, diminutive of Pierre.
pierrick.meaning_fr: Pierrick est un prénom masculin d’origine bretonne ou grecque. C’est le diminutif de Pêr, breton pour Pierre, ou en grec Petros désignant pierre ou cailloux. Fête : Les Pierre sont fêtés le 29 juin. Donc, les Pierrick célèbrent aussi leur fête ce jour-là.

pieter.meaning_en: Pieter is a male given name, the Dutch form of Peter. The name has been one of the most common names in the Netherlands for centuries, but since the mid-twentieth century its popularity has dropped steadily, from almost 3000 per year in 1947 to about 100 a year in 2016.

pietro.meaning_en: Pietro is an Italian masculine given name. Notable people with the name include:

pilar.meaning_en: Pilar is a feminine Spanish language given name, traditionally short for "Maria del Pilar". Notable people with the name include:

pinkie.meaning_en: Pinkie or Pinky is an English given name or hypocorism taken from a diminutive term for the color pink. It is also occasionally a diminutive for names such as Patricia. Variants include Pink, Pinka, Pinke, Pinkee, Pinkey, and Pinki.

pio.meaning_en: Pio is a masculine given name, the Spanish-language equivalent to Pius.

piotr.meaning_en: Peter is a common masculine given name. It is derived directly from Greek Πέτρος, Petros, which itself was a translation of Aramaic Kefa, the new name Jesus gave to apostle Simon bar Jonah. An Old English variant is Piers.

piper.meaning_en: Piper is an English given name meaning "piper". It is a transferred use of the surname, which originated as an occupational name in England in the Middle Ages for a pipe player.

pippa.meaning_en: Pippa is a feminine given name and a short form, usually of Philippa.

pixie.meaning_en: Pixie is a feminine given name of English origin.

pol.meaning_en: Pol is a male given name. In Europe, it can be a form of Paul or Polydore, and sometimes of Apollonius or Leopold. It is most common in Belgium, Luxembourg, Andorra, and Spain. The name in Cambodia and Thailand likely has a different origin.

pola.meaning_en: Pola is a feminine given name of Greek origin, a Polish and Spanish form of the name Apolonia, a feminine form of the ancient Greek name Apollinaris, a name derived from the Greek god Apollo.

polina.meaning_en: Polina is a feminine given name with roots in the Greek and Latin languages. It is most widely used in Eastern Slavic cultures such as Belarus, Russia and Ukraine.

polly.meaning_en: Polly is a given name, most often feminine, which originated as a variant of Molly. Polly may also be a short form of names such as Polina, Polona, Pauline, Paula, or Paulina.

polo.meaning_en: Polo is a masculine given name and nickname. Notable people with the name include:

porfirio.meaning_en: Porfirio is a given name in Portuguese and Spanish, derived from the Greek Porphyry.

posey.meaning_en: Posy or Posey or Posie is an English given name derived from the English term for a small flower bouquet. A posy is also a word for a single flower. It can also be derived from an English nickname, sometimes used independently, for a formal name such as Josephine.

posie.meaning_en: Posy or Posey or Posie is an English given name derived from the English term for a small flower bouquet. A posy is also a word for a single flower. It can also be derived from an English nickname, sometimes used independently, for a formal name such as Josephine.

pranay.meaning_en: Pranay is a Hindu Indian masculine given name, which means "affection/love" or "regard".

precious.meaning_en: Precious is a predominantly feminine given name derived from the English word meaning "of great worth." It is also in occasional use for males. It first appeared in the top 1,000 most popular names for girls in the United States in 1978, when it ranked at 989.

primrose.meaning_en: Primrose is an English feminine given name given in reference to the flower. The common name for the flower comes from the Latin phrase prima rosa, or first rose. It is also an English or Scottish surname.

princeton.meaning_en: Princeton is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Princeton Fant, American football player Princeton Kwong, American figure skater Princeton Lyman, American diplomat Princeton Owusu-Ansah, Ghanaian footballer

prisca.meaning_en: Prisca is a feminine given name related to Priscilla.

priscilla.meaning_en: Priscilla is an English female given name adopted from Latin Prisca, derived from priscus. The name first appears in the New Testament either as Priscilla or Prisca, a female leader in early Christianity.

priya.meaning_en: Priya or Pria is a common given name in India which is also used in Nepal, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Thailand. It is cognate to the name of the Germanic goddess Frigg; both descend from the Proto-Indo-European stem *priH-o-, meaning "beloved".

priyanka.meaning_en: Priyanka is a popular female given name in Hindu and Buddhist cultures.

famous.name: Prosper Mérimée
famous.occupation: Inspector general of the Historical Monuments

prudence.meaning_en: Prudence is a feminine given name. The name is a Medieval form of the Latin Prudentia, meaning prudence, i.e. good judgement. The usual diminutive or short form is Pru or Prue. These may also be short for the unrelated name Prunella, which means plum.

prune.meaning_fr: Prune est un prénom féminin français fêté le 5 octobre ou le 8 juin, comme sainte Fleur.

qais.meaning_en: Qais is an Arabic given name meaning lover or firm. “Qays” and “Qaiss” are alternatives of Qais.
qais.meaning_fr: Kaïs, Qays ou encore Kays est un prénom masculin arabe.

qasim.meaning_en: Qasim, Kassem or Qasem is the transliteration of the male given name, The meaning is one who distributes. The first known bearer of the name was the son of the Islamic prophet Muhammad, Qasim ibn Muhammad.

quanita.meaning_en: Quanita is a feminine given name. Notable people with the name include: Quanita Adams, South African stage and screen actress Quanita Bobbs, South African field hockey player Quanitta Underwood, American boxer

queenie.meaning_en: The name Queenie is an affectionate, or pet use, of the term "queen", and is thought to be derived from the word "quean", meaning 'woman' rather than a reference to the monarch or his wife. As a first name it can also mean "Royal Lady" or "Ruler".

quentin.meaning_en: Quentin is a French masculine given name derived from the Latin first name Quintinus, a diminutive form of Quintus, which means "the fifth".
quentin.meaning_fr: Quentin est un prénom masculin français et anglais d'origine latine.

quiana.meaning_en: Quiana and Quianna is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Quianna Chaney, American basketball player Quiana Grant, American model Quiana Lynell, American blues and jazz singer, arranger, and songwriter Quiana Smith, American stage actress

quinn.meaning_en: Quinn is a unisex given name, derived from an Irish surname. Notable people with the given name include:

quintus.meaning_en: Quintus is a male given name derived from Quintus, a common Latin forename found in the culture of ancient Rome. Quintus derives from Latin word quintus, meaning "fifth". Quintus is an English masculine given name and a surname.

rachael.meaning_en: Rachel is a feminine given name of Hebrew origin, popularized by the biblical figure Rachel, the wife of Israelite patriarch Jacob.

racheal.meaning_en: Rachel is a feminine given name of Hebrew origin, popularized by the biblical figure Rachel, the wife of Israelite patriarch Jacob.

rachel.meaning_en: Rachel is a feminine given name of Hebrew origin, popularized by the biblical figure Rachel, the wife of Israelite patriarch Jacob.

rachelle.meaning_en: Rachel is a feminine given name of Hebrew origin, popularized by the biblical figure Rachel, the wife of Israelite patriarch Jacob.

rachida.meaning_fr: Rachida est un prénom féminin d'origine arabe signifiant « mûre » ou « sensée », raisonnable. Elle est fêtée le 23 novembre.

racquel.meaning_en: Rachel is a feminine given name of Hebrew origin, popularized by the biblical figure Rachel, the wife of Israelite patriarch Jacob.

rae.meaning_en: Rae is a unisex given name. The Scottish name Rae is often associated with the Gaelic term "rath" which means "fortress." Rae is also the female variant of the Old High German Ray from regin meaning “counsel”.

raekwon.meaning_en: Raekwon is a masculine given name. Notable people with the name include: Raekwon, American rapper and a member of Wu-Tang Clan Raekwon Davis, American football defensive tackle Raekwon McMillan, American football linebacker

raelynn.meaning_en: Raelynn is a feminine given name of English origin, a modern combination of the names Rae and Lynn. Names ending in -lyn are currently popular for girls in the United States.

rafe.meaning_en: Rafe is a given name for a male used in many countries across the world. If the name is English, Scandinavian or German it is of Old Norse origin, derived from the Old Norse Raðulfr through Old English Rædwulf.

raffaella.meaning_en: Raffaella is an Hebrew female name taken from the Hebrew male name Rafael, meaning in Hebrew "God heal her". Used as a female name in Israel, Italy, Greece, Spain, Brazil.

raffi.meaning_en: Rafi is a male given name of Armenian and Arabic origin. It is one of the names of Allah, stemming from the Arabic verb rafaʿa, meaning "to lift, to raise". It is distinct from another male name, Rafi. Other common transcriptions include "Rafee", "Rafie", "Rafay" and "Raffy".

rafik.meaning_en: Rafik is the given name of: Rafik Al-Hariri, business tycoon, former Prime Minister of Lebanon Rafik Bouderbal, French-born Algerian player currently playing for ES Sétif in the Algerian Championnat National Rafik Deghiche, Algeria) Algerian football player currently playing as a forward for USM Alger in the Algerian league Rafik Djebbour, French-born Algerian football player currently playing as a striker for AEK Athens in the Greek Super League Rafik Haj Yahia, Israeli Arab politician, member of the Knesset for the Labor Party and One Nation Rafik Halliche, Algerian footballer who currently plays for C.D.
rafik.meaning_fr: Rafik ou Rafiq est un prénom masculin qui signifie « compagnon », « copain», « camarade » ou encore « clément » en arabe classique. Il est assez répandu, que ce soit au Moyen-Orient ou au Maghreb.

ragnar.meaning_en: Ragnar is a masculine Germanic given name, composed of the Old Norse elements ragin- "counsel" and hari- "army".

rahaf.meaning_en: Rahaf is a feminine given name of Arabic origin. Notable people with the name include:
rahaf.meaning_fr: Rahaf est un prénom arabe signifiant « quelque chose de délicat, fin, sensible et raffiné ». Il est aussi utilisé au Canada mais rarement.

raheem.meaning_en: Rahim is an Arabic word meaning "Merciful", from the root R-Ḥ-M. Al-Rahim is one of the attributes of God according to Islam. It is a male given name, sometimes a hypocorism for Abdu r-Raḥīm "Servant of the Merciful". Spellings include Rahim, Raheem, Rohim and Roheem.

rahil.meaning_en: Rahil is a unisex given name and a surname. Notable people with the name include:

rahman.meaning_en: Rahman or Rehman is an Arabic and Hebrew origin surname meaning "Gracious", "King", "Merciful" or "Lord" based on the triconsonantal root R-Ḥ-M. With nisba, the name becomes Rehmani, meaning "descendant of the gracious one".

rahul.meaning_en: Rahul is a popular male name in India and may be derived from the name Rahula, the name given to the son of the Buddha according to certain Buddhist traditions. The name Rahula in turn is derived from the name Rahu, a Hindu mythological figure that causes eclipses.

raif.meaning_en: Raif, Raaif, sometimes Raef is an Arabic male given name or used as a surname meaning "kind, compassionate, affectionate, benign" or "sympathetic, merciful".

rain.meaning_en: Rain is a given name. People named Rain include:

rainer.meaning_en: Rainer is a German male given name.

raisa.meaning_en: Raisa or Raissa is a female personal name. It is popular in Russia and South Asia. It was also a historically typical female name amongst Jews of the Russian Empire, as a Hebrew and Yiddish origin variant. In Yiddish, Raisa is derived from the word "roiz", meaning “rose”.

rajeev.meaning_fr: Rajiv est un prénom masculin indien qui peut également être écrit Rajive, Rajeev pour les anglophones ou même Radjiv. Le sens premier de ce prénom est « qui a des rayures ou des points ». Il signifie « fleur de lotus » en Hindi et en Sanskrit.

rajesh.meaning_en: Rajesh is a given name of Indian and Nepali origin with the translation "king".

rajiv.meaning_en: Rājīv is a popular South Asian male name, also spelt Rajeev, Rajive, Rajib, Rajeeb, Rajiva and Rajiba. It is said that the lotus flower, though it grows in muddy water, doesn't accumulate the mud particles onto it; such is the quality described as rājīv.

ralf.meaning_en: Ralph is a male name of English origin, derived from the Old English Rædwulf and Old High German Radulf, cognate with the Old Norse Raðulfr. The most common forms are: Ralph, the common variant form in English, which takes either of the given pronunciations.

roman.meaning_en: Roman is a masculine given name meaning from Rome, which originated within the Roman Empire, via Latin. In its initial sense, the title "Roman", denotes a member of the Roman Empire, or belonging to or identifying with Roman culture.
roman.meaning_fr: Roman, est un prénom masculin d'origine latine. Roman, signifie « qui vient de Rome ».

romana.meaning_en: Romana is a surname and female given name. Its roots are originally from the Assyrian/Syriac Roma and na, and later from the feminine form of the Latin name Romanus. One possible pronunciation of Romana in English is .

romaric.meaning_fr: Romaric est un prénom originaire de l'est de la France. Il a pour variantes masculines Romarick et Romary et pour variante féminine Romarie. La saint Romaric a lieu le 10 décembre.

romina.meaning_en: Romina is a feminine given name of Italian origin.

romuald.meaning_en: Romuald is a masculine given name.

romy.meaning_en: Romy is a given name, often a diminutive form of names such as Rosemary or Romina,Romilda,Romana,Roman or Romeo. People with the name include:

ron.meaning_en: Ron is a given name for boys. It is mostly used as a shortening of the name Ronald and Cameron, but is also Hebrew for "joy". People with this name include:

ronald.meaning_en: Ronald is a masculine given name derived from the Old Norse Rögnvaldr, or possibly from Old English Regenweald. In some cases Ronald is an Anglicised form of the Gaelic Raghnall, a name likewise derived from Rögnvaldr.
ronald.meaning_fr: Ronald est un prénom masculin dérivé du prénom germanique Raginwald. Ronnie et Ron sont ses diminutifs.

ronaldo.meaning_en: Ronaldo is a Portuguese given name equivalent to the English Ronald. It became a common name in all Portuguese-speaking countries, also prevalent in other Romance countries.

ronan.meaning_en: Rónán, anglicised as Ronan, is an Irish and Breton male given name and surname derived from rón, the Irish word for 'seal'. The given name dates back to Primitive Irish in the form ᚏᚑᚅᚐᚅᚅ [ᚋᚐᚊ ᚉᚑᚋᚑᚌᚐᚅᚅ], found as an ogham inscription which translates as 'Rónán, son of Comgán'.
ronan.meaning_fr: Ronan est un prénom masculin, fêté le 1er juin.

ronna.meaning_en: Ronna is a feminine given name. People with that name include: Ronna Brott, Master with the Ontario Superior Court Ronna Burger, American philosopher Ronna C.

ronnie.meaning_en: Ronnie is a given name. It can be a pet form of the masculine name Ronald and the feminine name Veronica. The masculine Ronald is derived from the Old Norse Rögnvaldr, which is composed of the elements regin and valdr.

rooney.meaning_en: Rooney is the given name or common first name of the following people: Rooney Lee, an American planter, military general and politician. Rooney Mara, an American actress. Rooney Massara, a British rower and businessman.

roosevelt.meaning_en: Roosevelt is a masculine given name borne by:

roque.meaning_en: Roque is a given name. It is the Spanish and Portuguese version of the Italian Rocco.

rory.meaning_en: Rory is a given name of Gaelic origin. It is an anglicisation of the Irish: RuairíThe meaning of the name is "red king", composed of ruadh and rígh. In Ireland and Scotland, it is generally seen as a masculine name and therefore rarely given to females.
rory.meaning_fr: Rory est un prénom, généralement masculin, d’origine gaélique.

rosa.meaning_en: Rosa is a female given name, especially in the Spanish, Portuguese, and Italian languages.

rosalba.meaning_en: Rosalba is a feminine personal name, derived from the Latin rosa alba, the white rose. Although known in English, the name is especially associated with Italy, and is also common in Spanish and Portuguese-speaking countries, where it is also a surname.

rosaleen.meaning_en: Rosaleen is an Irish female first name. It is an Anglicized version of the Irish name Róisín, the diminutive of "rose" in the Irish language; it therefore means "little rose".

rosalia.meaning_en: Rosalia is a feminine given name of Latin origin meaning "rose" and was the name of an early saint Saint Rosalia. In Latin, the Rosalia was a festival of roses celebrated variously throughout the Roman Empire.

rosalie.meaning_en: Rosalie is a feminine given name, the French, German, and Dutch form of the Roman name Rosalia, which was ultimately derived from the Latin word rosa, meaning rose. The name may also be spelled Rozalie in Dutch and Rosalee or Rosaleigh in English.
rosalie.meaning_fr: Rosalie est un prénom féminin d'origine latine utilisé en français et dans d'autres langues.

rosalind.meaning_en: Rosalind is a feminine given name derived from Old German word elements hros, or horse and lind, soft, tender. In the medieval era, it became associated with the Latin phrase rosa linda, or pretty rose.

rosalinda.meaning_en: Rosalinda or Roselinda is a female given name of Old German origin, and is also thought to be a name of Spanish origin. It is both a combination of the name Linda and Rosa, the Spanish form of Rose, and a name from which the diminutive Linda arose.

rosalynn.meaning_en: Rosalyn and the similar names Rosalynn and Roselyn are feminine given names. Notable people and characters with the names include:

rosamaria.meaning_en: Rosamaria is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Rosamaria Montibeller, Brazilian volleyball player Rosamaria Murtinho, Brazilian actress Rosamaría Roffiel, Mexican poet, novelist, journalist and editor

rosamond.meaning_en: Rosamond is a feminine given name. Notable people with the name include:

rosanna.meaning_en: The name Rosanna is the combination of Rosa and Anna. It should not be confused with Rossana, which is the Italian form of Roxana.

rosaria.meaning_en: Rosaria is the Italian feminine form of Rosario. Notable people with the name include:

rosario.meaning_en: Rosario is a given name originating from Italian, Spanish and Portuguese Roman Catholicism in which the Virgin Mary is titled "Our Lady of the Rosary." In Italian, it is a masculine name, with a diminutive of Saro and its female equivalent being Rosaria.
rosario.meaning_fr: Rosario est un prénom, de genre masculin en italien et féminin en espagnol et portugais.

famous.name: Rose of Lima
famous.occupation: member of Roman Catholic religious orders and societies

rose.meaning_en: Rose is a female given name. It is a late Latin name derived from rosa, meaning "rose". Variants are Rosa, Rosario, Rosie, Rosalba, Rosalie, Rosalia, Rosina, Rosaria, Rosalyn and Rosalina. Similar names are Rosanna and Rosamunde.
rose.meaning_fr: Rose est un prénom féminin, principalement fêté le 23 août.

roselyn.meaning_en: Rosalyn and the similar names Rosalynn and Roselyn are feminine given names. Notable people and characters with the names include:

rosemary.meaning_en: Rosemary is a feminine given name, a combination of the names Rose which is a flower that belongs to the Rose family, and from the name Mary which is the name of the Virgin Mary and means Strong, Fertile. It can also be used in reference to the herb named rosemary.

rosetta.meaning_en: Rosetta is a female given name.

roshni.meaning_en: Roshni or Roshini is a given name.

rosie.meaning_en: Rosie is a feminine given name of English origin. It can be a diminutive form of the English language given name Rose, which is of Latin origin. Similar diminutives in other languages include: Rosa becoming Rosita in Spanish, and Ruža becoming Ružica in Slavic languages.

rosita.meaning_en: Rosita is a feminine given name.

rossana.meaning_en: Rossana is a feminine Italian given name.

rowland.meaning_en: Rowland is an English male given name. It is a medieval variation of Roland.

roxana.meaning_fr: Roxana est un prénom d'origine persane féminin. Il est fêté le 7 septembre en France. En Hongrie, Roxána est fêté le 14 septembre.

roxann.meaning_en: Roxann is a feminine given name. Notable people with the name include: Roxann Dawson, American actress, television producer and director Roxann Robinson, American politician

roxanne.meaning_en: Roxanne is a Persian feminine given name. The English rendition of the name is derived from Greek Ῥωξάνη Rhōxanē, used for Roxana, one of Cambyses's wives, the daughter of Idérnēs, a sister of one sister of king Mithridates VI, and the wife of Alexander the Great.

roxy.meaning_en: Roxy is a given name or nickname, usually for Roxanne. Notable people with the name include:

roy.meaning_en: Roy is both a given name and a family surname with varied origins.

roya.meaning_en: Roya Persian: رویا), "dream", is a female name of Persian origin. It is common in Iran, Afghanistan, and Azerbaijan.

rozelle.meaning_en: Rozelle is a given name. Notable people with the given name include: Rozelle Claxton, American jazz pianist Rozelle Gayle, American jazz pianist, comic entertainer and actor Rozelle Scheepers, South African cricketer

rozenn.meaning_fr: Rozenn est un prénom féminin, principalement fêté le 23 août.

ruairi.meaning_en: Rory is a given name of Gaelic origin. It is an anglicisation of the Irish: RuairíThe meaning of the name is "red king", composed of ruadh and rígh. In Ireland and Scotland, it is generally seen as a masculine name and therefore rarely given to females.

ruari.meaning_en: Rory is a given name of Gaelic origin. It is an anglicisation of the Irish: RuairíThe meaning of the name is "red king", composed of ruadh and rígh. In Ireland and Scotland, it is generally seen as a masculine name and therefore rarely given to females.

ruby.meaning_en: Ruby is a predominantly feminine given name taken from the name of the gemstone ruby. The name of the gemstone comes from the Latin rubinus, meaning red. The ruby is the birthstone for the month of July.

rudolf.meaning_en: Rudolph or Rudolf or Rodolphe is a male first name, and, less commonly, a surname. It is an ancient Germanic name deriving from two stems: Hrōþi, Hruod, Hróðr or Hrōð, meaning "fame", "glory" "honour", "renown", and olf meaning "wolf".

rueben.meaning_en: Reuben or Reuven is a Biblical male first name from Hebrew רְאוּבֵן, meaning "behold, a son". In the Bible, Reuben was the firstborn son of Jacob.

rufina.meaning_en: Rufina is a female given name and surname, meaning "red-haired". It is claimed to be of Latin, Greek, Italian, Russian or Spanish origin. As a first name, it is the female equivalent of Rufus.

rui.meaning_en: Rui is a Portuguese male given name, a Japanese unisex name, and a Chinese unisex name component.

rumeysa.meaning_en: Rümeysa, or Rumeysa, is a feminine given name, the Turkish form of Arabic Rumaythah – the name of two companions of Muhammad – or Rumaysah, with several meanings.

rumi.meaning_en: Rumi is a feminine Japanese given name.

rune.meaning_en: Rune is a unisex given name in English speaking nations as well as Thailand, though it is predominantly masculine in Europe. The name is derived from the Old Norse word rún, meaning "secret" or the "sun". It is earliest attested in a runestone as Runi.
rune.meaning_fr: Rune est un prénom masculin scandinave dérivé du vieux norrois rún « secret ». Il se rencontre principalement en Norvège et dans les îles Féroé, parfois sous sa variante Rúni.

ruqayyah.meaning_en: Ruqayya is an Arabic female given name meaning "to rise”, or ”she who rises high”. Like most Arabic names, it has multiple transliterations: Ruqayyah, Ruqiya, Ruqaya, Ruqaiya, Rukayya, Rukaiya, Rukiya, Rakiya, Rakia, etc..
ruqayyah.meaning_fr: Rokia est un prénom féminin d'Afrique subsaharienne, équivalent de l'arabe Rukayya, prénom de la deuxième fille de Mahomet et Khadija.

ruslan.meaning_en: Ruslan is a masculine given name, a variant of the Turkic word aslan or arslan, meaning 'lion'. The name was popularized in the Russian Empire by the poem of Alexander Pushkin, Ruslan and Ludmila. Earlier, a version Yeruslan was attested.

famous.name: Russ Meyer
famous.occupation: non-sex actor in a pornographic work

russ.meaning_en: Russ is a masculine given name, often a short form of Russell, and also a surname.

russell.meaning_en: Russell is a given name that originated from the surname Russell, which in turn derives from the French name russel "red-haired, from rus "red hair color" and the suffix -el.

rusty.meaning_en: Rusty is a given name. Notable people with the name include:

famous.name: Ruth Bader Ginsburg
famous.occupation: Member of the Constitutional Court of Austria

ruth.meaning_en: Ruth is a common female given name, noted from Ruth, the eponymous heroine of the Book of Ruth.

ruthie.meaning_en: Ruthie is a feminine diminutive of Ruth.

ryan.meaning_en: Ryan is an English-language given name of Irish origin. Traditionally a male name, it has been used increasingly for both boys and girls since the 1970s. It comes from the surname Ryan, which is typically an anglicisation of the Irish surname Ó Riaghain / Ó Riain.

ryane.meaning_fr: Rayan, s'écrivant aussi Rayane, Ryan, Ryane, Rayyan, ou encore Rayene, est un prénom mixte.

ryann.meaning_en: Ryann is a female given name.

ryker.meaning_en: Riker or Ryker is a given name and surname of Dutch origin and is a cognate of Richard.

ryo.meaning_en: Ryō is a unisex Japanese given name. It is sometimes romanized as Ryou, Ryoh, or Ryo.
ryo.meaning_fr: Ryō est un prénom japonais, généralement masculin. Ce prénom est fréquent. Il peut être composé avec un suffixe : Ryōichi, Ryōichirō, Ryōsuke, ou encore Ryōtarō.

saad.meaning_en: Saad is a common male Arabic given name. The name stems from the Arabic verb sa‘ada. Saad is the stem of variant given names Suad and Sa‘id. It may be a shortened version of Sa'd al-Din, and is not to be confused with it.

saadia.meaning_en: Saadia or Saadiya is an Arabic, Hebrew and Berber masculine and feminine proper name. It is used as a forename and more rarely as a surname. According to some classical rabbinical sources, the name derives from the Hebrew verb Sa'ad, and means "God has supported".

saahil.meaning_en: Saahil is an Indian given name. Notable people with the name include: Saahil Jain, Indian cricketer Saahil Prem, Indian actor

saara.meaning_en: Saara is a female given name in Finland and Estonia, derived from the biblical name Sarah. Its nameday is celebrated on the 19th of July. As of 2012, almost 20,000 people in Finland have this name. It was most popular in the 1980s and the 1990s.

sabiha.meaning_en: Sabiha is an Arabic word meaning "Morning" and a female given name. Notable people with the name include:

sabin.meaning_en: Sabin is a given name of the following people Sabin of Bulgaria, ruler of Bulgaria from 765 to 766 Sabin Bălașa, Romanian painter Sabin Berthelot, French naturalist and ethnologist Sabin Bornei, Romanian boxer Sabin Carr, American pole vaulter Sabin Chaushev, Bulgarian Olympic shooter Sabin W.

sabine.meaning_fr: Sabine est un prénom féminin, porté par dix saintes chrétiennes. Il est exceptionnellement attribué à un homme. C’est aussi un nom de famille. Il figure également dans le titre de plusieurs œuvres artistiques ou littéraires.

sabra.meaning_en: Sabra or Sabrah is both a given name and surname with multiple origins. As an English feminine given name, it has been in use since the 18th century. It is sometimes considered a variant of the name Sabrina.
sabra.meaning_fr: Sabra est un prénom féminin arabe, également utilisé en anglais.

sabrina.meaning_en: Sabrina is a feminine given name derived from Proto-Celtic *Sabrinā.

sacha.meaning_fr: Sacha est le diminutif hypocoristique des prénoms Alexandre et Alexandra dans les langues slaves, et a donc la même étymologie. En France, il est lui-même utilisé comme prénom masculin et parfois féminin.

sachiko.meaning_en: Sachiko is a feminine Japanese given name that means "child of bliss." It also means "happiness" when it is written with the kanji characters 幸子. One common short form of the name is Sachi.

sachin.meaning_en: Sachin is a masculine given name common in South Asia. It is derived, via Indic languages like Bengali and Marathi, from the Sanskrit name Shachindra. Shachindra is a name given to Hindu god Indra which means Shachi's Indra. It is also a name of Hindu god Shiva.

sadi.meaning_en: Sadi and its variant Saadi are used as a masculine given name and a surname. Notable people with the name include:

sadie.meaning_en: Sadie is a feminine given name which originated as an English diminutive of the Hebrew name Sarah. It has long been used as an independent name. It is also a hypocorism of Sara or Sarah, and on rare occasions a masculine nickname.

saeed.meaning_en: Saʽid, also spelled Saʽeid, Said, Saïd, Sid, Saeed, Saed, Saied, Sayeed or Sayid, is a male Arabic given name which means "blessed, lucky, joy" or "happy, patient". The name stems from the Arabic verb sa‘ada.

safaa.meaning_en: Sanaa, or Safa, is the gender-neutral name derived from the Arabic word Safa, which means "purity", "innocence".

safi.meaning_en: Safi is a name of Arabic origin meaning "pure." It is a common surname in Levantine countries such as Palestine, Syria and Lebanon.

safia.meaning_en: Safiya is an Arab name, meaning "pure." Alternative transliterations include Saffiyah, Safiyyah, Safie, Safia, Safija, Safya, Safiyah, Safeia, etc. Notable bearers of the name include:
safia.meaning_fr: Safia est un prénom arabe féminin signifiant « pure ». Dans les pays musulmans, on associe ce prénom à la beauté pure, ou encore à la bonté et à la générosité. En Afrique de l'Ouest, ce prénom est souvent transformé en Safiata et Safiatou.

safiya.meaning_en: Safiya is an Arab name, meaning "pure." Alternative transliterations include Saffiyah, Safiyyah, Safie, Safia, Safija, Safya, Safiyah, Safeia, etc. Notable bearers of the name include:

sahar.meaning_en: Sahar is either a feminine given name of Arabic origin, common throughout the Persian-speaking and Muslim worlds, or unisex given name of Hebrew origin, used mainly in Israel.

sahir.meaning_en: Sahir is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Sahir Edoo, Mauritian badminton player Sahir Hoshiarpuri, Urdu poet Sahir Lodhi, Pakistani actor, director, and host Sahir Ludhianvi, Urdu poet Sahir Naqash, German cricketer

said.meaning_en: Saʽid, also spelled Saʽeid, Said, Saïd, Sid, Saeed, Saed, Saied, Sayeed or Sayid, is a male Arabic given name which means "blessed, lucky, joy" or "happy, patient". The name stems from the Arabic verb sa‘ada.

saida.meaning_en: Saida, Saidah also spelled Sayda, Saeeda, or Sayeeda, is the female form of the Arabic male given name Sa‘id. Saida is a Kurdish name means mother's sweetheart. Saida is a Japanese surname but not related to the Arabic given name

saim.meaning_en: Saim is an Arabic masculine given name. Notable people with this name include:

sajid.meaning_en: Sajid is a masculine given name of Arabic origin. It means "one who bows down to God". Notable people with the name include:

sakari.meaning_fr: Sakari est un prénom féminin et masculin.

sakina.meaning_en: Sakina is a feminine given name of Arabic and Hebrew origin.
sakina.meaning_fr: Sakina - ou parfois Sakyna - est un prénom, pouvant être d'origine japonaise, ou arabe. Très peu populaire au Japon, où le nom signifie les fleurs, il commence à se populariser petit à petit. En arabe, ce prénom signifie la paix et la sérénité.

sal.meaning_en: Sal is a given name and nickname, the latter often of Salvatore, Salvador, or Salomon.

saleem.meaning_en: Salim is a name of Semitic origin from the root It derives from the Semitic tri-consonantal root s-l-m meaning "safe" "clean" or "undamaged".

saleh.meaning_en: Saleh or Saaleh, Arabic form of the Hebrew Shelah, Selah or Methuselah, is a Semitic male name derivative. In Arabic it means "righteous" or "pious".

salimata.meaning_en: Salimata is a feminine West African given name, a form of Salima, the feminine form of Arabic Salim, which means "safe" or intact".

saliou.meaning_en: Saliou is an African given name.

sally.meaning_en: Sally or Sallie is an English language feminine given name that originated as a hypocorism for Sarah. Young children often have difficulty in pronouncing the letter r, which resulted in nicknames like Sally that substitute the letter r for l.

salma.meaning_en: Salma is an Arabic feminine name that means "peace.” It comes from the Arabic word Salam.
salma.meaning_fr: Salma est un prénom féminin qui signifie "la paix" en arabe.

salvador.meaning_en: Salvador is normally an indirect way of naming a Messiah.

salvatore.meaning_en: Salvatore is an Italian name meaning "Saviour". People named Salvatore include:

sam.meaning_en: Sam is a unisex given name. It is often short for other names, such as Samuel or Samantha.

samad.meaning_en: Samad or Samed is an Arabic male given name.

samaira.meaning_en: Samaira is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Samaira Mehta, American coder and inventor Samaira Rao, Indian actress

samantha.meaning_en: Samantha is an English feminine given name in use since the 17th century that is of uncertain derivation. It is now in popular use worldwide due to various popular culture influences.
samantha.meaning_fr: Samantha est un prénom féminin, fêté le 19 décembre.

samar.meaning_en: Samar is a female/male given name, gender is based on the country. It is used in several languages.

samara.meaning_en: Samara is a female given name of various origins. It might refer to Samara, Iraq; Samara, Russia; or to winged fruit seeds. The name increased in use after it was used for an evil character in the 2002 horror film The Ring.

sameera.meaning_en: Samira is a Sanskrit, Arabic, or Persian given name. In Sanskrit, Sameera or Samira is a feminine given-name, meaning "breeze, wind," or "Vāyu, the wind deity". Many anglicize their name to Samīr or Sameer.

samer.meaning_en: Samer is an Arabic male name literally means "informal friendly talk or chat to pass the night", "one to whom you speak", "congregation of those who spend the evening in pleasant conversation", "evening chat companion", "entertainer, companion".

sami.meaning_en: Sami, also Sammy or Samy, is a given name and surname of different origins and meanings, most prevalent in the Arab world and Scandinavia.

samiha.meaning_en: Samiha is an Arabic feminine given name, the feminine form of Samih or Sameh.

samina.meaning_en: Samina is a feminine given name that may derive from Arabic or Hebrew. The Hebrew derivation has numerous variants and is popular in Scandinavian countries.

samir.meaning_en: Samir is a male name found commonly in South Asia, the Middle East, and Central Asia. In Arabic, Samir means "holy", "jovial", "loyal", or "charming". In Albanian, it literally means "so good" but loosely "exquisite", "superb", or "perfect".
samir.meaning_fr: Samir est un nom propre d'origine arabe utilisé comme prénom. Il existe aussi sous les versions féminines de Samira ou Samirah.

samira.meaning_en: Samira is a Sanskrit, Arabic, or Persian given name. In Sanskrit, Sameera or Samira is a feminine given-name, meaning "breeze, wind," or "Vāyu, the wind deity". Many anglicize their name to Samīr or Sameer.

sammy.meaning_en: Sammy is a nickname, frequently for people named Samuel or Samantha, and also an English spelling of the Arabic name Sami.

samora.meaning_en: Samora is a unisex given name and a surname. People with the name include:

samuel.meaning_en: Samuel is a male name and a surname of Hebrew origin. It means "name of God", deriving from the Hebrew Shem + ʾĒl.
samuel.meaning_fr: Samuel est un prénom masculin, principalement fêté le 20 août. Il a été porté notamment par un prophète de l'Ancien Testament et plusieurs saints de l'ère chrétienne.

sanae.meaning_en: Sanae is a name that is typically given to girls in contemporary Japan, but can also be given to boys.

sanah.meaning_en: Sanah is a feminine given name. Notable people with the name include: Sanah, Polish singer and songwriter Sanah Moidutty, Indian singer and songwriter Sanah Mollo, South African women's footballer

sandeep.meaning_en: Sandeep is a common Indian given name, primarily male. The name may be derived either from the Sanskrit saṃdīpa, referring to a burning flame or lamp, or from the name of Sandipani, the guru of Krishna. Other spelling variations include Sandeep and Sundeep.
sandeep.meaning_fr: Sandeep ou Sundeep est un prénom populaire en Inde et au Népal. Il se compose de deux éléments : sat et dīp. Sat renvoie à la bonté ou à la vertu, et dīp renvoie à la lumière. Saṃdīp, ou Sandeep, combine ces deux mots par le procédé grammatical du sandhi.

sandra.meaning_en: Sandra is a female name, which is often used as a short form for Alexandra or Cassandra. Alexandra is a feminine form of the male name Alexander, which is a romanization of the Greek name Ἀλέξανδρος, Alexandros.

sandrine.meaning_en: Sandrine is a French female name. It is a diminutive form of Sandra, a shortened form of Alexandra, the female version of Alexander, which means Protector of Men. There are variants such as Sandrilene.

sandy.meaning_en: Sandy is a popular unisex given name. It is often short for other names. Spelling variations include Sandi and Sandie. Notable people named Sandy include:

sanford.meaning_en: Sanford is a male given name of Old English origin, meaning "sandy ford". Notable people with the name include: Sanford Barsky, American professor of pathology Sanford Bates, American penologist, administrator and author Sanford Berman, American librarian Sanford I.

saniya.meaning_en: Saniya or Saniyya or Saniyah is a feminine given name.

sanna.meaning_en: Sanna or Sanne, the Scandinavian short form of Susanna that in turn is a Greek version of a Hebrew name meaning "lily". It may also be a Sardinian surname.

santa.meaning_en: Santa is a given name. As a Latvian feminine given name, the name day of people named Santa is September 14.

santiago.meaning_en: Santiago is a masculine Spanish name that derives from the Hebrew name Jacob via "Sant Iago", "Sant Yago", "Santo Iago", or "Santo Yago", first used to denote Saint James the Great, the brother of John the Apostle.

santina.meaning_en: Santina is an Italian feminine given name derived from the Latin sanctus, meaning saint or holy. It is a feminine form of Santo or diminutive Santino. Both names are diminutive forms with the connotation of "little saint."

sanya.meaning_en: Sanya is both a given name and a surname.

saoirse.meaning_en: Saoirse is an Irish-language unisex given name meaning "freedom". It became popular in Ireland in the late 20th century. The actress Saoirse Ronan has given the name prominence internationally since her 2007 breakthrough in Atonement.

saori.meaning_en: Saori is a feminine Japanese given name.

tamara.meaning_en: Tamara is understood to mean "date", referring to the fruit of the date palm tree. In other words, the name carries the literal meaning of the sweet date fruit. This is not merely a coincidental interpretation as it is rooted in the Arabic language itself.

tiziana.meaning_fr: Tiziana est un prénom italien féminin. Il est notamment porté par : Tiziana Beghin, femme politique italienne. Paola Tiziana Cruciani, actrice et dramaturge italienne. Tiziana Lodato, actrice italienne. Tiziana Pini, animatrice de télévision italienne.

tobi.meaning_en: Tobi is a Yoruba unisex given name. It can be a contraction of several longer terms, including Olutobi, Oluwatobi, Oluwatobiloba.

tobias.meaning_en: Tobias is the romanization into Latin letters of the Koine Greek name Τωβίας, which itself is a Hellenization of the Biblical Hebrew name טוֹבִיה, Toviyah, 'Yah is good'. It is the name of several minor Biblical figures as well as a major character in the Book of Tobit.

tobie.meaning_fr: Tobie est le prénom du personnage principal du Livre de Tobie, dans la Bible hébraïque. Il vient de Τωβίας, la version grecque de Toviyah qui signifie « YHWH est bon » en hébreu. Ce prénom a été donné principalement dans les milieux protestants. Il est fêté le 31 janvier.

tobin.meaning_en: Tobin is a unisex given name of Irish origin.

toby.meaning_en: Toby is a given name in many English-speaking countries. The name is derived the Middle English vernacular form of Tobias. Tobias itself is the Greek transliteration of the Hebrew טוביה Toviah, which translates to Good is Yahweh. Yahweh is the name of the Jewish God.

toccara.meaning_en: Toccara is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Toccara Jones, American television personality, fashion model, occasional actress and singer Toccara Montgomery, American freestyle wrestler Toccara Williams, American WNBA basketball player

tod.meaning_en: Tod is a given name. Notable persons with that name include:

todd.meaning_en: Todd is a masculine given name. The name originated from Middle English, where it means "fox". Notable people and characters with the name include:

toi.meaning_en: Toi is a given name of the following notable people: toi8, Japanese artist Toi Aukuso Cain, Samoan politician Toi Cook, American football player Toi Derricotte, American poet Toi Hutchinson, American politician Toi Inagawa, Japanese yakuza member Toi Kagami Japanese footballer Toy Kojima Japanese professional wrestler Toi Suzuki Japanese water polo player Toi Te Rito Maihi, New Zealand weaver, printmaker, painter, educator and writer.

toinette.meaning_en: Toinette is a French given name in use in French speaking countries as a short form of Antoinette. Notable people with this name include the following:

tolga.meaning_en: Tolga is a Turkish given name. It means "war helmet" or “the rising”. It is also an Australian Aboriginal term for “red volcanic soil”. Also in the Hazara language, it means "crown" The name is used mostly for males. It may refer to:

tom.meaning_en: Tom is a masculine given name, often used as a diminutive of Thomas. In Germanic countries and Scandinavia, "Tom" is in use as a formal given name. The Gaelic-Cymric name Tom means "rising ground" or "eminent".

toma.meaning_en: In European and Assyrian usage, the name Toma is a version of Thomas. In the Russian language, it is a diminutive of the female given name Tamara. In Japan, it is a male name of a different origin. The meaning will vary by which kanji are used to write this name.

tomi.meaning_en: Tomi is a common name. In Finnish, it is a variant of Thomas and primarily used as a masculine name. In Japan, it can be a feminine or masculine given name. Notable persons with that name include:

tomie.meaning_en: Tomie is both a surname and a Japanese feminine given name. Notable people with the name include:

tomiko.meaning_en: Tomiko is a feminine Japanese given name.

tommaso.meaning_en: Tommaso is an Italian given name. It has also been used as a surname. Notable people with the name include:

tommi.meaning_en: Tommi is a masculine Finnish given name. Traditional Finnish diminutive of “Thomas”. Thomas comes from the Aramaic name Thoma, meaning ‘twin’. Used as a formal given name since 20th century, reinforced by the English Tommy.

tonette.meaning_en: Tonette is a Norwegian and Swedish given name in use in Sweden and Norway whose popularity peaked in the late 1960s. The name is a diminutive form of Antonetta and Antona as well as an alternate form of Tone, Tona and Torny.

toney.meaning_en: Toney is a given name and a nickname. Notable people with this name include the following:

toni.meaning_en: Toni, Toñi or Tóni is a unisex given name used in several European countries as well as among individuals with ancestry from these countries outside Europe.

tonia.meaning_en: Tonia is an Italian and Spanish feminine given name that is a diminutive form of Antonia as a feminine form of Tonino and Tonio that is used in Italy, Spain, parts of the United States, Mexico, Cuba, Dominican Republic, Guatemala, Honduras, El Salvador, Nicaragua, Costa Rica, Western Panama, Colombia, Venezuela, Peru, Ecuador, Bolivia, Chile, Paraguay, Argentina, Uruguay, and the Falkland Islands.

tonie.meaning_en: Tonie is a Swedish unisex given name and a nickname that is a diminutive form of Antonia in Sweden.

tonio.meaning_en: Tonino is an Italian and Spanish given name, surname or nickname.

tonja.meaning_en: Tonja is an English and Slovene feminine given name that is considered to be a short form of Antonija.

tonnie.meaning_en: Tonnie is a Danish, Dutch, Portuguese and Swedish given name and diminutive nickname with both masculine and feminine uses. As a Danish and Swedish name it is used as a diminutive of Antonia in Greenland, Denmark and Sweden, but also has masculine uses.

tonny.meaning_en: Tonny and Þonny are given names.

tonya.meaning_en: Tonya is an English female given name. The name originated as a short form of Antonia with influence from the Spanish form Toña. It can be found throughout the English-speaking world but is most common in the United States.

tora.meaning_en: Tora or Thora are female given names. In North Germanic languages, both Tora and Thora are derived from the Old Norse Þóra, a name related to the Norse god Thor.

torsten.meaning_en: Thorsten is a Scandinavian given name. The Old Norse name was Þórsteinn. It is a compound of the theonym Þór and steinn "stone", which became Thor and sten in Old Danish and Old Swedish.
torsten.meaning_fr: Torsten est un prénom masculin scandinave dérivé du vieux norrois Þorsteinn, formé des éléments Þórr « Thor », et steinn « pierre, roche ». C'est la variante suédoise du prénom Thorsten, porté notamment en Allemagne.

toshiko.meaning_en: Toshiko is a feminine Japanese given name.

toshio.meaning_en: Toshio is a common masculine Japanese given name.

toufik.meaning_en: Tawfik, or Tewfik, is an Arabic masculine given name and a surname. The name is derived from the Arabic root: waaw-faa-qaaf, which primarily means divine success, or to agree, or to reconcile. A spelling of Tewfik or Toufic is used more among French speakers.
toufik.meaning_fr: Toufic ou Toufik est un prénom arabe masculin qui signifie « acceptation », « succès » en français, issu de la racine arabe w.f.q, liée à la notion d’accord ou de conformité. Un prénom hébreu moderne ressemblant est Tovik ou Tuvik.

tracey.meaning_en: Tracy, is an English given name and surname. As a British personal name, it was originally adopted from Norman surnames such as those of the family de Tracy or de Trasci from Tracy-Bocage in Normandy, France.

traci.meaning_en: Tracy, is an English given name and surname. As a British personal name, it was originally adopted from Norman surnames such as those of the family de Tracy or de Trasci from Tracy-Bocage in Normandy, France.

tracy.meaning_en: Tracy, is an English given name and surname. As a British personal name, it was originally adopted from Norman surnames such as those of the family de Tracy or de Trasci from Tracy-Bocage in Normandy, France.

travis.meaning_en: Travis is mainly an English masculine given name of French origin. It is derived from the word "traverser" or "to cross", and was given to toll collectors who stood by a bridge or crossing.

tray.meaning_en: Tray is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Tray Blackmon, American football player Tray Chaney, American actor Tray Grinter (1885–1996, English cricketer Tray Walker, American football player

trayce.meaning_en: Trayce is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Trayce Jackson-Davis, American basketball player Trayce Thompson, American baseball player

trena.meaning_en: Trena is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Trena Cox, English artist Trena King, American archer Trena Trice-Hill, American basketball player

treston.meaning_en: Treston is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Treston Decoud, American football player Treston Thomison, American mixed martial artist

trina.meaning_en: Trina is a common female first name of Scandinavian origin. The name is based on the Latin word for "triple", Trena. Trina is often used as a shortened version of names such as Katrina. In dance, it is used as a term referring to a ballerina in training.

trinidad.meaning_en: Trinidad is a given name of Spanish origin that is often given in reference to the Christian doctrine of the Trinity, or one God in three persons. It is currently among the most popular names for girls in Chile.

trinity.meaning_en: Trinity is a given name of recent English origin that is derived from the Christian doctrine of the Trinity. It became popular starting in 1999 because of the character Trinity in The Matrix movies.

tripp.meaning_en: Tripp is a nickname, commonly used for males who are third-generation namesakes.

trish.meaning_fr: Trish est un prénom féminin, porté surtout aux États-Unis et dans les autres pays anglophones.

tristan.meaning_fr: Tristan est un prénom celtique, d'origine brittonique. Sa signification est controversée, elle descendrait de la racine du prénom Drusdan.

tristen.meaning_en: Tristan, Tristram, or Tristen is a given name derived from Welsh drust, influenced by the French word triste and WelshThe name owes its popularity to the character of Tristan, one of the Knights of the Round Table and the tragic hero of Tristan and Iseult.

triston.meaning_en: Tristan, Tristram, or Tristen is a given name derived from Welsh drust, influenced by the French word triste and WelshThe name owes its popularity to the character of Tristan, one of the Knights of the Round Table and the tragic hero of Tristan and Iseult.

troy.meaning_en: Troy is a male given first name used in English-speaking countries, and may derive from the Irish Troightheach, meaning "foot soldier". Additionally Troy is utilised as an anglicised surname derived from a variety of Gaelic and Norman surnames. Further detail here Troy.

trudie.meaning_en: Trudie is a female given name.

trudy.meaning_en: Trudy is a diminutive of Geertruida, and Gertrude. Notable people with the name include:

tucker.meaning_en: Tucker is a given name of mixed origin, likely deriving from the occupational surname referring to a "cloth-softener". The word 'Tucker' comes from the German word Tucher, meaning cloth-weaver.

tugdual.meaning_fr: Tugdual est un prénom masculin breton. Nom issu du breton tud et du vieux breton uual. Il fait référence à saint Tugdual de Tréguier, fêté le 30 novembre.

twana.meaning_en: Twana or Twanna is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Twana Barnett, American reality television star Twana Khalid Ahmed, Iraqi football referee Twanna Hines, American writer and internet personality

tyrone.meaning_en: Tyrone is a male given name of Irish origin. The name originates from the toponym County Tyrone in Northern Ireland, which in turn derives from the Irish language Tír Eoghain. Tír Eoghain was the name of a Gaelic kingdom of medieval Ireland.

ubaldo.meaning_en: Ubaldo is a masculine Italian and Spanish given name, from Germanic hug "mind" and bald "bold".

uchenna.meaning_en: Uchenna is a common given name of Igbo origin meaning “the will of the father,” where “father” could be one's birth parent or God. Though unisex, it is primarily given to boys.

ugo.meaning_en: Ugo is the Italian form of Hugh, a name of Germanic origin. Its diminutive form is Ugolino. It is also a Nigerian Igbo first name.

ugur.meaning_en: Uğur is a common masculine Turkish and Azerbaijani given name. In both Turkish and Azerbaijani, the word "uğur" means "luck".

ulises.meaning_en: Ulises is a Spanish-language given name. It is the Spanish form of the English name Ulysses, which itself derives from a Latin form of Odysseus.

ulisses.meaning_en: Ulisses is a Portuguese-language given name. It is the Portuguese form of the English name Ulysses, which itself derives from a Latin form of Odysseus.

ulrich.meaning_en: Ulrich is a Germanic given name derived from Old High German Uodalrich, Odalric. It is composed of the elements uodal- meaning "heritage" and -rih meaning "king, ruler".

ulyses.meaning_en: Ulyses is a male given name. People with this name include: Ulyses Daniel Alonso, husband of Myrka Dellanos Ulyses Garces, Philippine politician who was a member of the House of Representatives of the Philippines Ulyses L. Hewit, U.S.

ulysse.meaning_en: Ulysse, the French spelling of Ulysses, is a masculine French given name.
ulysse.meaning_fr: Ulysse est un prénom parfois donné en référence au personnage mythologique du même nom.

ulysses.meaning_en: Ulysses is one Latinized version of Odysseus. The name was made more famous in modern times by the American Civil War hero and eighteenth president of the United States, Ulysses S. Grant, by James Joyce's novel Ulysses, and the film of the same name.

uma.meaning_en: Uma is a given name in various cultures. In India, it is the name of the Hindu goddess, who is more commonly known as Parvati. In Sanskrit the word umā can further mean "tranquillity", "splendour", "fame" and "night".

umair.meaning_en: Umair, also spelled Umayr, is an Arabic male given name.

umar.meaning_en: Umar is a masculine given name.

umberto.meaning_en: Umberto is a masculine Italian given name. It is the Italian form of Humbert.

umut.meaning_en: Umut is a Turkish gender neutral given name meaning hope.

una.meaning_en: Una is a feminine given name with various origins. As used by Edmund Spenser in The Faerie Queene, the name is derived from the Latin unus, meaning one. Una is a currently popular name for girls in Serbia, where the name also has associations with the Una River.

unai.meaning_fr: Unai est un prénom masculin basque signifiant « vacher, berger [de vaches]». Le nom apparait à Artajona en 1167 avec le nom de « Garcia Unaia ».

uri.meaning_en: Uri is a Hebrew masculine given name.

ursula.meaning_en: Ursula is a feminine given name in several languages. The name is derived from a diminutive of the Latin ursa, which means "bear".
ursula.meaning_fr: Ursula est originellement un prénom féminin issu du latin ursus avec le diminutif -ula qui semble traduire dans une inscription bilingue latin - gaulois, le nom celtique Artula, petite oursonne. Il s'agit donc d'un calque.

usman.meaning_en: Osman refers to two different names: Osman or Usman is the Turkish, Persian, and Urdu transliteration of the Arabic masculine given name Uthman.

uthman.meaning_en: Uthman, also spelled Othman, is a male Arabic given name with the literal meaning of a young wise, brave, Wise, or brave. It is popular as a male given name among Muslims.

uzair.meaning_en: Uzair, also spelled "Uzayr" or "Ozair", is a male name. It is the Arabic equivalent of the Hebrew name "Ezra", and it means "helper" or "strength". The name originated from the Islamic prophet "Uzair", who is often identified as the biblical prophet "Ezra".

vadim.meaning_en: Vadim is a Slavic masculine given name derived from Vadim Rusnac, Bălți, the Ruthenian word vaditi, meaning to blame or as a diminutive of Vadimir. Ukrainian language: Vadym; Belarusian language: Vadzim.Notable people with the name include:

vaibhav.meaning_en: Vaibhav is a male given name in the Sanskrit language.

val.meaning_en: Val is a variant of the feminine names Valerie, Valeria, Valmai, Valentina, or Valene; as well as the masculine names Valeri, Valentine, Valen, Valentino, or Valens. Val is also a variant of the Old Norse names Vald and Valdr.

valarie.meaning_en: Valarie is a given name, similar to Valerie. Valarie Allman, American track and field athlete. Valarie Hodges, American businesswoman and politician. Valarie Jenkins, American disc golfer.

valdemar.meaning_en: Waldemar, Valdemar, Valdimar, or Woldemar is an Old High German given name. It consists of the elements wald- "power", "brightness" and -mar "fame".
valdemar.meaning_fr: Valdemar ou Waldemar est un nom porté par plusieurs rois et ducs scandinaves :

valentin.meaning_en: Valentin is a male given name meaning "strong, healthy, power, rule". It comes from the Latin name Valentinus, as in Saint Valentin. Commonly found in Argentina, Bulgaria, France, Germany, Italy, Romania, Russia, Scandinavia, Ukraine, Latin America, Spain and Croatia.

valentina.meaning_en: Valentina is a feminine given name. It is a feminine form of the Roman name Valentinus, which is derived from the Latin word "valens" meaning "healthy, strong".
valentina.meaning_fr: Valentina est un prénom féminin dérivé du prénom masculin Valentinus, qui dans l'ancienne langue latine signifiait : personne courageuse, leader, sociable, sage, active et vigoureuse.

valentino.meaning_en: Valentino is an Italian male given name, the masculine equivalent of the female given name Valentina. It may be abbreviated as "Vale" or "Tino". The equivalent English male given name is Valentine. A surname, Valentino, also exists. People named Valentino include:

valeri.meaning_en: Valery is a male given name and occasional surname. It is derived from the Latin name Valerius. The Slavic given name Valeriy or Valeri is prevalent in Russia and derives directly from the Latin.

valeria.meaning_en: Valeria is a female given name dating back to the Latin verb valere, meaning strong, brave and healthy "to be strong".

valerie.meaning_en: Valerie is generally a feminine given name, derived directly from the French Valérie. Valéry or Valery is a masculine given name in parts of Europe, as well as a common surname in Francophone countries. Another, much rarer, French masculine form of the name is Valère.
valerie.meaning_fr: Valérie est un prénom féminin, forme féminine du prénom Valère. Son étymologie latine : du verbe valere qui signifie « être fort » ou « avoir de la valeur ».

valerio.meaning_en: Valerio or Valério is a male given name in several languages, derived from the Roman surname Valerius, which itself is derived from the Latin verb valere, meaning "to be strong".

valery.meaning_en: Valery is a male given name and occasional surname. It is derived from the Latin name Valerius. The Slavic given name Valeriy or Valeri is prevalent in Russia and derives directly from the Latin.

vanessa.meaning_en: Vanessa is a feminine given name. It was created by the Anglo-Irish writer Jonathan Swift for Esther Vanhomrigh, whom Swift had met in 1708 and whom he tutored. The name was created by taking "Van" from Vanhomrigh's last name and adding "Essa", a pet form of Esther.

vanina.meaning_en: Vanina is a feminine given name.

vanna.meaning_en: Vanna is a given name that first appeared in recorded European history circa 1294. The Italian medieval feminine name originated in Tuscany, and is particular to Florence, Italy.

vasiliki.meaning_en: Vasiliki, also spelled Vassiliki, is a Greek female given name. The male version of this name is Vasilios.

vasilios.meaning_en: Vassilios or Vassileios, also transliterated Vasileios, Vasilios, Vassilis or Vasilis, is a Greek given name, the origin of Basil. In ancientIt is directly descended from the word "King", Greek: Βασιλιάς. It descends from the Greek language.

vaughan.meaning_en: Vaughan is a surname, originally Welsh, deriving from the Welsh word bychan, meaning "small". It is also used as a first name - mainly for men, and occasionally for women.

velia.meaning_en: Velia is a feminine given name.

velma.meaning_en: Velma is an English feminine given name of uncertain origin. It might have been created as a rhyming variant of the names Selma and Thelma.

velvet.meaning_en: Velvet is an English primarily feminine given name derived from the name for the fabric. A young Elizabeth Taylor played the horse-crazy 12-year-old Velvet Brown in the 1944 film National Velvet based on the 1935 book by Enid Bagnold.

vera.meaning_en: Vera is a female given name of Slavic origin. In Slavic languages, Vera means faith. The name Vera has been used in the English speaking world since the 19th century and was popular in the early 20th century. In Turkish Vera means piety. It is usually a feminine name.
vera.meaning_fr: Véra, ou Vera, est un prénom d'origine slave mais également latine, qui veut dire « la foi » en langue slave et « vrai » en latin.
