vern.meaning_en: Vern is a masculine given name, often a short form of Vernon, Lavern or other names. People named Vern include: Vernon Vern Bakalich, New Zealand rugby league player Verdi Vern Barberis, Australian weightlifter Vernon Vern Buchanan, American politician, member of the U.S.

vernon.meaning_en: Vernon is an English masculine given name, a transferred use of the French and English surname meaning “from the place of the alder trees.” Many English boys were likely named in honor of British Navy Admiral Edward Vernon.

veronika.meaning_fr: Veronika est une forme germanique et slave du prénom féminin Véronique.

vesna.meaning_en: Vesna is a Slavic female name derived from the name of Vesna, an ancient Slavic goddess of spring. It means "spring" in some Slavic languages. It is in use in Croatia, North Macedonia, Serbia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro and Slovenia.

vesta.meaning_en: Vesta is the Roman goddess of the hearth, home, and family. The given name may also refer to: People: Vesta Hathaway, British writer Vesta Kasputė, Lithuanian chess player Vesta C. Muehleisen, American educator Vesta M.

vibha.meaning_en: Vibha is an Indian feminine given name. The Sanskrit word vibhā has the meaning of "shining, bright".

vicki.meaning_en: Vicky, Vick, Vickie or Vicki is a feminine given name. It is often short for Victoria. The name Vicky in Greece comes from the name Vasiliki.

vickie.meaning_en: Vicky, Vick, Vickie or Vicki is a feminine given name. It is often short for Victoria. The name Vicky in Greece comes from the name Vasiliki.

victoire.meaning_en: Victoire is a French feminine given name. It is the French form of the name Victoria and the feminine form of Victor. It is derived from the Latin word victoria, meaning "victory".
victoire.meaning_fr: Victoire est un prénom féminin, fêté à différentes dates, voir à la page Sainte Victoire .

victor.meaning_en: Victor or Viktor is a given name and a surname. It is Latin in origin, meaning winner or conqueror, and the word “victor” still means this in Modern English.
victor.meaning_fr: Victor est un prénom masculin d'origine romaine signifiant vainqueur, formé sur le verbe latin vincere et qui signifie vaincre. La forme féminine est Victoire ou Victoria.

viggo.meaning_en: Viggo, also spelled Wiggo, is a Nordic male name. There are two main theories about its origins: a Latinised form of the Old Norse name Viggeir, which is also found in the form of other Germanic names, such as Ludvig. It stems from old Norse vig-, meaning "battle, fight".
viggo.meaning_fr: Viggo est un prénom scandinave, probablement dérivé du vieux norrois víg « guerre, bataille ».

vijay.meaning_en: Vijay is a Hindu male given name meaning 'Victory', and also a surname.

vikas.meaning_en: Vikas means expanding, progress or development in Sanskrit. It is often used as a masculine given name in Greater India. You would find people with this name all over India. Vikas and Pragati both means development. But Vikas name is given to males while Pragati to females.

vikram.meaning_en: Vikram, also Vickram, Vickrum, is a given name of Sanskrit origin. The most common understanding of the name Vikram is valorous—one who is wise, brave and strong as well as victorious.

viktor.meaning_en: Victor or Viktor is a given name and a surname. It is Latin in origin, meaning winner or conqueror, and the word “victor” still means this in Modern English.

vilma.meaning_en: Vilma is a feminine first name.

vinay.meaning_en: Vinay is an Indian name typically meaning guidance, good behaviour, genuinity, politeness, modesty and smart in Sanskrit. It has its origins in the Sanskrit language origin.

vince.meaning_fr: Vincent est un prénom français masculin d'origine latine, aussi utilisé comme patronyme. Dérivé du nom romain Vincentius, formé à partir du verbe latin vincere, il désigne notamment plusieurs saints de l'Église catholique, notamment saint Vincent de Saragosse, martyrisé en 304.

vincent.meaning_en: Vincent is a masculine given name originating from the Roman name Vincentius, which itself comes from the Latin verb vincere, meaning "to conquer."
vincent.meaning_fr: Vincent est un prénom français masculin d'origine latine, aussi utilisé comme patronyme. Dérivé du nom romain Vincentius, formé à partir du verbe latin vincere, il désigne notamment plusieurs saints de l'Église catholique, notamment saint Vincent de Saragosse, martyrisé en 304.

vincente.meaning_en: Vincente is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Vincente Minnelli, American film director and stage director

vincenza.meaning_en: Vincenza is an Italian female given name.

vinton.meaning_en: Vinton is a unisex given name. Bearers of the name include:

viola.meaning_en: Viola is a feminine given name derived from the Latin viola, given in reference to the flowering plant species. The name is in common use in Italy. In Greece as Violeta. It is best known in the Anglosphere as a character in William Shakespeare's Twelfth Night.

violaine.meaning_fr: Violaine est un prénom féminin dérivé du latin viola, qui a donné le prénom Violette. De même que d'autres prénoms de fleur ainsi que leurs dérivés, Violaine se fête le 5 octobre, jour de la sainte Fleur.

violet.meaning_en: Violet is a female given name which comes from the eponymous flower. As with other such names, its popularity has varied dramatically over time.

violeta.meaning_en: Violeta is a female given name.

violetta.meaning_en: Violetta is a female given name.

virginia.meaning_en: Virginia is a Germanic and Romance feminine given name thought to be derived from the Ancient Roman family name Verginius or Virginius.

virginie.meaning_fr: Virginie est un prénom féminin qui vient du latin virgo.

viridiana.meaning_en: Viridiana, Viridianne, Verdiana is a female given name of Latin origin as well as the name of an Italian saint.

vishal.meaning_en: Vishal is a name for males. Vishal means great, grandeur, magnificence, prominence, and eminence. The meaning is also attributive to the property of being grand.

vita.meaning_en: Vita is a feminine given name derived from the Latin word meaning life. In other instances it has been used as a diminutive of names such as Victoria or as a feminine form of the related masculine name Vitus and its masculine and feminine variants.

vito.meaning_en: Vito is an Italian name that is derived from the Latin word "vita", meaning "life". It is a modern form of the Latin name Vitus, meaning "life-giver," as in San Vito or Saint Vitus, the patron saint of dogs and a heroic figure in southern Italian folklore.

famous.name: Maria Beatrice of Savoy, Duchess of Modena

vittoria.meaning_en: Vittoria is an Italian feminine given name. It is the feminine form of Vittorio and the Italian form of the name Victoria. It is derived from the Latin word victoria, meaning "victory".

vittorio.meaning_en: Vittorio is an Italian given name. It is derived from the Latin name Victor, meaning "winner" or "conqueror". The feminine form of the name is Vittoria.

vivian.meaning_en: Vivian is a given name, and less often a surname, derived from a Latin name of the Roman Empire period, masculine Vivianus and feminine Viviana, which survived into modern use because it is the name of two early Christian female martyrs as well as of a male saint and bishop.

vladimir.meaning_en: Vladimir is a masculine given name of Slavic origin, widespread throughout all Slavic nations in different forms and spellings.
vladimir.meaning_fr: Vladimir est un prénom d'origine slave, également rencontré comme nom de famille. Vladimirovitch est le patronyme correspondant.

vladislav.meaning_en: Vladislav is a male given name of Slavic origin. Variations include Volodislav, Vlastislav and Vlaslav. In the Czech Republic, Slovakia and Croatia, the common variation is Ladislav.

vlasta.meaning_en: Vlasta is a woman’s name. It is also the short form of the feminine name Vlastina and masculine names Vlastimil and Vlastislav.

volkan.meaning_en: Volkan is a Turkish masculine given name and a surname. Notable people with the name include:

vonda.meaning_en: Vonda is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Vonda Kay Van Dyke, crowned the 1965 Miss America on September 13, 1964 Vonda N.

wade.meaning_en: Wade is a masculine given name of Anglo-Saxon English origin and derives from the pre-7th century Old English verb "wadan" meaning "to go", or as a habitational name from the Old English word "wæd" meaning "ford".

wael.meaning_en: Wa'el, also spelt Wael, is an ancient Aramaic male given name. The first currently known usage of the name was found and translated at a site called Sumatar Harabesi.

wafaa.meaning_en: Wafaa or Wafa is an Arabic given name and surname meaning "Loyalty, Faithfulness". Notable people with the name include:

waldemar.meaning_en: Waldemar, Valdemar, Valdimar, or Woldemar is an Old High German given name. It consists of the elements wald- "power", "brightness" and -mar "fame".

waleed.meaning_en: Waleed or al-Waleed, also spelled al-Walid, Walid, Oualid, or Velid, is an Arabic-language masculine given name meaning newborn child.

wali.meaning_en: Wali is a masculine given name of Arabic origin. Notable people with the name include:

walid.meaning_en: Waleed or al-Waleed, also spelled al-Walid, Walid, Oualid, or Velid, is an Arabic-language masculine given name meaning newborn child.

walker.meaning_en: Walker is an occupational male given name, deriving from the English term for "cloth washer".

wallis.meaning_en: Wallis is a unisex given name of English and Scottish origin. Notable people with the given name include:

walt.meaning_en: Walt is a masculine given name, generally a short form of Walter, and occasionally a surname. Notable people with the name include:

walter.meaning_en: Walter is a German and English masculine given name of Germanic origin, composed of the elements meaning "power" or "ruler", and "army".

wanda.meaning_en: Wanda is a female given name of Polish origin. It probably derives from the tribal name of the Wends. The name has long been popular in Poland where the legend of Princess Wanda has been circulating since at least the 12th century.

wandrille.meaning_fr: Wandrille est un nom masculin français d'origine germanique.

warner.meaning_en: Warner is an English, Finnish, Norwegian and Swedish given name that is an alternate form of Werner that is in use throughout North America, Australia, New Zealand, Papua New Guinea, the Philippines, Peninsular Malaysia, India, Pakistan, the British Isles, Norway, Finland, Sweden, the Republic of Karelia, Estonia, Guyana, Liberia, Sierra Leone, Ghana, Namibia, South Africa, Botswana, Zimbabwe, Zambia, Malawi, Tanzania, Uganda, Kenya, Sudan, South Sudan, Ethiopia, Cameroon and Nigeria.

waseem.meaning_en: Wasim, Wassim or Waseem is a masculine given name and surname of Arabic origin, meaning 'Handsome', 'Graceful' or 'Good-Looking'.

wasim.meaning_en: Wasim, Wassim or Waseem is a masculine given name and surname of Arabic origin, meaning 'Handsome', 'Graceful' or 'Good-Looking'.
wasim.meaning_fr: Wassim est un prénom arabe signifiant « élégant », « beau », en français.

wassim.meaning_en: Wasim, Wassim or Waseem is a masculine given name and surname of Arabic origin, meaning 'Handsome', 'Graceful' or 'Good-Looking'.

watson.meaning_en: Watson is a patronymic forename of English and Scottish origin. Meaning "Son of Walter" or "Son of Water", the name originated in Old English because in medieval times the usual pronunciation of Walter was Water.

webb.meaning_en: Webb is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Webb C.

webster.meaning_en: Webster is sometimes used as a given name.

wednesday.meaning_en: Wednesday is a usually feminine given name, taken from the day of the week.

wei.meaning_en: Wei is a Chinese given name. The form 伟 is the most common Chinese given name, accounting for approximately 0.5% of Chinese people.

wellington.meaning_en: Wellington is a masculine given name borne by: Wellington Albert, Papua New Guinean Rugby League player Wellington Carvalho dos Santos, Brazilian footballer Wellington Dias, Brazilian football midfielder Wellington Dias, Brazilian politician from Piauí Wellington Leal Dias Santos, Brazilian jiu-jitsu practitioner Wellington Fagundes, Brazilian Senator for Mato Grosso Wellington Gonçalves, Brazilian footballer Wellington Jighere, Nigerian Scrabble player Wellington Koo, Chinese diplomat Wellington Koo, Taiwanese lawyer and politician Wellington Lima, Brazilian artistic acrobat and performer Wellington Mara, American NFL team owner Wellington Masakadza, Zimbabwean cricketer Wellington Nem, Brazilian footballer ʻUelingatoni Ngū, Tongan crown prince from 1879 to 1885 Wellington A.

wenceslas.meaning_en: Wenceslaus, Wenceslas, Wenzeslaus and Wenzslaus are Latinized forms of the Czech name Václav.
wenceslas.meaning_fr: Venceslas est un prénom masculin d'origine slave. C'est aussi parfois un patronyme.

wendall.meaning_en: Wendall is a given name. Wendall, is related to the Old German name Wendell. The meaning of Wendall is "wanderer".

wendy.meaning_en: Wendy is a Welsh feminine given name. In Britain during the English Civil War in the mid-1600s, a male Captain Wendy Oxford was identified by the Leveller John Lilburne as a spy reporting on his activities. It was also used as a surname in Britain from at least the 17th century.

werner.meaning_en: Werner is a name of German origin and is common both as a given name and a surname. As is often the case with Germanic names, it is a dithematic name, meaning it is composed of two semantically unrelated word stems, in this case the Old High German waron and heri.

wesly.meaning_en: Wesly is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Wesly Decas, Honduran footballer Wesly Felix, Haitian boxer Wesly Mallard, American football player

wheeler.meaning_en: Wheeler is the given name of: People: Wheeler R. Baker, American politician Wheeler Peckham Bloodgood, American lawyer Wheeler H.

whitney.meaning_en: Whitney or Whittney is both a masculine and a feminine given name.

wiktor.meaning_en: Wiktor is a Polish masculine given name. It is the Polish form of the name Victor, meaning "winner" or "conqueror". The feminine form of the name is Wiktoria.

wiktoria.meaning_en: Wiktoria is a Polish feminine given name. It is the feminine form of Wiktor and the Polish form of the name Victoria. It is derived from the Latin word victoria, meaning "victory".

wilber.meaning_en: Wilber is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Wilber M.

wilfrid.meaning_en: Wilfred is a masculine given name derived from Germanic roots meaning "will" and "peace". The name was popular in the United Kingdom in the early twentieth century. Wilfried and its English spelling, Wilfrid, are closely related to Wilfred, with the same roots.

wilfried.meaning_en: Wilfried is a masculine German given name derived from Germanic roots meaning "will" and "peace". The English spelling is Wilfrid. Wilfred and Wifred are closely related to Wilfried with the same roots.

wilhelm.meaning_en: Wilhelm is a German given name, and a cognate of the English name William. The feminine form is Wilhelmine.

famous.name: Wilhelmine of Prussia, Queen of the Netherlands
Wilhelmine of Prussia, Margravine of Brandenburg-Bayreuth

wilhelmina.meaning_en: Wilhelmina is a feminine given name. It is the Dutch, German and Yiddish feminine form of Wilhelm, Willem, or William. It is derived from the Germanic wil, meaning "will, desire" and helm, meaning "helmet, protection".

will.meaning_en: Will [wil] or Wil is a given name, often a short form of William, Wilson, Wilfred, Wilbert, Willow, Wilmer, Wilbur, Wilhelm, Wilhelmina, Wilma, Willard or Willeke. Notable people with the name include:

willem.meaning_en: Willem is a Dutch and West Frisian masculine given name. The name is Germanic, and can be seen as the Dutch equivalent of the name William in English, Guillaume in French, Guilherme in Portuguese, Guillermo in Spanish and Wilhelm in German.

william.meaning_en: William is a masculine given name of Germanic origin. It became popular in England after the Norman conquest in 1066, and remained so throughout the Middle Ages and into the modern era.
william.meaning_fr: William est un nom propre. Il est utilisé comme prénom et comme nom de famille.

willo.meaning_en: Willo is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Willo Davis Roberts, American writer of children's novels Willo Flood, Irish footballer Willo McDonagh, Irish footballer

willow.meaning_en: Willow is a given name used in reference to the willow. It has grown in popularity in English speaking countries along with other names inspired by the natural world.

wilma.meaning_en: Wilma is a female given name, a feminine form of William. People with the name include:
wilma.meaning_fr: Wilma est un prénom féminin qui signifie protecteur. Il est l'abréviation du prénom allemand Wilhelmina, qui est parfois francisé par Wilhelmine. Son pendant masculin est Will, abrégé de William.

wilton.meaning_en: Wilton is a masculine given name which is borne by: Wilt Chamberlain, American Hall-of-Fame basketball player and actor Wilton R.

winifred.meaning_fr: Winifred peut désigner : Winifred, un prénom féminin utilisé dans les pays anglophones ; Winefride de Treffynnon, une sainte galloise du VIIe siècle, également désignée comme « sainte Winifred » ; Winifred, localité du comté de Fergus, dans l'État américain du Montana.

winnie.meaning_en: Winnie or Winny is both a male and a female given name of Welsh origin, a short form of Edwina, Winona, Winifred or Winnifred, Winter, Gwendolyn, Guinevere, Gwyneth, and Wynne. The name's meaning is: fair one, white and smooth, soft, happiness, or fair and pure.

winona.meaning_en: Winona is a feminine given name, an Anglicized form of the Dakota descriptive term, Winúŋna, meaning "firstborn daughter."

winslow.meaning_en: Winslow is a masculine given name.

winter.meaning_en: Winter is a unisex given name of English origin given in reference to the season. In some instances, the given name is a transferred use of the surname. The name has been in regular use across the English-speaking world.

wissam.meaning_en: Wissam is a masculine given name of Arabic origin. Notable people with this name include:

wissem.meaning_en: Wissem is a unisex Arabic given name. Notable people with the name include: Wissem Hmam, Tunisian handball player Wissem Hosni, Tunisian long-distance runner Wissem Ben Yahia, Tunisian footballer
wissem.meaning_fr: Wissem ou Wissam est un prénom arabe épicène.

wladimir.meaning_en: Wladimir is a masculine given name. It is an alternative spelling of the name Vladimir.

wolfe.meaning_en: Wolfe is a masculine given name. Notable people and characters with the name include:

wolfgang.meaning_en: Wolfgang is a German male given name traditionally popular in Germany, Austria and Switzerland. The name is a combination of the Old High German words wolf, meaning "wolf", and gang, meaning "path", "journey", "travel".
wolfgang.meaning_fr: Wolfgang est un nom propre qui peut désigner :

woodrow.meaning_en: Woodrow is a male English given name and surname. The name is derived from the Middle English wode + reue and the Old English wudu + rǣw, rāw, literally meaning "wood" and "row", "row of houses". The name was originally a surname.

wyatt.meaning_en: Wyatt is a male given name, derived from the Norman surname Guyot, derived from "widu", Proto-Germanic for "wood".

wynn.meaning_en: Wynn is a given name and nickname.

xander.meaning_fr: Xander est un prénom masculin, diminutif du prénom Alexander.

xavier.meaning_en: The given name Xavier is a masculine name derived from the 16th-century Navarrese Roman Catholic Saint Francis Xavier.
xavier.meaning_fr: Xavier est un prénom masculin, du basque etcheberri qui signifie maison neuve.

xaviera.meaning_en: The given name Xaviera is a feminine form of Xavier, both derived from the 16th-century Roman Catholic Saint Francis Xavier.

xenia.meaning_en: Xenia is a female given name. The below sections list notable people with one of the variants of this given name. Related names include Oksana, Ksenija; Kseniya; Xénia, and Senja.
xenia.meaning_fr: Xénia est un prénom d’origine grecque. Dans la Grèce antique, la xénia désigne le concept grec d’hospitalité, et, par extension, les présents offerts à un hôte. La relation d’hospitalité se fait sous la protection de Zeus et d’Athéna.

ximena.meaning_en: Ximena is the female version of the given name Jimeno or Ximeno, a Spanish or Basque name of unknown meaning that has been in use since the Middle Ages. It has been associated with the Basque Semen.

xiomara.meaning_en: Xiomara is a feminine Spanish given name, which is probably of Guanche ancestry that can be compared with Guacimara or Autinmara, which share the same suffixes.

xochitl.meaning_en: Xóchitl is the Westernised version of "xōchitl", the Nahuatl word for flower. It is a given name that is somewhat common in Mexico and among Chicanos. The name has been a common Nahuatl name among Nahuas for hundreds of years.

xolani.meaning_en: Xolani is a South African Xhosa, Zulu male given name.

xuan.meaning_en: Xuan is a unisex given name. In Asturian and Galician, Xuan is a masculine given name and the Asturian cognate of Johannes.

yacine.meaning_en: Yacine is the French version of the Arabic name Yasin. It is common in North Africa. The name comes from a chapter of the Quran called Ya-Sin. It is an epithet of the Islamic prophet Muhammad.
yacine.meaning_fr: Yassine ou Yacine est un prénom arabe mixte, majoritairement attribué à des garçons. Il s'agit du premier verset et titre de la sourate 36.

yael.meaning_fr: Yaël est un prénom féminin devenu épicène. En français, il peut être écrit avec tréma ou sans tréma, ou bien encore sous la forme de « Yaëlle ». Il est fêté le 13 juillet ou le 19 octobre avec Joël. Le correspondant étymologique arabe est le mot وَعِل : mouflon, argali.

yahia.meaning_en: Yahia, is a common Arabic male given name also written as Yahya or Yehia. People with the name include:

yahya.meaning_en: Yahya, also spelled Yehia, is an Arabic male given name. In the Qur'an, Yahya also appears as the Arabic equivalent of the given name of the prophet John the Baptist in Islam. For this reason, Yahya is now a common name in the Muslim world.
yahya.meaning_fr: Yahya ou Yahia est la traduction arabe non littérale de Jean, c'est en effet le nom que le Coran donne à saint Jean le Baptiste.

yakov.meaning_en: Yakov is a Russian or Hebrew variant of the given names Jacob and James. People also give the nickname Yasha or Yashka used for Yakov.

yamil.meaning_en: Yamil is a given name. It is a variant of Jamil.

yamila.meaning_en: Jamila is a feminine given name of Arabic origin. It is the feminine form of the masculine Arabic given name Jamil, which comes from the Arabic word jamāl, meaning beautiful.

yamina.meaning_en: Yamina is a given name. Notable people with the name include: Yamina Bachir, Algerian film director and screenwriter Yamina Benguigui, French film director and politician Yamina Halata, Algerian judoka Yamina Méchakra, Algerian novelist and psychiatrist
yamina.meaning_fr: Yamina est un prénom d'origine arabe signifiant « personne droite », « éthique » et « morale ».

yannick.meaning_en: Yannick is a first name that originated in Brittany, France, where the combination of its two Breton language parts, Yann and -ick, results in the meaning of Little John or Petit Jean in French.
yannick.meaning_fr: Yannick ou Yannig, est un prénom breton masculin, devenu mixte en français par confusion. Il est fêté le 27 décembre. Il se compose du prénom breton Yann, équivalent de Jean, et du diminutif -ig, et correspond aux prénoms à terminaison diminutive comme Johnny, Jeannot, Juanito.

yannik.meaning_en: Yannik is a German male given name.

yara.meaning_en: Yara is a given name developed independently in the Arabic and Tupi languages, and also the anglicized spelling of a number of unrelated given names.

yasir.meaning_en: Yasser is an Arabic male name meaning "to be of ease" or "of wealth".

yasmeen.meaning_en: Yasmin is a feminine given name of Persian origin, sometimes also used as a surname. Variant forms and spellings include Yasaman, Yasemin, Yasmeen, Yasmina, Yasmeena, Yasmine, and Yassmin.

yasmin.meaning_en: Yasmin is a feminine given name of Persian origin, sometimes also used as a surname. Variant forms and spellings include Yasaman, Yasemin, Yasmeen, Yasmina, Yasmeena, Yasmine, and Yassmin.

yasmina.meaning_en: Yasmin is a feminine given name of Persian origin, sometimes also used as a surname. Variant forms and spellings include Yasaman, Yasemin, Yasmeen, Yasmina, Yasmeena, Yasmine, and Yassmin.

yasser.meaning_en: Yasser is an Arabic male name meaning "to be of ease" or "of wealth".
yasser.meaning_fr: Yasser ou Yassir est un prénom masculin d'origine arabe qui signifie : prospère et facile à vivre.

yassin.meaning_en: Yassin, an alternative of Yasin, Yassine, Yaseen, Yacine, Yesine, Yessine and Yessin, is a unisex given name mostly common in the Arab world and Muslim countries, and a surname. The name comes from a chapter of the Quran called Ya-Sin.

yassine.meaning_en: Yassine is a given name, an alternative of Yasin, Yassin, Yaseen and Yacine. The name is most common in North Africa. The name is derived from a chapter of the Quran called Ya-Sin. It is an epithet of the Islamic prophet Muhammad.

yavuz.meaning_en: Yavuz is a common masculine Turkish given name and in Turkish, Yavuz means 'inflexible', 'resolute' and 'ferocious'.

yaw.meaning_en: Yaw is a masculine given name originating from the Akan people and their day naming system, meaning "born on a Thursday" in Akan language, following their day naming system.

yehoshua.meaning_en: Yehoshua is a masculine given name related to Joshua.

yelena.meaning_en: Yelena is a feminine given name. It is the Russian form of Helen, written Елена in Russian.

yeliz.meaning_en: Yeliz is a common feminine Turkish given name. In Turkish, "Yeliz" means "beautiful", "luminous", "brightly", and/or "spacious".

yennifer.meaning_en: Yennefer, Yenifer, or Yennifer is a given name likely derived from the Cornish name Jennifer, itself a cognate of the name Guinevere. It appears more in Spanish speaking and Latin American countries. Real and fictional people with the name include:

yeshua.meaning_en: Yeshua was a common alternative form of the name Yehoshua in later books of the Hebrew Bible and among Jewish people of the Second Temple period.
yeshua.meaning_fr: Yeshoua est une contraction de la forme יְהוֹשֻׁעַ. La forme courte de ce nom est privilégiée par rapport à la forme longue dans la littérature juive de la période du Second Temple, dont les plus récents livres de la Bible hébraïque sont un exemple.

yigit.meaning_en: Yiğit is a Turkish name that can be translated as "valiant", "a person of exceptional bravery and strength". Notable people with the name include:

yisroel.meaning_en: Israel is a masculine Hebrew name.

yitzchok.meaning_en: Yitzchok is a given name, which is the Hebrew pronunciation of the name Isaac, one of the patriarchs of the Israelites.

yoan.meaning_fr: Yoann est un prénom masculin qui correspond au prénom Jean en français. Yoann se fête le jour de Saint-Jean l’Évangélisateur, apôtre de Jésus-Christ, le 27 décembre, ou comme Jean-Baptiste, le 24 juin. Ce nom était à la mode dans les années 1980.

yoann.meaning_fr: Yoann est un prénom masculin qui correspond au prénom Jean en français. Yoann se fête le jour de Saint-Jean l’Évangélisateur, apôtre de Jésus-Christ, le 27 décembre, ou comme Jean-Baptiste, le 24 juin. Ce nom était à la mode dans les années 1980.

yoav.meaning_en: Yoav is a male given name popular among Israeli Jews. Its popularity is attributed to both Joab, commander of King David's army in the Hebrew Bible, and Yitzhak Dubno, a 1940s Palmach soldier whose codename was Yoav.

yohan.meaning_en: Yohan is a male given name of many origins. Yohan is a Hebrew given name, which was adopted as John. Similarly Yohanan was adopted as Jonathan.
yohan.meaning_fr: Yoann est un prénom masculin qui correspond au prénom Jean en français. Yoann se fête le jour de Saint-Jean l’Évangélisateur, apôtre de Jésus-Christ, le 27 décembre, ou comme Jean-Baptiste, le 24 juin. Ce nom était à la mode dans les années 1980.

yohann.meaning_fr: Yohann est un prénom masculin moderne correspondant à Jean en français. Il s'agit d’un prénom issu de l'allemand Johann ou du néerlandais Johan, dont le J- initial se prononce Y- [j]. Voir Jean. Les Yohann sont fêtés le 27 décembre.

yolaine.meaning_en: Yolaine is a French feminine given name. Notable people with the name include: Yolaine de Courson, French politician Yolaine Oddou, French-Canadian biathlete Dascha Yolaine Polanco, Dominican actress Yolaine Yengo, French rugby sevens player
yolaine.meaning_fr: Yolaine est un prénom féminin. Il peut être un prénom masculin.

yolanda.meaning_en: Yolanda is a female given name from Western Europe and North America, derived from the Greek name Iolanthe meaning "Violet". In German and Dutch the name is spoken similarly but traditionally spelled Jolanda, and in Italian, Portuguese and Romanian Iolanda.

yolande.meaning_en: Yolande is a feminine given name. People, real or fictional, with this name include:
yolande.meaning_fr: Yolande est un nom propre qui peut désigner :

yolonda.meaning_en: Yolonda is an African-American variation of the name Yolanda. People of the name include: Yolonda L.

yonatan.meaning_en: Jonathan is a common name given to males which means "YHWH has given" in Hebrew. The earliest known use of the name was in the Bible; one Jonathan was the son of King Saul, a close friend of David. Variants of Jonathan include Jonatan, Djonathan.

yonathan.meaning_en: Jonathan is a common name given to males which means "YHWH has given" in Hebrew. The earliest known use of the name was in the Bible; one Jonathan was the son of King Saul, a close friend of David. Variants of Jonathan include Jonatan, Djonathan.

yoseph.meaning_en: Joseph is a common male name, derived from the Hebrew Yosef. "Joseph" is used, along with "Josef", mostly in English, French and partially German languages. This spelling is also found as a variant in the languages of the modern-day Nordic countries.

yoshiko.meaning_en: Yoshiko is a feminine Japanese given name.

yoshio.meaning_en: Yoshio is both a masculine Japanese given name and a Japanese surname.

yosra.meaning_en: Yousra, Yosra, or Yusra is a feminine given name of Arabic origin. It is the feminine equivalent of Yousri. Notable people with the name include:

yossef.meaning_en: Yosef is a Hebrew male name derived from the Biblical character Joseph. The name can also consist of the Hebrew yadah meaning "praise", "fame" and the word asaf. It is the Hebrew equivalent of the Arabic name Yusuf and the source of the English name Joseph.

youenn.meaning_fr: Youenn est un prénom breton, dérivé de Iwan qui est une des formes bretonnes du prénom Yves. Autres variantes : Yeun, Cheun.

younes.meaning_fr: Yunus est un prénom masculin arabe dont la forme première est Yûnus. Il correspond en français au prénom Jonas. Il existe des variantes orthographiques : Younse, Younès, Younous, etc.

yousef.meaning_en: Yusuf is an Arabic male name meaning "increases". It is the Arabic equivalent of the Hebrew name Yosef and the English name Joseph. It is widely used in many parts of the world by Arabs of all Abrahamic religions, including Middle Eastern Jews, Arab Christians, and Muslims.

youssef.meaning_en: Yusuf is an Arabic male name meaning "increases". It is the Arabic equivalent of the Hebrew name Yosef and the English name Joseph. It is widely used in many parts of the world by Arabs of all Abrahamic religions, including Middle Eastern Jews, Arab Christians, and Muslims.

ysabelle.meaning_en: Isabel is a female name of Spanish origin. It originates as the medieval Spanish form of Elisabeth. Arising in the 12th century, it became popular in England in the 13th century following the marriage of Isabella of Angoulême to the king of England.

ysaline.meaning_fr: Ysaline est un prénom féminin ancien très peu répandu mais qui semble jouir d'une nouvelle popularité ces dernières années dans les statistiques françaises et belges.

yu.meaning_en: Yū or Yu or Yuu is a very common Japanese given name used by either sex.

yui.meaning_en: Yui is a feminine Japanese given name which can also be used as a surname.

yuki.meaning_en: Yuki and Yūki/Yuuki are separate Japanese given names used for females or males, though they can be romanized the same way when vowel length is not transliterated. Generally, Yuki is more common for females, while Yūki is more common for males.

yuma.meaning_en: Yuma and Yūma/Yuuma are separate Japanese given names used for females or males, though they can be romanized the same way when vowel length is not transliterated. Possible spellings of Yuma include ゆま, 夢真, and 悠麻.

yumi.meaning_en: Yumi is a feminine Japanese and Korean given name.
yumi.meaning_fr: Yumi est un prénom japonais utilisé dans beaucoup de mangas et animes. Cela signifie : « verte beauté ». Yumi Ishiyama est un des personnages principaux du dessin animé français Code Lyoko.

yumna.meaning_en: Yumna is a feminine given name of Arabic origin. Notable people with this name include:

yuna.meaning_fr: Youna, ou Yuna, ou Jeune, est un prénom féminin breton. Youna est une sainte de Plounévez-Moëdec, dans le Trégor. Elle est fêtée le 21 août.

yunus.meaning_en: Yunus, also spelled Younas, Younes, Younis, Younus, Yunes, Younous, Yunos and Yonas, is a common male given name, the Arabic version of the Greek Ιωνάς, from the Hebrew יוֹנָה Jonah 'dove'.

yuri.meaning_en: Yuri is a Japanese given name. Although it sounds similar, it is completely unrelated to the Slavic name Yuri.
yuri.meaning_fr: Yuri est un prénom donné dans différents pays : Yuri est une transcription anglophone du prénom masculin russe Юрий. Il existe différentes hypothèses quant à son origine, la plus connue étant que ce prénom viendrait du prénom d'origine grecque Georges, via le germanique Jorgen.

yuriko.meaning_en: Yuriko is a common Japanese given name, used for women.

yusuf.meaning_en: Yusuf is an Arabic male name meaning "increases". It is the Arabic equivalent of the Hebrew name Yosef and the English name Joseph. It is widely used in many parts of the world by Arabs of all Abrahamic religions, including Middle Eastern Jews, Arab Christians, and Muslims.

yuval.meaning_en: Yuval is a Hebrew first name. It means stream, brook, or tributary. In the Hebrew Bible, Yuval was the son of Lamech and Adah, a brother of Jabal, a descendant of Cain. He was named as the ancestor of all who played the lyre and pipe. Yuval is known as the father of music.

yvan.meaning_fr: Yvan est un prénom masculin, forme francisée du prénom Ivan.

famous.name: Gilbert du Motier, Marquis de Lafayette

yves.meaning_en: Yves is a common French male given name of uncertain origin, either from Celtic as in the Gaulish name Ivo and compound names Ivorix and Ivomagus, all derived from the Gaulish term for yew, iuos or īuos, or from Germanic, derived from Proto-Germanic *īwaz, *īhwaz, masculine variant of *īwō, from Proto-Indo-European *h₁eyHweh₂, meaning yew.
yves.meaning_fr: Yves est un prénom masculin français, d’origine incertaine, celtique ou germanique. Il est fêté le 19 mai. C'est aussi un patronyme, dont la forme la plus courante est Yvon.

yvette.meaning_en: Yvette is a feminine given name, the French feminine form of Yves, which means 'yew' or 'archer' in some cases.

yvon.meaning_en: Yvon is a masculine given name.

yvonne.meaning_en: Yvonne is a feminine given name, the female form of Yvon, which is derived from the French name Yves and Yvette. It is from the French word iv, meaning "yew". Since yew wood was used for bows, Ivo may have been an occupational name meaning "archer".

zabdiel.meaning_en: Zabdiel is a male given name of Hebrew origin, meaning "gift of God".

zacharias.meaning_en: Zechariah, with many variant forms and spellings such as Zachariah and Zacharias, is a theophoric masculine given name of Hebrew origin, meaning "God/YHWH remembers". It comes from the Hebrew root זכר, meaning to remember, and yah, one of the names of the God of Israel.

zacharie.meaning_en: Zacharie is both a masculine French given name and a surname. Notable people with the same name include:
zacharie.meaning_fr: Zacharie est un prénom masculin français.

zachary.meaning_en: Zachary is a male given name, a variant of Zechariah – the name of several biblical characters.

zack.meaning_en: Zack is sometimes a given name, but more often it is a hypocorism or short form of another given name, usually Zachary in the English speaking world, which derives from Zechariah.

zackery.meaning_en: Zechariah, with many variant forms and spellings such as Zachariah and Zacharias, is a theophoric masculine given name of Hebrew origin, meaning "God/YHWH remembers". It comes from the Hebrew root זכר, meaning to remember, and yah, one of the names of the God of Israel.

zahra.meaning_en: Zahra is a female given name and surname. It became popular as the name of Muhammad’s daughter, Fatimah al-Zahra. The name was also popularized by Muslim influence in the Indian subcontinent. Zahra is also used as a surname, particularly in Malta.

zain.meaning_en: Zain or Zayn is an Arabic personal name meaning "beautiful" or "handsome". Zayyan is a variation of Zain. It is also used as an alternate spelling of the Jewish and German name Zahn.
zain.meaning_fr: Zain est un prénom masculin d’origine arabe.

zaina.meaning_en: Zaina is a given name. Notable people with the given name include: Zaina Agoro, Nigerian American singer-songwriter Zaina Erhaim, Syrian journalist and feminist Zaina Hassan, Jordanian footballer Zaina Kapepula, Congolese basketball player

zainab.meaning_fr: Zainab ou Zaïnab est un prénom féminin arabe porté notamment par : Zainab Ahmed, femme politique nigériane ; Zainab Al-Ghazali, femme politique égyptienne ; Zainab al-Khawaja, militante bahreïni des droits de l'homme ; Zainab Balogun, actrice, mannequin et présentatrice de télévision nigériano-britannique ; Zainab Bangura, femme politique sierra-léonaise ; Zaïnab Biicheva, écrivaine, poétesse et dramaturge bachkire ; Zainab Fasiki, bédéiste et illustratrice féministe marocaine ; Zainab Fawaz, femme de lettre ottomane , Zainab Johnson, actrice et humoriste américaine ; Zainab Murad, journaliste et militante féministe égyptienne ; Zainab Salbi, humanitaire et auteure irako-américaine ; Zainab Shinkafi Bagudu, militante nigériane contre le cancer.

zaire.meaning_en: Zaire is a given name and surname. Notable people with the name include:

zak.meaning_en: Zak is a given name derived from Zachary or Zechariah/Zachariah.

zakariya.meaning_en: Zakariya is a masculine given name, the Arabic form of Zechariah which is of Hebrew origin, meaning "God/Yahweh has remembered".

zaki.meaning_en: Zaki is an Arabic male name and surname. Zaki is a Quranic name meaning "pure", "virtuous", or "intelligent".

zakia.meaning_en: Zakiya, Zakia, Zakiyah, Zakiyya or Zakieh may represent two different female given names of Arabic origin, namely Arabic: زكية, meaning "pure", corresponding to the male name Zaki, and Arabic: ذكيه, meaning "intelligent".

zakiah.meaning_en: Zakiya, Zakia, Zakiyah, Zakiyya or Zakieh may represent two different female given names of Arabic origin, namely Arabic: زكية, meaning "pure", corresponding to the male name Zaki, and Arabic: ذكيه, meaning "intelligent".

zakk.meaning_en: Zak is a given name derived from Zachary or Zechariah/Zachariah.

zalman.meaning_en: Zalman, occasionally Zalmen is a Yiddish-language variant of Solomon. The name was common among European Jews, and it still has usage in many Haredi and especially Hasidic communities.

zalmen.meaning_en: Zalman, occasionally Zalmen is a Yiddish-language variant of Solomon. The name was common among European Jews, and it still has usage in many Haredi and especially Hasidic communities.

zara.meaning_en: Zara is a feminine given name and a surname. Zara is commonly cited as a Hebrew name and considered a variant of the Hebrew name Sarah or a feminine form of Zarah, better known as Zerah, a biblical figure from the Book of Genesis.

zarina.meaning_en: Zarina is a feminine name derived from the Slavic word “tsar Caesar, name of the gens Iulia, commonly indicates Gaius Julius Caesar.

zaven.meaning_en: Zaven is an Armenian masculine given name.

zayd.meaning_en: Zaid or Zayd is an Arabic given name and surname.

zayden.meaning_en: Zayden is a variant of the male given name Aidan. The popularity of Zayden as a baby name in the United States peaked in 2014 when it reached 188th. The name entered into usage over the late 1990s and early 2000s decade.

zaynab.meaning_en: Zaynab, and variant spellings, is an Arabic female given name meaning 'a flower in the desert'. Zainab bint Muhammad was a daughter of the Islamic prophet Muhammad, Zaynab bint Ali was a granddaughter, two of his wives were Zaynab bint Jahsh and Zaynab bint Khuzayma.
zaynab.meaning_fr: Zaynab est un prénom arabe féminin. Ce prénom se présente sous plusieurs formes telles que Zeynab, Zineb et d'autres variantes.

zechariah.meaning_en: Zechariah, with many variant forms and spellings such as Zachariah and Zacharias, is a theophoric masculine given name of Hebrew origin, meaning "God/YHWH remembers". It comes from the Hebrew root זכר, meaning to remember, and yah, one of the names of the God of Israel.

zedekiah.meaning_en: Zedekiah is a masculine given name of Hebrew origins. It is most commonly associated with Zedekiah, a Biblical figure and the last monarch of the Kingdom of Judah. The name is also used by the following:

zehra.meaning_en: Zahra is a female given name and surname. It became popular as the name of Muhammad’s daughter, Fatimah al-Zahra. The name was also popularized by Muslim influence in the Indian subcontinent. Zahra is also used as a surname, particularly in Malta.

zeinab.meaning_fr: Zeinab est un prénom féminin arabe porté notamment par : Zeinab Al-Kafrawy, résistante anti-coloniale et enseignante égyptienne ; Zeinab Alif, religieuse catholique soudanaise ; Zeinab Badawi (1959, journaliste soudano-britannique ; Zeinab Bancé, cheffe cuisinière et entrepreneure ivoirienne ; Zeinab Camara, femme politique guinéenne ; Zeinab Jalalian (1982, militante iranienne en faveur des droits des femmes kurdes ; Zeinab Mamedyarova, joueuse d'échecs azerbaïdjanaise ; Zeinab Sedky, actrice égyptienne ; Zeinab Suma Jammeh, ancienne première dame de la Gambie.

zelda.meaning_en: Zelda is a nickname for the feminine name Griselda, from Old High German Grisja Hilda, 'Grey Battle-maid'. It is also the feminine form of the Yiddish name Zelig, meaning 'blessed', 'happy'.
zelda.meaning_fr: Zelda est un prénom, diminutif de Griselda. Dans l'un des contes du Décaméron de Boccace, Griselda est une jeune femme que le roi Gualtiero, son mari, met à l'épreuve afin de démontrer au peuple la supériorité de la noblesse du cœur sur le lignage.

zelia.meaning_en: Zelia is a feminine given name. Notable people named Zelia or Zélia include: Zealia Bishop, sometimes spelled Zelia, American short story writer Zelia N.

zelie.meaning_en: Zélie is a French short form of the name Azélie. Anglicized spellings and pronunciations of the name also in use include Zelie and Zellie. In some instances the name Zaylee and its spelling variants are intended as phonetic versions of Zélie.
zelie.meaning_fr: Zélie est un prénom féminin fêté le 17 octobre avec sainte Solène ou le 12 juillet avec Zélie Martin, mère de sainte Thérèse de Lisieux.

zeliha.meaning_en: Zeliha is a Turkish feminine given name. Notable people with the name include: Zeliha Ağrıs, Turkish taekwondo practitioner Zeliha Kendir, Turkish hockey player Zeliha Atıcıoğlu, Azerbaijani sport shooter Zeliha Şimşek, Turkish women's footballer

zena.meaning_en: Zena is a feminine given name.

zenaida.meaning_en: Zenaida, Zenaide, Zénaïde, or Zinaida, from Greek: Ζηναΐς meaning "dedicated to Zeus". It is a personal name used in many cultures for women. It can also refer to the Zenaida doves, named after Princess Zénaïde Bonaparte.

zeno.meaning_en: Zeno is the common anglicised form of the name Zenon, derived from the theonym Zeus. Other forms of the given name include Zénon and Zenón. The name is popular as a masculine given name in many Western countries, and it can also be found as a surname.

zenobia.meaning_en: Zenobia is a feminine given name of Greek origin meaning “life of Zeus”. It is the feminine form of Zenobios. The most famous bearer was Zenobia, queen of Palmyra. Russian language form: Zinovia.
zenobia.meaning_fr: Zénobie ou Zenobia est un prénom féminin d'origine grecque. Il a pour équivalent masculin Zénobe.

zenon.meaning_en: Zeno is the common anglicised form of the name Zenon, derived from the theonym Zeus. Other forms of the given name include Zénon and Zenón. The name is popular as a masculine given name in many Western countries, and it can also be found as a surname.
zenon.meaning_fr: Zénon est un nom masculin utilisé surtout en Grèce antique. Il a pour féminin Zénona.

zephaniah.meaning_en: Zephaniah is both a given name and surname. The name is of Hebrew origin and it means "God has hidden".

zeus.meaning_en: Zeus is a Greek god, the ruler of Mount Olympus and the king of the gods. Zeus or Zeuss may also refer to:

zi.meaning_en: Zi was the royal surname of the Kings of the Shang dynasty, originally from their ancestor named Xie. After the fall of the Shang and the rise of the Zhou dynasty, the royal family changed their surname to Yīn, the name of their capital.

zia.meaning_en: Zia is a name of Arabic origin somewhat translating to "Shine". Notable people with this name include:

ziad.meaning_en: Ziad is an Arabic given name and surname.

ziggy.meaning_en: Ziggy is a masculine given name, often a diminutive form of Zigmunt and other names. It is also a nickname. Notable people with the name include:

zigmund.meaning_en: Zygmunt, Zigmunt, Zigmund and spelling variations thereof are masculine given names and occasionally surnames. It has the same etymology as the Germanic name Sigismund. People so named include:

zilpha.meaning_en: Zilpha is a given name. Close variations include Zilphia and Zilpah. Notable people with the name include: Zilpah, mother of Gad and Asher in the book of Genesis Zilpah P.

zina.meaning_en: Zina is a given name. It may be an East Slavic diminutive of the female given name Zinaida. Notable people with the name include: Zina Andrianarivelo-Razafy, Madagascan diplomat Zina Bethune, American actress, dancer and choreographer Zina D. H.
zina.meaning_fr: Zina est un prénom féminin d'origine arabe et russe. Ce prénom existe dans d'autres langues à savoir italienne, tchèque et slovène avec d'autres étymologie. Par exemple les italiens disent Zina pour évoquer Constanzina.

zineb.meaning_fr: Zineb est un prénom féminin arabe porté notamment par : Zineb El Adaoui, femme politique marocaine ; Zineb El Arari, footballeuse marocaine ; Zineb El Rhazoui, journaliste franco-marocaine ; Zineb Ghezal, judokate algérienne ; Zineb Hattab, cheffe de cuisine maroco-espagnole ; Zineb Mama Ayad, gymnaste artistique algérienne ; Zineb Mekouar, écrivaine franco-marocaine ; Zineb Obeid, actrice et présentatrice de télévision marocaine ; Zineb Oukach, actrice marocaine ; Zineb Redouane, victime de violence policière lors du mouvement des Gilets jaunes à Marseille, en France ; Zineb Redouani, footballeuse marocaine ; Zineb Sedira, artiste franco-algérienne ; Zineb Sekelli (1935, personnalité de la cuisine algérienne ; Zineb Triki, actrice franco-marocaine ; Zineb Wakrim, réalisatrice, scénariste et artiste visuelle marocaine.

zinedine.meaning_fr: Pour l'ensemble des articles sur les personnes portant ce prénom, consulter : la liste des articles dont le titre commence par ce prénom les listes produites par Wikidata : Liste des personnes de prénom « Zinedine » — même liste en incluant les éventuels prénoms composés qui contiennent « Zinedine ».

zion.meaning_en: Zion is a given name and surname derived from the ancient Canaanite hill fortress in Jerusalem called the City of David. It is less commonly spelled Sion, Tzion, Tsion, Tsiyon, Seyon, or Tsiyyon. In Hebrew Zion is one of the 70 Names of Jerusalem.

zita.meaning_en: Zitta is a female given name. The name may originate from the Italian word zitta meaning young girl or from the Hungarian pet name of Felicita, from Latin Felicia. In Basque, the word means saint. In Greek, the word means' the hunter'.
zita.meaning_fr: Zita est un prénom féminin d’origine toscane, signifiant « petite fille », ou d’origine hongroise comme diminutif de Felicitás.

ziva.meaning_en: Ziva, Zivah, or Zhiva, is originally a Hebrew name. Ziva is a first name for women and an equally uncommon last name. The meaning of the name Ziva, which is a variant of Ziv, is “radiance, brilliance, light, brightness, light of God”.

ziya.meaning_en: Ziya is a Turkish given name for males and females, it is of Arabic origin, in Turkish Ziya means light.

zoe.meaning_en: Zoe is a feminine first name of Greek origin, meaning "life."

zoey.meaning_en: Zoe is a feminine first name of Greek origin, meaning "life."

zohra.meaning_fr: Zohra est un prénom d'origine arabe qui veut dire « blancheur », « radiance », « brillance ». C'est aussi le nom de la planète Venus, la planète brillante. C'est un prénom à rattacher à la langue sémite.

zoie.meaning_en: Zoe is a feminine first name of Greek origin, meaning "life."

zoltan.meaning_en: Zoltán is a Hungarian masculine given name. The name days for this name are 8 March and 23 June in Hungary, and 7 April in Slovakia. "Zoli" is the short version of Zoltán. "Zoli" is commonly used. Zoltána is the feminine version.

zora.meaning_en: Zora is a given name with origins across multiple cultures, most prominently Slavic, Arabic, Hebrew, and West African. Its roots and usage span both genders depending on cultural context. [1]
zora.meaning_fr: Zora est un prénom slave, donné en Serbie, Croatie, Macédoine, Tchéquie, et arabe.

zoraida.meaning_en: Zoraida is a given name. Notable people with the given name include: Zoraida Gómez, Mexican actress Zoraida Sambolin, American television journalist Zoraida Santiago, Puerto Rican composer and singer Zoraida Córdova, Ecuadorian-American writer and editor

zoran.meaning_en: Zoran is a common South Slavic name, the masculine form of Zora, which means 'dawn, daybreak'. The name is especially common in Serbia, North Macedonia, Croatia and to some degree in Slovenia.

zorawar.meaning_en: Zorawar is a Persian name that means forceful. It can be also be spelled as ‘Zoravar.’ The name 'Zorawar' originates from the ancient Persian language. It is derived from the Persian word 'zor' which means 'powerful' or 'strong', and 'avar' which means 'warrior' or 'leader'.

zubair.meaning_en: Zubayr is an Arabic masculine name and a surname from the root Z-B-R, meaning 'strong' or 'brave'.

zuleyka.meaning_en: Zuleika is a feminine given name. Variations of the name include Suleika, Zuleikha, Zulaikha, Zuleyka, Zuleica, Züleyha and Zuleykha. The name is of uncertain origin, possibly from Persian, meaning "brilliant beauty", or from Arabic, meaning "bright and fair". Zuzu is a nickname.

zulma.meaning_en: Zulma is a feminine given name that derives from the Ottoman Empire Sultan named Suleiman the Magnificent and some say it is also derives from the Hebrew "shâlôm", meaning "peace, completeness, safety, soundness, welfare, health, prosperity, quiet, tranquility, contentment, friendship, of human relationships, with god especially in covenant relationship".

zuri.meaning_en: Zuri is a given name of Swahili origin meaning "beautiful." It has been among the 1,000 most popular names for newborn girls in the United States since 2010 and among the top 300 names since 2018.

zuzanna.meaning_en: Zuzana is a common female given name in the Czech Republic and Slovakia. It is often translated to other languages as Zuzanna, Zsuzsanna, Suzanne, Susan, or Susannah – all commonly derived from the Hebrew language name Shoshana, meaning "lily".
zuzanna.meaning_fr: Suzanne est un prénom féminin d'étymologie chaldéo-perse issu de la Bible. La graphie Susanne existe également en français.

zvi.meaning_en: Tzvi is a Jewish masculine given name.

zygmunt.meaning_en: Zygmunt, Zigmunt, Zigmund and spelling variations thereof are masculine given names and occasionally surnames. It has the same etymology as the Germanic name Sigismund. People so named include:
zygmunt.meaning_fr: Zygmunt est un prénom polonais dont le variant français est Sigismond.
